jobs.title: Senior Web Designer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Senior Web Designer with a strong creative vision, excellent visual design skills, and a portfolio that demonstrates expertise in art direction, typography, layout, and motion.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Web Designer with a strong creative vision, excellent visual design skills, and a portfolio that demonstrates expertise in art direction, typography, layout, and motion.

This role is ideal for someone who can create visually engaging and interactive web experiences that go beyond standard corporate designs and templates. The selected candidate should be comfortable working independently, moving quickly, collaborating with developers, and taking ownership of design projects from concept to execution.

What You'll Do:

  • Conceptualize and design high-impact web pages, campaign experiences, and digital assets with a clear creative direction.
  • Develop distinctive visual concepts through strong art direction, typography, layout, and composition.
  • Create engaging motion and interactive elements, either by producing them directly or providing clear direction to developers.
  • Develop wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity web designs using Figma.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are translated into polished, responsive, and accessible websites.
  • Maintain and improve the brand's web components and visual style across different projects.
  • Work on a variety of projects, from immersive and interactive web experiences to simpler website redesigns and page updates.
  • Communicate design ideas clearly, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality work within project timelines.

Requirements:

  • A personal portfolio website showcasing advanced web design skills. This is mandatory and will be the primary basis for evaluation.
  • Strong creative vision and a distinctive design style that feels modern, expressive, and visually engaging rather than overly corporate.
  • Proven experience designing immersive, interactive, or visually rich web experiences.
  • Strong skills in art direction, typography, layout, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience with motion design or a solid understanding of motion and interaction in web design.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity design.
  • Good understanding of how web designs are developed into responsive and accessible live websites.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver quality work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with developers and brand teams.
  • Availability to collaborate during Pacific Time (PT) business hours. Candidates based in the Pacific Time zone are strongly preferred.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working with technology, SaaS, AI, or brand-focused companies.
  • Previous experience in a creative agency or design studio.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Experience with 3D design, WebGL, or other interactive web technologies.
  • Familiarity with Framer, Webflow, After Effects, or other prototyping and motion design tools.
  • Experience using AI-assisted design tools.
  • Freelance opportunity supporting ongoing web design projects.
  • Weekly working hours and engagement duration will be discussed during the selection process.
  • Work involves a mix of highly creative web experiences, campaign pages, and simpler website redesigns.
  • Candidates should be comfortable working with a small, fast-moving in-house brand team.
  • Pacific Time availability is preferred, with candidates based in the Pacific region strongly prioritized.

Application Requirements:

  1. Submit your proposal through Upwork.
  2. Include a link to your personal portfolio website.
  3. Answer the required screening questions and provide relevant details about your web design experience.

Important: A personal portfolio website is mandatory. The portfolio will be the primary basis for evaluating candidates' creative style, visual design skills, art direction, typography, and motion capabilities. Proposals without a personal portfolio website will not be considered.

An enterprise client is seeking a talented Senior Web Designer to support a leading AI company in creating distinctive, high-quality web experiences.

The selected freelancer will work with a small, fast-moving in-house brand team to develop creative web designs, campaign pages, and digital experiences that reflect a bold and modern visual identity.

jobs.title: Researcher, World Models
jobs.excerpt: About MenloMenlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it.
jobs.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

We are hiring a Researcher to advance the world models at the core of Asimov's ability to perceive, predict, and act. You will work at the intersection of self-supervised representation learning, predictive architectures, and embodied control, in close collaboration with our platform, firmware, and hardware teams.

What You'll Do

  • Design, train, and rigorously evaluate world models that let Asimov predict the consequences of actions across visual, proprioceptive, and force/torque modalities.

  • Advance our self-supervised learning stack for visual and sensor representations, building on and extending the JEPA family (V-JEPA, I-JEPA, and related predictive-embedding approaches).

  • Prototype and benchmark generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs) against JEPA-style objectives for embodied prediction and planning.

  • Own the data pipeline for your experiments end to end: curation, tooling, and scaling, without depending on a separate data-engineering team to move.

  • Integrate what you build with our platform, firmware, and software teams so research reaches the robot, not just the paper.

  • Contribute to sim-to-real transfer, inverse dynamics, and multi-modal sensor fusion, and publish or open-source work where it strengthens the field and the team.

What We Look For

  • Proven modeling track record: you have trained models and can show solid, honest evaluations, not just training curves.

  • JEPA fluency: you understand the joint-embedding predictive approach and can reason about where it fits versus alternatives.

  • Breadth across approaches: familiarity with prior and adjacent work, including VLA (vision-language-action) models, and a view on their trade-offs.

  • Depth in a modality: strong depth in at least one sensory domain (vision, audio, natural language, or similar).

  • Strong data abilities: you get things done without depending on a whole data-engineering team.

  • Solid engineering: you can implement, integrate, and ship what you build alongside platform, firmware, and software teams.

  • Conversant, ideally deep, in several of: SSL for visual and sensor representations; world models (JEPA, V-JEPA, I-JEPA, LeJEPA, MJEPA); generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs); robotics ML (VLA, inverse dynamics, sim-to-real, optical flow); sensor fusion (vision, proprioception, force/torque, multi-modal encoders); PyTorch, JAX, and distributed training.

Nice to Have

  • Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CoRL, or RSS (or arXiv work with comparable citations).

  • PhD or equivalent research experience in ML, robotics, or computer vision. Not required with a strong portfolio.

  • Demonstrated hardware or robotics interest or hands-on experience.

  • Strong communication: technical blogs, talks, or clear written research.

Why Join Menlo

World models are the bet that lets a humanoid generalize instead of memorize. This is a rare seat where your research runs on real hardware in short cycles, your data and modeling choices are yours to own, and your work ships in the open. If you want the distance between an idea and a walking robot to be measured in weeks, this is the room.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
Partner Discovery & Requirements Analysis

  • Lead and document working sessions with clinical, finance, operations, product, and technical stakeholders to understand existing workflows, business rules, data requirements, and operational processes.
  • Translate manual and system-supported workflows into structured business and functional requirements.
  • Produce gap-analysis documentation mapping current-state processes and partner requirements to existing platform capabilities.
  • Classify requirements based on appropriate disposition, such as existing functionality, configuration, new development, acceptable operational workaround, shared platform enhancement, or out of scope.
  • Maintain a consistent backlog structure across implementations so requirements remain comparable, traceable, and reusable.

System Reconciliation & Technical Analysis

  • Analyze application logic, SQL, stored procedures, configuration parameters, integrations, and data flows to understand existing system behavior.
  • Determine whether business requirements can be satisfied through configuration, existing functionality, process changes, or new development.
  • Validate assumptions about platform behavior against available technical evidence and distinguish confirmed system behavior from inferred behavior.
  • Identify discrepancies between documented behavior, stakeholder expectations, system configuration, and implemented logic.
  • Trace business rules to underlying parameters, data elements, calculations, integrations, and system components.
  • Identify where behaviors are configurable versus hardcoded and assess the impact on future implementations.

Requirements Authoring

  • Write clear business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and proposed workarounds.
  • Maintain appropriate separation between business-facing requirements and technical implementation details.
  • Ensure acceptance criteria reflect the agreed solution approach, including configuration changes, operational workarounds, or new functionality.
  • Apply a consistent standard for distinguishing standalone requirements from assumptions, configuration decisions, implementation details, or operational procedures.
  • Maintain traceability from business need through solution decision and development implementation.

Cross-Functional Facilitation & Governance

  • Facilitate requirements, solutioning, and review sessions across business, clinical, product, engineering, data, and operational teams.
  • Drive open questions toward resolution and update requirements and documentation to reflect confirmed decisions.
  • Identify ambiguity, conflicting requirements, downstream impacts, and cross-feature dependencies before development begins.
  • Prevent scope drift and ensure implementation-specific requirements do not unintentionally become platform-wide requirements.
  • Support prioritization and decision-making by clearly communicating business impact, implementation complexity, dependencies, and risk.

Ticket Creation & Scoping

  • Translate approved requirements into development-ready tickets containing problem statements, user stories, functional scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and open questions.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to clarify technical scope and implementation approach.
  • Track dependencies across features, integrations, implementations, and shared platform capabilities.
  • Identify common capabilities that can support multiple clients, workflows, or future implementations rather than creating one-off solutions.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, or equivalent role in a software-, data-, or technology-driven environment.
  • Experience working within healthcare technology, healthcare operations, payer/provider systems, pharmacy, claims, revenue cycle, eligibility, or related healthcare domains.
  • Ability to understand and reason about SQL, data structures, system logic, APIs, configuration, and technical workflows well enough to validate platform behavior and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development tickets that engineering teams can implement with minimal rework.
  • Strong analytical rigor with the ability to distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions, challenge unclear reasoning, and validate conclusions.
  • Experience facilitating requirements and solution-review sessions involving business, clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt business and technical information for different audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with healthcare claims, eligibility, reimbursement, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, or healthcare financial processes.
  • Experience working with configurable or rules-driven healthcare platforms.
  • Experience supporting client, provider, health system, or partner implementations.
  • Understanding of data pipelines, ETL processes, APIs, healthcare integrations, and data exchange concepts.
  • Experience managing a shared product backlog across multiple customers, implementations, or business units.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards, regulatory requirements, or privacy considerations such as HIPAA.

Key Competencies

  • Requirements elicitation and translation
  • Healthcare workflow analysis
  • Technical and data analysis
  • System behavior reconciliation
  • Product and backlog management
  • Stakeholder facilitation and decision-driving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Analytical rigor and structured problem-solving
  • Dependency and impact analysis
  • Documentation discipline and traceability

The Lead AWS Platform Architect will take ownership of platform architecture and implementation across multiple AWS environments, helping guide the evolution toward a secure multi-account federal cloud architecture.

The right candidate is equally comfortable designing cloud architecture and implementing it. You should be able to move from architecture decisions and Terraform modules to EKS operations, GitOps workflows, CI/CD security controls, and production troubleshooting.

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyAjaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Ajaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results. We operate across four core pillars: AI Strategy and Advisory, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Training and Enablement, and Custom Product Development.

In addition to client services, Ajaia builds proprietary AI products, copilots, and vertical solutions that solve high-value industry problems. This dual model allows us to translate hands-on implementation experience into scalable products while continuously refining our approach through real-world deployment.

Our operating model combines deep technical execution with practical change management, enabling enterprises to deploy secure, compliant, and high-impact solutions that drive measurable operational value. From executive roadmapping to production-ready systems and workforce upskilling, Ajaia embeds intelligent tools directly into the workflows that matter most.

Mission: Help organizations win the AI moment.

Position Overview

As a Junior AI Engineer at Ajaia, you will build and ship AI-enabled software across client engagements and internal products, working alongside senior engineers who will review your work and help you grow.

You will take clearly scoped tasks, ask good questions, and deliver working code across web interfaces, backend services, LLM integrations, and AI-driven workflows. Over time, you will take on larger pieces of work with less guidance.

This is an individual contributor role for an early-career engineer who learns fast, cares about quality, and wants real production experience in applied AI.

Every role at Ajaia is AI-forward. We expect engineers to use AI tools in daily workflows across research, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. AI usage is a core execution capability, not optional tooling.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Build and fix frontend and backend features for AI-enabled applications, under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Help integrate large language model APIs, prompts, and simple AI workflows into products.
  • Write clean, tested code and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
  • Work with APIs, databases, and cloud deployments on well-defined tasks.
  • Use AI tools daily for coding support, debugging, research, test generation, and documentation.
  • Ask clarifying questions early and raise blockers quickly.
  • Keep documentation, tickets, and status updates current.
  • Learn the team's engineering patterns and apply them consistently.

Requirements

  • 0–2 years of professional experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects (internships, freelance, open source, or personal projects count).
  • Working knowledge of a modern frontend framework (such as React or Next.js) and a backend language (such as Python or Node.js).
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, SQL databases, and authentication.
  • Some hands-on experience calling a large language model API (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini) in a project.
  • Comfortable with Git and GitHub for daily collaboration.
  • Clear written and spoken English with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Active daily use of AI tools for coding, debugging, and learning.
  • Ability to check AI-generated code for correctness instead of accepting it as is.
  • Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and improve quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A project that uses retrieval (RAG), embeddings, or a simple AI agent.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL.

Schedule and Location

  • This is a fully remote role within approved hiring locations, subject to Ajaia hiring and compliance requirements.
  • Working schedule follows Eastern Time hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, including holidays.

Technical Requirements

  • Reliable wired internet connection with at least 100 Mbps speed.
  • Computer or laptop with Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5 processor or higher.
  • Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 128 GB available storage.
  • Dual-monitor setup preferred.
  • Windows 10 or macOS (latest version).
  • 1080p webcam and working microphone.
  • Backup solutions for power and internet interruptions.

Benefits

  • Compensation: USD 10,000 per year base salary + Performance Bonus
  • Remote work with earned flexibility.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Paid time off.

Why Join Ajaia

You will start your career building real AI products that reach production, with senior engineers who will review your work and help you grow fast. You will see both client delivery and internal product work, and build the range that strong AI engineers need.

The environment rewards ownership, speed, and clarity rather than bureaucracy.

Experience the Ajaia difference. Let's build what's next.

Were seeking a detail-oriented Medical Billing Specialist to support the revenue cycle operations of a U.S.-based healthcare client. This role is primarily focused on reducing claim denials and recovering aging or stale claims. You'll be working directly in the clients billing system, managing claim queues, and communicating with payers to ensure timely and accurate reimbursement.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience in medical billing or claims follow-up who thrives in a fast-paced, process-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Log into the clients billing system to review and manage denied or aging claims
  • Work claim queues to identify root causes of denials and submit appropriate documentation or corrections
  • Make outbound phone calls to insurance payers to check claim statuses, appeal denials, and resolve payment issues
  • Escalate recurring denial trends or system/process bottlenecks to the clients RCM lead
  • Maintain accurate and detailed notes of all payer interactions and claim activities
  • Assist with additional RCM workflows as needed to support clean and efficient revenue operations

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in medical billing, revenue cycle management, or claims follow-up
  • Familiarity with payer portals and billing systems (e.g., Kareo, Athena, AdvancedMD, etc.)
  • High attention to detail and ability to work independently on repetitive or process-heavy tasks
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Comfortable speaking with payers over the phone and navigating insurance systems

Nice to Have

  • Experience with denial management and recovery of aged claims
  • Previous work with U.S.-based healthcare providers
  • Background in a remote RCM role

jobs.description:
Work Setup: Remote, Mexico-aligned working hours
Contract End Date / Length: 30 November 2026 (expected to be extended)
Rate: £623–£674
Languages: English; Spanish preferred

Our client is looking for a Mainframe Datacom Engineer to provide hands-on BAU support and technical ownership of an existing CA Datacom environment on IBM z/OS. The role runs alongside a wider modernisation programme and focuses on maintaining and supporting the current Datacom estate, rather than production monitoring or a Datacom-to-DB2 migration.

What you will do:

  • Administer and maintain Broadcom Datacom databases on z/OS.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve Datacom database issues independently.
  • Carry out backup, restore and recovery, and database administration and structuring.
  • Diagnose and resolve database and query performance issues.
  • Perform and support Datacom fixes, patching, patch validation and maintenance.
  • Provide Datacom technical consultancy and support to applications and users.
  • Carry out root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
  • Take ownership of BAU Datacom activities transferred from the existing team.
  • Work with application, operations and infrastructure teams to maintain service stability.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong hands-on Broadcom Datacom or CA Datacom DBA experience.
  • A proven ability to diagnose and fix Datacom issues, not only monitor and escalate them.
  • Strong experience in backup and recovery, database administration, restoration and performance or query tuning.
  • Hands-on Datacom patching, maintenance and system programming experience.
  • Strong IBM z/OS and JCL knowledge.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale production Datacom environments.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal training or supervision.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analysis and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work Mexico-aligned hours.

Preferred:

  • Spanish language capability, particularly for working with Spanish-speaking users and team members.
  • CICS, COBOL and wider mainframe application knowledge.
  • Banking or financial services experience.
  • Db2 knowledge (advantageous, not required).
  • Experience in regulated enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on Broadcom or CA Datacom DBA experience.
  • Strong IBM z/OS and JCL knowledge.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale production Datacom environments.
  • English fluency, with Spanish preferred.

jobs.excerpt: Votre rôleEn tant que Senior Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultant.
jobs.description:
Votre rôle

En tant que Senior Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultant.e.s. Vous piloterez opérationnellement les missions, participerez activement au développement commercial, au marketing de l’offre et au développement de l’expertise au sein du cabinet.

Vous intervenez comme directeur de projet auprès de directions immobilières, directions des environnements de travail et directions des systèmes d’information dans la définition de leur stratégie Smart Building et dans la transformation numérique de leurs bâtiments, depuis l’expression des besoins jusqu’au déploiement des solutions et à leur adoption par les utilisateurs.

Vos principales responsabilités

1.Développement commercial et management

  • Encadrer, accompagner et faire progresser des consultants.
  • Réalisation des rendez-vous d’avant-vente et aux phases de qualification.
  • Pilotage de la rédaction des propositions commerciales et des réponses aux appels d’offres.
  • Structurer les démarches, charges, livrables et dispositifs d’intervention.
  • Présenter les propositions aux clients et défendre les choix méthodologiques.
  • Développer des offres, méthodes, référentiels et convictions autour du Smart Building.
  • Participer à la veille technologique, réglementaire et concurrentielle.

2.Pilotage de mission de conseil et cadrage stratégique

  • Analyser les enjeux usagers, immobiliers, énergétiques, environnementaux, numériques et organisationnels des clients.
  • Construire une vision cible du bâtiment intelligent adaptée à leurs priorités et à leur patrimoine.
  • Réaliser des diagnostics de maturité Smart Building et Digital Workplace.
  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les cas d’usage à valeur :
    • performance énergétique ;
    • optimisation de l’occupation et des espaces ;
    • confort et qualité des environnements intérieurs ;
    • maintenance prédictive ;
    • expérience collaborateur ;
    • services aux occupants ;
    • sûreté et sécurité ;
    • pilotage multisite du patrimoine.
  • Élaborer des feuilles de route, scénarios de transformation et modèles de gouvernance.
  • Contribuer à la construction des trajectoires d'ambition digitales.

3.Pilotage de conception fonctionnelle et architecture Smart Building

  • Recueillir les besoins des directions métiers, immobilières, techniques et informatiques.
  • Formaliser les cas d’usage, parcours utilisateurs et exigences fonctionnelles.
  • Participer à la définition des architectures fonctionnelles et applicatives.
  • Définir les principes d’articulation entre :
    • équipements et systèmes du bâtiment ;
    • GTB/GTC ;
    • IoT et capteurs ;
    • réseaux et connectivité ;
    • Building Operating System ou plateforme de services ;
    • BIM et BIM GEM ;
    • systèmes d’information immobiliers ;
    • outils Workplace ;
    • plateformes de données ;
    • applications destinées aux occupants.

4.Pilotage de prestation d’assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage et pilotage de projets

  • Accompagner les clients dans la rédaction de programmes fonctionnels et de cahiers des charges.
  • Participer à la consultation et à la sélection de fournisseurs, intégrateurs et éditeurs.
  • Analyser les réponses techniques et fonctionnelles.
  • Assurer la coordination entre les différents acteurs du projet :
  • Piloter les risques, dépendances, arbitrages et plans d’action.
  • Préparer et animer les instances de gouvernance.
  • Suivre la réalisation des pilotes, démonstrateurs et déploiements.
  • Préparer les phases de recette fonctionnelle et de mise en service.
  • Vérifier l’alignement des solutions déployées avec les usages et la vision initiale.

5. Pilotage de mission de conduite du changement

  • Comprendre les attentes des occupants, exploitants et gestionnaires.
  • Concevoir des parcours de services simples et cohérents.
  • Animer des ateliers de design de services ou de co-construction.
  • Participer à la définition des modalités d’adoption des nouveaux services numériques.
  • Accompagner les équipes clientes dans l’évolution de leurs pratiques.
  • Mesurer l’usage, la satisfaction et la valeur créée après le déploiement.

Votre profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure Bac+5, école d’ingénieurs, école de commerce, université ou formation spécialisée en immobilier, bâtiment, numérique ou systèmes d’information.
  • Expérience professionnelle de 10 ans minimum, acquise dans le conseil, l’immobilier, l’ingénierie, l’intégration de solutions ou la transformation digitale.
  • Expérience significative sur des projets Smart Building, Smart Workplace, immobilier numérique, IoT, performance énergétique ou exploitation technique.
  • Expérience de pilotage de missions, de lots ou de projets complexes impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.
  • Une expérience en management en cabinet de conseil constitue un atout important.

Vos qualités

  • Forte capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
  • Aptitude à comprendre et à articuler des enjeux métiers, immobiliers et technologiques.
  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et relationnelles.
  • Capacité à animer des ateliers et à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction.
  • Pédagogie et capacité à rendre accessibles des sujets techniques complexes.
  • Autonomie dans la conduite des missions.
  • Esprit de conseil et orientation client.
  • Goût du travail collectif et des environnements pluridisciplinaires.
  • Capacité à structurer et sécuriser des projets complexes.
  • Curiosité pour les innovations, les usages et les évolutions du marché.
  • Capacité à encadrer et faire progresser des consultants

Entité

L'ambition d'Orange Business est de devenir l'intégrateur réseaux et numérique de référence en Europe, en nous appuyant sur nos forces autour des solutions de connectivité nouvelle génération, du cloud et de la cybersécurité.

Nos 30 000 femmes et hommes présents dans 65 pays, dont chaque voix compte, sont tous animés par la même détermination et le même esprit d'équipe, pour construire les solutions digitales d'aujourd'hui et de demain et créer un impact positif pour nos clients, pour leurs salariés et pour la planète.

Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes grâce à des projets innovants dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l'IA, la cybersécurité, l'IoT, ou encore le digital workspace et le big data.

Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous !

Travailler chez Orange Consulting, c'est rejoindre un cabinet à taille humaine qui offre à ses collaborateurs des perspectives d'évolution claires et accessibles à travers des parcours de formations spécialement conçus par et pour nos consultants.

La direction Orange Consulting accompagne les entreprises et les institutions en France et à l'international sur leurs problématiques de transformation digitale et leurs enjeux métiers.

About Us

AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world’s leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.

AfterShip unifies shipping & labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post-purchase touchpoint.

AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400 carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.

Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.

Your Mission:

Our marketing team ships at a high cadence across paid, email, events, organic social, and web. In 2026 we built the strategic creative direction. In 2027 we need production horsepower—designers who turn that direction into volume, fast, using AI as leverage. The ideal candidate is a builder first and foremost, not an abstract strategist. This role reports to AfterShip’s Manager of Creative.

What You’ll Do:

  • Performance marketing ad creative (static + simple motion) for paid channels.
  • UI snippets that showcase our product benefits, used across channels.
  • Demand gen campaign creative including campaign identity + asset development.
  • Web asset development + templated wireframes leveraging our core design system.
  • Other assets as needed: organic social assets, email marketing assets, IRL event graphics.
  • Contributing to the build out of AI-native production workflows — pushing Claude Design, Midjourney, Runway, Figma AI, and whatever’s next to the limit.

Who We're Looking For:

  • Taste: Your portfolio shows you know what great B2B tech marketing design looks like.
  • AI as a reflex: You build your own agents and default to AI-native production methods every day — not as a demo you rolled out once. You are deeply curious and constantly seek out new ways to get leverage out of AI tooling.
  • Hustle: You ship fast. You care about getting to prod. You see the value in creative testing and iteration vs. aiming for polished perfection.
  • Design chops: Strong graphic design + fluency in simple motion design. Figma is your home.
  • Extreme ownership: When a project is assigned to you, you own it from beginning to end. You clear blockers and problem solve as needed to deliver on the assignment.
  • Opinionated: You always bring a POV to your work, and can articulate the rationale behind the creative choices you make.

At AfterShip, we know great talent doesn’t always fit every requirement. If you’re passionate about our mission and believe you can make an impact, we encourage you to apply.

Why You Should Join Us:

  • Great Place to Work Certified: We’ve been recognized for our inclusive, values-driven culture that celebrates diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovative & Inclusive Culture: Started by our software engineer-turned-CEO, AfterShip is built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. We’re a passionate, global team of problem solvers who put egos aside to innovate together. We take immense pride in fostering a culture that’s inclusive, which has allowed us to surround ourselves with the industry's most talented professionals.
  • Ambitious Mission with Real Impact: Join us in transforming eCommerce by making buying and selling easier for everyone. It’s one of the most dynamic spaces in tech, with limitless opportunities to innovate and grow.
  • Thrive & Grow: There’s no ceiling to what you can achieve or learn here. We’re committed to empowering your career while advancing together as a company.
  • Flexible Work Setup: We’re a remote-first team, meaning by default that employees work from home or on a hybrid-flexible basis in our hub locations. You’re empowered to choose a work setup that works best for you and your team. With flexible hours depending on your time zone, you’ll be able to have a schedule that fits your working style and the requirements of your role.

Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Hybrid-flexible work setups
  • Healthcare coverage offered from day 1
  • Retirement plans including company match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Annual learning & wellness benefit
  • Monthly book perk
  • Career progression & professional development
  • In-office lunch and commuter benefits for those located in our hub locations

Salary range for this role: CAD$65,000 - $125,000

We are an equal opportunity employer and provide accommodations upon request throughout the recruitment process, in accordance with local legislation. Please let us know if you require any support, and we’ll work with you to meet your needs.

We believe in hiring right over hiring fast. While timelines may vary, we’re looking to fill this role as soon as possible.

Our hiring process uses AI to help with initial resume screening and to support interview note-taking. These tools help our team stay organized and fair, but all hiring decisions are made by people.

jobs.excerpt: Hi,We are Monterail - ~ 130 experts working together to create meaningful software.
jobs.description:
Hi,

We are Monterail - ~ 130 experts working together to create meaningful software.
As a software agency, we collaborate with multiple clients, so as a Junior Project Manager, you will most likely run a few projects simultaneously.
We specialise in 4 main industries Fintech, MedTech, HRtech & E-commerce.

We are opening a Junior Project Manager opportunity with a specific twist: at least half of your projects will be AI-augmented.

What does that mean? In some of our projects we use AI tools like Claude, Claude Code connected to our repos to handle the work that used to take hours: drafting tickets, summarising calls, surfacing risks in git history.

We are looking for someone who is excited to utilise AI in their projects but also work in traditional set-up of projects.

Requirements

Project work - what will you do?

  • collaborate on building web and mobile applications from prototyping through delivery
  • coordinate a project team of Backend, Front-End or Mobile Developers, supported by QA Specialists and Designers
  • organize project workflows and facilitate regular meetings - stand-ups, sprint plannings, retros
  • act as a project advisor, balancing the client's roadmap and communication with our internal possibilities
  • set the project flow using different tools and methods
  • work with client budget sheets and gradually work alongside senior PMs on schedule and delivery for the projects you’re engaged on
  • monitor risks and actively look for inefficiencies
  • challenge your project team and client to balance product quality with work efficiency
  • collaborate closely with a Tech Lead to tackle technological complexity and prioritise the backlog

AI- augmented work - what will you do?

  • use Claude (and similar tools) to draft Jira tickets, refinement summaries, decision logs and client updates
  • turn long call transcripts into structured decisions, action items and follow-ups without losing nuance
  • spot when AI output is wrong, vague or hallucinated, and rewrite it
  • maintain memory files for each project so context doesn't live only in your head

jobs.title: Senior AWS DevSecOps / Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Our client is seeking a remote Senior AWS DevSecOps / Platform Engineer to help build, secure, and operate a mission-critical cloud platform supporting high-availability scientific and operational workloads.
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a remote Senior AWS DevSecOps / Platform Engineer to help build, secure, and operate a mission-critical cloud platform supporting high-availability scientific and operational workloads.

This is a remote position for a senior, hands-on engineer who is comfortable owning production AWS infrastructure from Infrastructure as Code through deployment, validation, monitoring, and ongoing operations.

The environment is built around AWS, Amazon EKS, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, and GitOps, with a strong emphasis on automation, security, reliability, and federal compliance. Infrastructure changes are managed through code and automated pipelines rather than manual configuration.

The ideal candidate has deep hands-on experience with Terraform and AWS, has operated Kubernetes/EKS in production, and understands how to build secure delivery pipelines that can withstand both operational scrutiny and formal security reviews.

This is an opportunity to join a small, experienced engineering team where senior engineers have meaningful ownership and influence over platform architecture, security, automation, and engineering standards.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, maintain, and improve production AWS infrastructure across multiple environments.

  • Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules and Infrastructure as Code used to provision and manage cloud infrastructure.

  • Manage Terraform remote state and safely reconcile differences between deployed infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Operate and maintain production Amazon EKS environments, including cluster networking, autoscaling, add-ons, upgrades, workload identity, ingress, and load balancing.

  • Design and support Kubernetes workloads using Helm and modern container orchestration practices.

  • Build and maintain GitOps-based deployment workflows using Argo CD, Flux, or comparable technologies.

  • Develop and harden GitLab CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure and application delivery.

  • Integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, Infrastructure as Code scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, policy enforcement, and artifact validation.

  • Implement policy-as-code technologies such as OPA, Conftest, or comparable tools.

  • Support container supply-chain security, including image scanning, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), image signing, and deployment validation.

  • Design and maintain secure AWS identity and access patterns using IAM and workload identity technologies such as IRSA or EKS Pod Identity.

  • Design and support AWS networking, including VPCs, routing, load balancing, security boundaries, and cross-account connectivity.

  • Work with AWS services including EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, and related cloud technologies.

  • Support the development and evolution of multi-account AWS environments and federal landing-zone architectures.

  • Implement least-privilege access, network isolation, continuous monitoring, security controls, and other cloud-hardening practices.

  • Support federal cybersecurity requirements including NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, RMF, and Authority to Operate activities.

  • Develop and maintain technical evidence and documentation supporting security controls and compliance reviews.

  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability using technologies such as Amazon CloudWatch, Grafana, or comparable platforms.

  • Troubleshoot complex AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, networking, pipeline, security, and production infrastructure issues.

  • Mentor other engineers and help establish strong engineering practices around code review, change management, automation, testing, and technical documentation.

  • Collaborate with application developers, security teams, architects, and other technical stakeholders to deliver secure and reliable production services.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, or a related discipline, including senior-level ownership of production environments.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, infrastructure lifecycle management, and remediation of configuration drift.

  • Strong hands-on AWS engineering experience supporting production workloads.

  • Experience with AWS networking, IAM, EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, and related cloud services.

  • Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes and Amazon EKS in production, not simply deploying applications to an existing cluster.

  • Experience with Kubernetes networking, autoscaling, workload identity, Helm, ingress, load balancing, and cluster lifecycle management.

  • Hands-on experience implementing GitOps using Argo CD, Flux, or a comparable platform.

  • Experience engineering CI/CD pipelines, with GitLab CI/CD strongly preferred.

  • Experience implementing DevSecOps controls such as SAST, container scanning, Infrastructure as Code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code.

  • Strong experience with Git-based development and infrastructure workflows, including merge requests, peer review, and controlled production changes.

  • Experience supporting secure, highly available cloud infrastructure.

  • Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks such as FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and RMF, including familiarity with requirements supporting an Authority to Operate.

  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

  • Ability to mentor engineers and provide senior technical leadership.

  • U.S. Person with the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating multi-account AWS environments, AWS Organizations, Control Tower, or federal cloud landing zones.

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or FedRAMP environments.

  • Experience implementing container supply-chain security, including SBOMs, image signing, admission controls, or AWS Signer.

  • Experience with CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, or comparable observability technologies.

  • Experience with Docker and secure container build practices.

  • Experience with serverless AWS technologies such as Lambda.

  • Experience with real-time or event-driven data-processing architectures.

  • AWS certification such as Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Developer.

  • Experience supporting scientific, environmental, geospatial, weather, or other data-intensive mission systems.

  • Familiarity with scientific data formats such as NetCDF or GRIB.

Work Environment

  • This position is remote.

  • No routine on-site requirement is expected.

Security / Eligibility Requirements

  • U.S. Person.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.

  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.

  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.

  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.

  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.

Preferred Experience

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

jobs.title: Strategic Planning Consultant
jobs.excerpt: The Lawyering Project is excited to launch our search for an experienced strategic planning partner to facilitate the development of our 2028-2033 strategic plan.
jobs.description:
The Lawyering Project is excited to launch our search for an experienced strategic planning partner to facilitate the development of our 2028-2033 strategic plan. This engagement will take place during February – July 2027 and the consultant will report to the Lawyering Project’s Executive Team.

Organizational Background

Founded in 2017, the Lawyering Project is a legal advocacy organization that blends traditional impact litigation with movement lawyering to promote reproductive health, rights, and justice throughout the United States. We have an all-remote staff that includes 24 full-time employees spread across the United States.

Laws that undermine reproductive health, rights, and justice deprive people of moral agency, rob us of control over our bodies, and compound other forms of oppression like racism, sexism, and poverty. Our mission is to eliminate these laws and the harmful impacts they have on people’s lives. We are especially focused on laws that limit the availability or affordability of abortion care; contribute to disparities in reproductive health outcomes; embody gender-based stereotypes; or discriminate against people based on their reproductive decisions.

We envision a society with laws that enable each of us to make decisions about intensely personal matters like sex, pregnancy, family, and healthcare based on our own beliefs and values, and ensure that we all have access to safe pregnancy care, safe abortion care, and safe communities for our families.

More information about the Lawyering Project is available on our website.

Project Background

Since its inception nearly a decade ago, the Lawyering Project has undergone significant growth in its staff size, programming, and overall organizational capacity, all while operating in a volatile political and legal landscape. We understand that, to realize our long-term vision for reproductive health, rights, and justice, we must continually assess our organizational strategy and impact. Energized by the organization’s growth, the exciting work being done by our clients and partners, and the growing need for legal services by those seeking, providing, and supporting abortion care, we are embarking on a strategic planning process to coincide with our tenth anniversary. Our goal for this process is to bring our creative, partner-driven approach to lawyering to bear on the challenges facing the repro movement nearly five years after the fall of Roe.

Project Scope of Work

  1. Design a process for the development of a five-year strategic plan that includes the following:
    • Robustly engaging with the Lawyering Project’s Board of Directors and staff;
    • Gathering input from key external stakeholders including clients, partners, and funders;
    • Evaluating the impact of the Lawyering Project’s current programs;
    • Assessing the strengths and weaknesses of the Lawyering Project's current operations; and
    • Providing the Lawyering Project’s Executive Team with periodic opportunities to review progress and offer feedback.
  2. Guide the Lawyering Project through the strategic planning process, taking the lead on meeting facilitation and data collection.
  3. Use the information and insights gathered to create a five-year strategic plan.
  4. Assist the Executive Team in creating metrics to assess progress under the strategic plan.

Requirements

Desired Consultant Expertise and Qualifications

  • Proven expertise in strategic planning for nonprofit organizations. Experience working with legal advocacy organizations is a plus.
  • Proven knowledge of the U.S. reproductive health, rights, and justice movement.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate group discussions and build alignment among stakeholders with differing perspectives.
  • Strong project management skills, especially the ability to complete deliverables on time and according to specifications.
  • Demonstrated commitment to JEDI (Justice, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion) and social justice.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills and readiness to work with a group of committed, talented, and enthusiastic individuals.

Budget

We are seeking bids of up to $40,000 for the entire project.

Submission Requirements

To apply, please submit the following materials by December 18, 2026:

  • A concise proposal detailing your approach to the project
  • An updated CV or resume
  • At least two client references from strategic planning projects
  • Any additional supporting materials that you would like us to consider

Our goal is to engage a consultant by January 31, 2027, and begin work on the project in early February.

The more you sell, the more you earn.

What matters is proven sales experience.

  • Know how to handle objections and negotiate

We're looking for a closer.

Someone who knows how to manage a pipeline, handle a high volume of demos, create value, overcome objections and take a deal all the way to signature.

If you've already proven that you can sell and you're looking for an environment where your performance has a direct impact on your earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

Because Poland is just getting started.

We're launching this market now, which means you'll be joining at a stage where there is a lot to build and a lot of opportunity to capture.

For ambitious sales professionals, this is a chance to get in early, establish yourself in a new market and grow together with the business.

If you want to be one of the people helping build RealAdvisor's presence in Poland from the ground up, this is the moment to join.

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

jobs.description:
YOUR MISSION

Nulogy is seeking an energetic, coachable, and curious individual to join our growing marketing team as a Business Development Representative. This role provides an exciting entry point into the world of sales and marketing within a leading software company. You'll gain hands-on experience in identifying potential leads, initiating early-stage outreach, and contributing to the success of demand generation campaigns. This position is ideal for someone early in their career who is eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support outbound outreach efforts through email, phone, and social media to identify and engage potential prospects.
  • Assist in researching target accounts, industry trends, and key decision-makers.
    Help qualify inbound leads from web inquiries, events, and campaigns.
  • Work with the BDR to prepare outreach materials and follow-up messages.
  • Support logistics and follow-ups for virtual and in-person events.
  • Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions and lead status in Salesforce.
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales to refine messaging and lead generation strategies.

EXPERIENCE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • 0–1 years of experience in a sales, marketing, or customer-facing role (internship or part-time experience welcome).
  • Familiarity with or interest in CRM and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated, with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
  • Interest in the SaaS, tech, supply chain, or logistics industries.
  • Comfortable making phone calls and engaging with new people.
  • Team-oriented and open to feedback.
  • Ability to multitask and manage time efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Nulogy is a manufacturing technology company driven by a vision to make life better for the people who plan, produce, and deliver the products we use every day.
Nulogy’s Manufacturing Operating System helps manufacturers and packagers automate every stage of the production process—from inventory to quality—which reduces operating costs, increases efficiency, and boosts customer satisfaction. Hundreds of manufacturing sites around the world are powered by Nulogy, and our software also runs in the networks of world-leading brands such as Colgate-Palmolive, L’Oréal, and Procter & Gamble.

Nulogy has grown rapidly over the last decade, and we are proud to be recognized with a number of awards including: Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers, Food Logistics Top 100 Software Provider, and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Culture. Nulogy has also received multiple awards for company culture, the most recent being one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for 2024, Great Place to Work 2025 & Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2025.

By joining Nulogy, you’ll become part of a fantastic culture of capable and motivated individuals. You’ll also join a team that is solving challenging problems every day with the potential to make a global impact.

OUR VALUES
1. We put people first
We lead with genuine care, build strong relationships, and create space for people to grow.
2. We rewrite the playbook
We don’t wait for perfect conditions. We move, deliver, and refine, solving problems creatively as we go.
3. We learn up
We stay curious, learn from the people and experiences around us, and keep looking ahead.
4. We take the hot potato!
When something goes wrong, we don’t pass the problem along. We take ownership and work together to solve it.
5. We ring the bell together
We celebrate success as a team and recognize the people who helped make it happen.

WHY NULOGY
We’re solving problems that no one has been able to solve before. This is an opportunity to join a team that is transforming the way that supply chains are structured.

Competitive benefits package: Group benefit plans including health, dental, and vision that start on day one—benefit premiums are fully paid by the employer; Parental leave: 100% top-up for 15 weeks for any parent of biological or adopted children; Flexible paid vacation policy; RRSP Matching Program, 401K program.


FULLY REMOTE
Everyone is set up with the tools and resources required to stay connected and help employees do their best work.

Nulogy embraces diversity, and we recognize the need for teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We encourage everyone to apply.

jobs.excerpt: Teach English Online!  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing • Long-term employment only!
jobs.description:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

jobs.description:
Description

About Sygnia

Sygnia is a premier cyber technology and services company providing high-impact incident response, cyber resilience consulting, and threat hunting for leading organizations across the globe. Trusted by Fortune 100 companies and government entities alike, Sygnia draws its strength from a team of elite professionals with backgrounds in military-grade cyber operations and the global cybersecurity industry.

Sygnia is rapidly expanding its presence in the United States, growing our incident response capabilities and client base across key industries. Joining now means playing a formative role in shaping our U.S. operations while benefiting from the backing and expertise of an established global leader.

The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Incident Response Expert to join our elite global team. In this role, you will lead and participate in complex forensic investigations and incident response engagements involving sophisticated cyberattacks, ransomware events, and nation-state activity. Your expertise will play a critical role in helping Sygnia’s clients understand, contain, and recover from cyber incidents while preserving business continuity and mitigating risk.

What You’ll Do

  • Work with a team to conduct end-to-end forensic investigations, including log analysis, host and network forensics, malware triage, and memory analysis.
  • Support response efforts for major cybersecurity incidents, collaborating closely with internal and external security and IT teams.
  • Perform threat hunting activities in client environments to detect and eliminate advanced persistent threats.
  • Identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) using frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Analyze a wide variety of data sources (endpoint, network, SIEM, etc.) to build a clear picture of the attacker’s actions and impact.
  • Leverage and contribute to Sygnia’s internal investigation tools, playbooks, and threat intelligence platforms.
  • Communicate investigation results effectively to both technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Develop and present high-quality technical reports, timelines, and strategic recommendations to clients.
  • Support the continuous improvement of internal methodologies, tooling, and knowledge sharing within the team.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in incident response, digital forensics, threat hunting, or cyber investigations—whether from the private sector, military, or government.
  • Deep technical understanding of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS), file systems, registry and memory structures, and log analysis.
  • Proficiency in network fundamentals and common protocols (DNS, HTTP/S, SMB, etc.) and network traffic analysis (e.g., PCAP review).
  • Experience with tools such as EnCase, X-Ways, FTK, Velociraptor, Splunk, or Wireshark, and EDR platforms like CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Microsoft Defender.
  • Competency in scripting or automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to support investigations.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and related forensic techniques is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly convey complex technical topics to diverse audiences.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure in time-sensitive environments.
  • Willingness to travel.

Bonus Points For

  • Industry-recognized certifications (e.g., GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, GCIA, GREM, CISSP).
  • Experience responding to ransomware, business email compromise (BEC), and advanced threat actor incidents.
  • Experience presenting findings to legal counsel, regulators, or board-level stakeholders.
  • Multilingual skills and experience in multinational or cross-cultural environments.
