Description

Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection. At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth.

We are looking for a Security Engineer to join our MDR team as the founding Australia member of the Security organization. In this role, you will be part of our security function, focusing on proactive reviews and providing advanced guidance to customers, while independently owning AUS hours coverage. This is an opportunity to bring deep cloud security expertise to a fast-growing team, working closely with analysts, researchers, and engineers — with a clear path toward technical or team leadership as the AUS presence scales.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in fine-tuning Upwind's detection and response mechanisms.
  • Support proactive reviews of customer environments to identify risks, exposed attack surfaces, and recommend improvements.
  • Lead and conduct in-depth security investigations — including supply chain, API, malware, and runtime attack scenarios — documenting outcomes and developing playbooks to enhance future detection and response.
  • Collaborate with Security Analysts, Research, and Backend teams to enhance detection quality.
  • Own the handling of complex or critical incidents escalated from Tier 1/2, including live, high-pressure engagements with customers.
  • Participate in recurring customer meetings, helping translate security findings into clear, actionable recommendations — and maintain composure when conversations get tense.
  • Stay up to date with emerging threats, attack techniques, attack surfaces, and best practices in cloud security.
  • Contribute to the development and training of AI-driven detection models, leveraging machine learning to improve investigation accuracy and response efficiency.

Requirements

  • This role includes participating in a shared on-call rotation. While escalations are infrequent, team members are expected to be available for nights, weekends, or holidays during their rotation week.
  • Solid, hands-on experience in cybersecurity, ideally from a leading cloud or cloud security company, with real-world exposure to cloud environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of detection engineering, incident response, and threat analysis, with the ability to explain attack techniques (supply chain, API, malware, runtime) in depth.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container technologies (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Comfortable and hands-on with Linux; Windows knowledge is a plus.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals and scripting (Python/Bash).
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to engage directly with customers — including staying composed under pressure or pushback.
  • Self-directed and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment.
  • Curiosity, problem-solving mindset, and a genuine personal interest in security beyond the day job.
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science / Information Security — an advantage.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areWe’re Ethena, an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space.
jobs.description:
Who we are

We’re Ethena, an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our team of agents helps Compliance leaders run proactive Compliance programs that drive meaningful behavior change.

From Policies and Disclosures to Training, Hotline, and Analytics, our agents work together to drive smarter, faster, human-led decision-making. Hotline and training data rolls up into fully customizable, board-ready risk reports. Phishing clicks trigger bite-sized, targeted follow-up courses that drive behavior change without taking up a ton of training time. Our AI call taker synthesizes data to recommend improvements to company policies and training. Every signal lands in one place, so Compliance leaders can spot risk early and fix it before it becomes a problem. The agents do the legwork, and people make every judgment call.

More than 2,000 organizations, from Pinterest and Zendesk to the Salvation Army, run their programs on Ethena. That covers millions of employees, from the warehouse floor to the trading desk. Our learning paths drop seat time by 60%, learners give our training a 93% approval rating, and 96% of customers renew.

Lots of companies call themselves AI-forward. We’ve actually built the tools to prove it. Come help us build what’s next.

How we work

We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy — for customers and each other. We're passionate about the work we do, love feedback, and lead with high agency and accountability. When we see something that could be better, we step up to the plate and do something about it. We take our work seriously, but are careful not to take ourselves too seriously. Because doing great work should be fun.
Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.

Who we're looking for

Ethena is growing fast, and we need a finance leader who’s excited to build what comes next. As our Head of Finance, you’ll own the full finance function, from accounting and close to forecasting, planning, and board reporting. You’ll report to our COO and work closely with her to give our leadership team the data and insight behind our biggest decisions. You’ll also give every department head a clear line of sight into their budget. We’re looking for someone with a real point of view. You’ll spot the risks and opportunities in the numbers before anyone asks and turn complex data into clear and actionable takeaways. You’ll be hands-on in the details one day and zoomed out on strategy the next. Along the way, you’ll build a high-performing finance team that holds itself to a high bar.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with the COO to drive smart decisions. You’ll keep leadership equipped with a clear, current view of financials, forecasts, and runway. You’ll also pull together and synthesize the data behind our biggest calls. You’ll flag risks and opportunities early, lay out the levers we can pull, and bring a recommendation on things like a smarter way to deploy spend or a cost that’s growing faster than its value. Then you’ll turn it into takeaways the exec team can act on.
  • Partner with RevOps on revenue and comp plans. You’ll work with our Head of RevOps to turn pipeline and attainment data into financial insight on unit economics, retention, and sales efficiency. You’ll oversee commission and comp plans.
  • Give every department head line of sight. You’ll work with each leader so they always know where their budget stands, what’s changed, and what tradeoffs they’re facing.
  • Own planning and forecasting. That covers the annual plan, quarterly reforecasts, the operating model, the cash forecast, and scenario planning for pricing, hiring, and growth.
  • Oversee accounting end to end. You’ll oversee month-end and year-end close, AR/AP, revenue recognition, and tax, and build a faster, cleaner close as we scale.
  • Lead the audit and keep us compliant. You’ll own the annual audit and keep us current on tax and regulatory requirements everywhere we operate.
  • Manage investor and lender relationships. You’ll own board and investor reporting, manage our banking and lending partners, and lead fundraising work from model to data room.
  • Level up the finance function. You’ll grow and lead the team, decide what to bring in-house versus outsource, and use AI and automation to keep a lean team operating well above its size.

What makes a great candidate

  • You cut your teeth in FP&A and have since overseen every part of finance, including accounting, at early stage and fast-growing SaaS companies.
  • You’ve built and led a finance team, and you’ve been the person accountable for the numbers, not just a contributor to them.
  • You’ve run an audit, supported a fundraise, and presented directly to a board.
  • You’re as comfortable reconciling an account as you are presenting a growth plan to the board.
  • You have a strong point of view and share it. You come with a recommendation and the math behind it, and you change your mind when the data says you should.
  • You can make finance make sense to anyone, from a first-time manager to a board member.
  • You’re highly autonomous and do your best work when you’re trusted to run your function.
  • You care about building a team with a culture of excellence, and you know how to hire, coach, and raise the bar.
  • You’re AI-native. You already use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to automate work, build models, and get to insights faster, and you’d rather build a tool than hire for a task.
  • You thrive on a fully distributed team, and move fast without losing rigor.
At Ethena, we're committed to fair and equitable compensation. We carefully evaluate each candidate's skills and qualifications to provide our best possible offer upfront. Our no-negotiation policy ensures that our first offer is always our best offer, promoting pay equity throughout our organization.

Physical Demands

This is sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing in a home office environment.

Location

Ethena is a remote-first organization and is currently hiring candidates based in the United States.
We are not currently offering employer visa sponsorship for this role.

AI Usage in Interviews:

We’re big fans of AI and use it heavily in our day-to-day work. That said, to ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, we’re happy to chat — just let us know.

Benefits

The benefits offered for this position can be found here. We provide unlimited PTO.

How to Apply

Applications for this position will be accepted via our job board. Excited about the opportunity, but worried you don’t meet all the requirements? Apply anyway, and give us both the chance to find out. We welcome you to read more about our approach to job descriptions by our Chief People Officer, Melanie Naranjo. Curious to know what it’s like to interview with us? Read more here.
Ethena is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a successful organization is one that celebrates its employees for who they are, who they love, and the unique lens through which they experience the world. Ethena does not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or other legally protected status. We understand that our differences make us better. They empower us to learn from each other, lean on each other, and create a product and community that models the behavior we hope to see in others.

jobs.description:
Cybersecurity & Information Assurance Specialist — Federal Health IT

Location: Remote — United States
Security Clearance: Active Secret Required

Strengthen Cybersecurity. Support Critical Federal Healthcare Technology.

Rackner is seeking a Cybersecurity & Information Assurance Specialist to strengthen security compliance and operational readiness across mission-critical federal healthcare technology.

In this role, you'll help maintain information assurance records, coordinate security reviews, and support compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) requirements. You'll collaborate with engineering, security, and operational teams to maintain accountability and help ensure technology environments remain prepared for security assessments.

This opportunity is ideal for a cybersecurity professional who understands DoD information assurance requirements, values accurate documentation, and enjoys solving practical security challenges across technical and operational environments.

What You'll Do

  • Maintain DoD cyber workforce qualification records, monitor certification expirations, and support ongoing compliance with applicable requirements.
  • Conduct periodic access reviews for designated systems and tools, and coordinate account and credential lifecycle activities with appropriate security stakeholders.
  • Maintain security-control documentation and supporting STIG and ACAS evidence, contributing to eMASS records and customer security assessments as assigned.
  • Report security incidents through established procedures and coordinate with authorized response teams.
  • Advise field engineering and operational teams on applicable security readiness and compliance requirements.
  • Help maintain accurate, audit-ready information assurance records and support ongoing security compliance activities.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional cybersecurity or information assurance experience supporting DoD environments.
  • Meets the position's applicable DoD 8140 cybersecurity qualification requirement, including the specified IAM Level II qualification (such as ISC2 CGRC, formerly CAP; CompTIA SecurityX, formerly CASP+; or an approved equivalent).
  • Professional experience with Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS), and Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS).
  • Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.
  • Experience supporting Defense Health Agency (DHA) Risk Management Framework (RMF) packages.
  • Familiarity with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2 practices.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, your work supports federal missions where security, reliability, and accountability matter. You'll collaborate with experienced technical professionals, apply your expertise to meaningful operational challenges, and contribute to the readiness of technology that supports federal healthcare teams.

We value practical problem-solving, collaboration, professional growth, and people who take ownership of their work.

Benefits & Perks

Eligible employees may enjoy:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
  • 401(k) with a 100% company match up to 6%.
  • Paid time off and paid holidays.
  • Company-supported certifications and professional development.
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support.
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement.
  • Weekly pay and team events.

Work Arrangement

This is a remote position within the United States, requiring collaboration with security, engineering, and operational stakeholders.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Title: Support Specialist II
Reports To: Manager, General Support
Department: Product Support

Summary/Objective:
The Support Specialist II serves as a technical expert and customer advocate for the 3-GIS product suite within the Esri ecosystem. This role is responsible for diagnosing complex software issues, guiding customers through best practice workflows, and ensuring a consistently exceptional support experience. You will work directly with client accounts, collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams, and help shape the future of customer success at 3-GIS.
This position requires strong technical proficiency, strong communication skills, and the ability to guide customers through various 3-GIS product challenges.
Essential Functions:

Customer Support & Technical Troubleshooting

  • Provide superior customer support and troubleshoot client issues with 3-GIS software, ensuring customers exceed expectations in their use of the platform.
  • Serve as a support representative for customer accounts, acting as a trusted advisor.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues across the 3-GIS stack, Esri products (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, Portal), and associated databases.
  • Leverage GIS data analysis and mapping tools to support customer requests.
  • Contribute toward the development of change control processes for hosted systems when required.
  • Possible participation in the on-call rotation to support critical customer systems.

Customer Enablement & Education

  • Educate customers on 3-GIS and Esri products, services, and recommended workflows to maximize operational efficiency.
  • Assist clients on product functionality, system usage, and best practices.
  • Engage in technical discussions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Configuration & System Management

  • Be able to configure and assist with upgrades of 3-GIS Solutions, Esri software, and supporting technologies.
  • Configure web services, application servers, and database connections for customer environments.
  • Test new software functionality, validate bug fixes, and provide structured feedback to Product and Development teams.
  • Follow documented procedures for customer escalations and ticket processing, including product enhancements and bugs.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Product, Development, and PMO teams to ensure accurate, timely solutions for customers.
  • Identify, document, and escalate issues to team leads or engineering as appropriate.
  • Track and report data from calls, chats, and high priority issues to support continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and train new team members within the organization.
  • Provide feedback to support leadership to improve customer experience, support processes, and operational efficiency.

Continuous Improvement & Customer Advocacy

  • Proactively identify workflow improvements, best practices, and opportunities to enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases, documentation, and process refinement.
  • Support customer onboarding and consultation for new customers.
  • Complete other support duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, GIS, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 3-4 years of experience in customer service, technical support, or GIS-related roles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    1. ArcGIS Desktop/Pro
    2. ArcGIS Server / ArcGIS Enterprise
    3. Esri Portal
    4. ArcGIS geoprocessing and data analysis tools
    5. 3-GIS Web and Mobile
    6. Python or similar scripting languages
    7. Database tools such as PGAdmin, SQL Developer, or SQL Server Manager
    8. Jira or similar ticketing systems
  • Self-directed and effective in a remote or hybrid work environment.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills with an interest in problem solving.
  • Passion for continuous learning and supporting team growth.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Understanding of 3-GIS configuration.
  • Hands-on experience with 3-GIS Admin.
  • Experience with APIs, automation, or system integrations.
  • Telecom planning, construction, or asset management experience.
  • Advanced experience with ESRI spatial analysis and geoprocessing workflows.
  • Experience troubleshooting web-based application system architecture (on-premises, cloud, hybrid).
  • Experience troubleshooting Windows Server, IIS, 3-GIS solutions and user workflows.
Work Environment:
  • Employees in a Remote setting with limited travel.

Expected Hours of Work:
  • 40 hours, Monday – Friday

Requirements

  • Posséder au moins 8 années d’expérience comme analyste en développement ou en maintenance de systèmes avec un SGBD relationnel;
  • Posséder au moins 5 années d’expérience avec MySQL version 8 ou ultérieure;

Benefits

  • Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l’innovation
  • Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail)
  • Congés en cas de maladie et à l’occasion d’événements familiaux
  • Outils informatiques adaptés
  • Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant
  • Initiatives sociales et environnementales
  • Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail
  • Cheminement de carrière

SALAIRE

Le salaire sera calculé sur la base du taux horaire moyen correspondant à votre profil.

LIEU DE TRAVAIL

Télétravail à partir du Canada. Une présence exceptionnelle à Québec pourrait être demandée selon les besoins du mandat.

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l’excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l’échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d’accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l’excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connaît une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.

Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergure.

TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l’équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

About Magic
Magic is a leading modern outsourcing platform that connects SMBs to high-quality remote workers, from SDRs to virtual assistants and more. Background
Founded: 2015 · Funding: $30M (Y Combinator, Sequoia backed) · Industry: HRTech, Virtual Assistant Platform · Employees: 672 · HQ: San Francisco, CA / Manila, PH
  • Check out Magic's Business Profile
  • Know more about our Team via Magic's Careers Page﻿﻿
Why does this role exist?

This is a full-time, in-house role at Magic — not freelance, and not a placement with a single client.
You'll build and hold candidate pipelines for niche, hard-to-fill roles — running Boolean searches across LinkedIn, job boards, and online communities, then screening and scheduling before a recruiter ever steps in. On custom, high-touch hires, you'll run sourcing, outreach, screening, and scheduling in a single day.
This isn't a full-cycle recruiting seat — you won't be running interviews or making offers. What you will do is make the call, before anyone else sees a resume, on whether a candidate is strong enough to move forward.
What You'll Actually Do

Sourcing Research
You'll hunt down candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, social platforms, and online communities — running Boolean searches and testing keyword combinations until the right people surface. You're building pipelines for the reqs open today and the ones opening next month, and logging all of it in Penthouse, Magic's in-house ATS, so nothing gets lost.

Coordination Handoff

You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with recruiters to understand exactly what "qualified" means for each req, then keep sourcing paced to their timelines. For niche and custom requests, you're also the one getting candidates onto the calendar — scheduling is part of the job, not an afterthought.

Candidate Engagement Screening

You're the first filter before anyone else sees a resume — reaching out, gauging real interest, and screening for fit before you endorse anyone up the chain. You'll keep candidates warm with real communication, not templated silence, because a good pipeline is really just a lot of relationships you didn't let go cold.

What Winning Looks Like

  • You keep a pipeline moving even when half of it has gone quiet — you re-engage instead of waiting around.
  • You can lose a whole day to one complicated custom req and still hit your other numbers.
  • You can tell a great candidate from a good-on-paper one before a recruiter ever opens the profile.
  • You hit your targets — Matching Interview Pass Rate, Hire Hit Rate, Drop-off Rate, Daily Endorsements — without cutting corners to get there.
  • Recruiters trust your handoffs, because they're clean every time, not just when it's convenient.

Your Superpowers
  • Adaptability
  • Attention to Detail
  • Boolean Search Mastery
  • Self-Direction
  • Challenge-Ready Mindset
  • Clear Communication

What You Bring

  • 1–3 years of dedicated sourcing experience — this is a sourcing seat, not a full-cycle recruiting one, so we're looking for someone who already thinks like a sourcer.
  • A track record finding candidates for niche or hard-to-fill roles across LinkedIn, job boards, social platforms, and online communities.
  • Hands-on Boolean search and keyword optimization skills.
  • Comfortable running multiple sourcing requests and accounts at once in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.
  • Professional English, written and verbal.
  • WFH setup: 8GB+ RAM with an Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better, 40 Mbps+ internet with backup, noise-cancelling headset with mic and webcam, backup computer and connection, quiet dedicated workspace.

Our Hiring Process
Application → Recruiter Screening → Hiring Manager Interview → Final Interview → Job Offer


The Reality
This role sits within Magic's Boutique team, supporting recruiters across general, niche, and custom-hire requisitions — everything from SDRs and bookkeepers to project managers and full custom accounts. The pool for niche and custom roles is often small, so real sourcing work is the norm, not the exception, and priorities can flip from a slow-burn niche search to an all-day custom-hire sprint without warning.
Shift: 9 AM–6 PM PHT (flexible start options: 7 AM–4 PM or 8 AM–5 PM), Monday–Friday, reporting to the Recruitment Manager.   • Can you go from a slow-burn niche search to an all-day sourcing-and-scheduling sprint without losing your rhythm?

jobs.title: Cloud Developer (m/w/d) – Identity & Access Management
jobs.excerpt: das erwartet dich: Shaping.  Digital.  Future.  Wir bauen digitale Souveränität – für Bundeswehr, Polizei, Justiz und kritische Infrastrukturen.
jobs.description:
das erwartet dich:

Shaping. Digital. Future.


Wir bauen digitale Souveränität – für Bundeswehr, Polizei, Justiz und kritische Infrastrukturen.

Ein großer öffentlicher Auftraggeber aus dem sicherheitskritischen Bereich betreibt seine eigene private Cloud – souverän, sicher und unter eigener Kontrolle. Ein zentrales, sicheres Identity & Access Management ist dafür der Schlüssel. Unser Team gestaltet diese Lösung mit: Architektur, Implementierung, Betrieb. Echtes Gestalten statt Verwalten, mit direktem Beitrag zur Digitalisierung der öffentlichen Hand.

Dafür suchen wir dich als Cloud Developer (m/w/d). Und um es gleich zu sagen: Du musst kein IAM-Experte sein. Wenn du solide Softwareentwicklung mitbringst und Lust hast, dich in Cloud- und IAM-Themen im sicherheitskritischen Bereich einzuarbeiten, wollen wir dich kennenlernen.
  • Aufbau statt Wartung: Du entwickelst eine zentrale IAM/PAM-Lösungmit – von Architekturentscheidungen bis zum produktiven Betrieb.
  • Cloud-native Engineering: Du baust und betreibst Services auf Kubernetes, automatisierst Infrastruktur als Code (GitOps) und sorgst mit CI/CD-Pipelines dafür, dass Änderungen sicher und schnell in die Umgebung kommen.
  • Identity & Access: Du gestaltest, wie Identitäten, Rollen und privilegierte Zugriffe über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus verwaltet werden – Provisionierung, Berechtigungen, Governance, Nachweisbarkeit.
  • Integration: Du bindest bestehende Systeme über saubere Schnittstellen (REST-APIs) an und arbeitest an einer Integrationsarchitektur, die über Jahre trägt.
  • Sicherheit als Standard: Du arbeitest in einer kritischen Umgebung mit klaren regulatorischen Vorgaben – und lernst, wie man Anforderungen aus BSI-Grundschutz & Co. in gute technische Lösungen übersetzt.
Unser Stack (Auszug): Kubernetes · Linux · Git · CI/CD · Infrastructure as Code & GitOps · REST-APIs · IAM/PAM-Plattformen · Jira & Confluence

das bringst du mit:

Das Anforderungsprofil des Projekts ist breit – im Idealfall bringst du alles davon mit. Realistisch suchen wir Menschen, die einen Teil davon sicher beherrschen und den Rest mit uns lernen wollen.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und ein sicheres Verständnis des Software-Lifecycles (SDLC) – Git ist dein tägliches Werkzeug
  • Praxis mit Linux, Automatisierung und Skripting (z. B. Bash, Python)
  • Erste praktische Erfahrung mit DevOps oder DevSecOps – idealerweise beim Aufbau oder Betrieb von CI/CD-Pipelines
  • Verständnis von Softwaredesign, API-Konzepten (REST) und Integrationsarchitekturen
  • Lust, dich in Identity & Access Management, Privileged Access Management und Cloud-Betrieb tief einzuarbeiten – und die Ausdauer, es auch zu tun
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (Projektsprache)

Womit du bei uns punktest
  • Aufsetzen und Betrieb von Kubernetes-Clustern
  • Infrastructure as Code und GitOps in der Praxis
  • Kenntnisse in Identity & Access Management oder Privileged Access Management, besonders im Cloud-Umfeld
  • Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Zugriffen, IAM/PAM und Governance des Identitätslebenszyklus
  • Verständnis regulatorischer Anforderungen für den Betrieb kritischer Umgebungen (BSI-Grundschutz, VS-NfD, KRITIS)
  • Erfahrung im Public Sector oder in vergleichbar regulierten Umfeldern

warum saltrock?

  • Fully remote: Du arbeitest, wo du willst. Wenn du Kolleg:innen sehen möchtest, stehen unsere Büros in Köln und Münster offen.
  • Kurze Wege: Kleines Unternehmen, direkter Austausch mit dem CEO, Entscheidungen in Tagen statt Quartalen.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: 30 Urlaubstage und Vertrauensarbeitszeit („Come as you are“).
  • Zusatzleistungen: Firmenkreditkarte inkl. Spesentool sowie Edenred City Karte (50 € monatlich).
  • Weiterentwicklung: Fachzertifikate (z. B. CKA, Cloud- und IAM-Zertifizierungen), Leadership- und Soft-Skill-Trainings, Zugang zu LinkedIn Learning und Udemy.
  • Karrierepfade: Individuelle Entwicklung, z. B. Richtung Lead Architect oder Practice Lead.
  • Sinn & Wirkung: Projekte mit gesellschaftlicher Relevanz – ein aktiver Beitrag zur technologischen Handlungsfähigkeit Deutschlands.

Klingt nach dir?


Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – Lebenslauf reicht, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wenn du magst, zeig uns ein Projekt, ein Repo oder etwas, das du gebaut hast.

Bereit, die Handlungsfähigkeit unseres Landes mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt.

jobs.description:
Department:

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTechis W&D’s in-house technologyteam– a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTechEngineeringbuilds solutions thatimpactnot only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Lead Data Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical leader within the Data Engineering organization, helping define the architecture, engineering standards, and best practices that support Walker & Dunlop’s enterprise data platform. This role focuses on technical leadership and platform modernization, partnering closely with Engineering leadership and distributed engineering teams to build scalable, reliable, and well-governed data systems.

You will play a key role in shaping the future state of the data platform by driving architectural consistency, improving engineering practices, and supporting the adoption of modern data engineering capabilities across the organization.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Define andmaintainarchitectural standards for the enterprise data platform, including data modeling, pipeline design, orchestration, and observability practices.

  • Lead the Technical Design Document (TDD) process, including authoring, reviewing, and approving technical designs for complex initiatives.

  • Conduct design reviews and production readiness reviews across Data Engineering teams.

  • Guide the evolution of the core data platform stack, including Redshift, Airflow, Kafka, SQL Server, and Aurora PostgreSQL.

  • Establish and promote engineering standards related to code quality, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and release management.

  • Identifyand help address technical debt, platform fragmentation, scalability concerns, and reliability improvements.

  • Partner with Engineering Managers and teams on technical planning, solution design, and implementation approaches.

  • Mentor and coach engineers on architecture, engineering best practices, and technical leadership skills.

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders on platform capabilities, integrations, and data architecture patterns.

  • Support evaluation and adoption of new tools, frameworks, and technologies related to data engineering, transformation, quality, and governance.

  • Perform other duties as assigned

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degreepreferred, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, including experience serving as a technical lead or senior individual contributor across multiple teams or initiatives.

  • Strong experience building and supporting cloud-native data platforms within AWS environments.

  • Experience with modern data engineering tools and technologies including Airflow, Kafka, Redshift, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.

  • Experience implementing CI/CD practices, automated testing, and production support processes for data pipelines and platforms.

  • Familiarity with enterprise data warehouse technologies and data transformation frameworks preferred.

  • Commercial real estate, financial services, or regulated industry experience preferred.

Knowledge,Skillsand Abilities

  • Deepexpertisein SQL, data modeling, and modern data engineering practices.

  • Strong understanding of scalable data platform architecture, orchestration, and operational reliability.

  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, data quality, and data contract concepts.

  • Experience writing and reviewing technical design documentation and leading technical decision-making processes.

  • Strong understanding of monitoring, observability, and platform health practices for enterprise data systems.

  • Ability to lead technical initiatives and influence engineering standards across distributed teams.

  • Strong communicationand collaboration skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, anddemonstratepatience when learning new processes

  • Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders

This position has an estimated base salary of 170k-190k plus a discretionary bonus. An employment offer is based on the applicant’s relevant work experience, applicable knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

  • The opportunity to join one of Fortune Magazine’s Great Places to Work winners

  • Comprehensive benefit options* that have earned Walker & Dunlop the gold level of the 2025 Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation™, some of which include:
    - Up to 83% subsidized medical payroll deductions
    - Competitive dental and vision benefits

    - 401(k) + match

    - A robust health and wellness program – earn cash rewards and gain access to resources that

    - Health Savings Account and Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending

jobs.description:
Compensation Range:

$97,000 - $105,000 USD

Compensation Disclaimer:
The salary range listed reflects the base pay for this role at Altus Group and is provided where required by local regulations. Actual offers may differ based on experience, market conditions, and other relevant factors. The range does not include additional compensation such as bonuses, equity, benefits, or other incentives.

Who we need

Reporting to the Director, Development Advisory, we are hiring a Senior Construction Consultant to join our growing U.S. team. As our new Senior Construction Consultant, you will provide independent construction risk advisory and loan monitoring services for lenders and developers across a diverse portfolio of projects. You will conduct pre-development due diligence, review construction drawings, contracts, schedules, budgets, and project documentation, perform site inspections, validate construction progress against draw requests, and prepare detailed reports and recommendations that support lending decisions.

This is a remote role with the expectation that you are based in the Eastern United States near a major airport and are available to travel up to 50% of the time. Travelling to project sites throughout the country, you will collaborate with lenders, developers, contractors, and internal stakeholders while helping to expand our Development Advisory practice and deliver trusted construction insights across multiple asset classes.

What’s in it for you

Complex projects and diverse asset classes. You will advise on a wide range of development projects across the United States, gaining exposure to residential, commercial, industrial, hospitality, mixed-use, and institutional developments. From pre-development due diligence through construction completion, you will apply your expertise across different project types, delivery models, and markets, broadening your perspective beyond a single asset class or geographic region.

A trusted advisory role. This is an opportunity to move beyond project execution and apply your construction expertise in a consulting capacity. You will serve as an independent advisor to lenders and project stakeholders, providing risk assessments, funding recommendations, and strategic insights that influence critical project and investment decisions. Your professional judgement, technical expertise, and ability to identify and communicate risk will be highly valued.

The opportunity to help build a growing practice. As part of an expanding U.S. Development Advisory team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth and evolution of the practice while working alongside respected professionals across the United States and Canada. Whether your career aspirations include technical specialization, mentoring others, business development, or leadership, you will have the support, exposure, and opportunities to continue advancing your career within a global organization.

As our new Senior Construction Consultant, you will:

  • Provide independent construction risk advisory and due diligence services. You will review construction drawings, specifications, schedules, budgets, contracts, development approvals, and other project documentation to assess project feasibility and identify potential risks prior to financing. Applying your construction expertise and professional judgement, you will prepare detailed due diligence reports that provide lenders with a clear understanding of project scope, cost, schedule, and risk exposure before loan closing or initial funding.
  • Lead construction loan monitoring and reporting activities. You will serve as the independent advisor between lenders, developers, contractors, and project stakeholders throughout the construction lifecycle. Conducting regular site inspections, you will evaluate construction progress, validate draw requests against work in place, review supporting documentation, assess cost-to-complete forecasts, and provide funding recommendations that support informed lending decisions. You will prepare comprehensive monthly reports that communicate project status, financial performance, schedule adherence, and emerging risks through project completion.
  • Assess project performance and proactively identify risk. You will analyze contractor pay applications, subcontractor invoices, lien waivers, change orders, RFI logs, contingency utilization, and other key project controls to evaluate project health and financial performance. Drawing on your understanding of construction practices, contracts, and project delivery, you will identify potential concerns, communicate findings clearly, and recommend practical solutions that help lenders mitigate risk and protect their investments.
  • Manage relationships and represent Altus as a trusted advisor. You will collaborate with lenders, developers, contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders across multiple concurrent projects. As a trusted source of independent insight, you will build credibility through your technical expertise, professionalism, and ability to communicate complex construction and financial information in a clear, practical, and actionable manner.

You bring:

  • The construction expertise. You have a degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience gained through construction, development, consulting, or contracting environments. You bring several years of hands-on experience overseeing, managing, consulting on, or evaluating construction projects and have a strong understanding of project delivery, construction practices, project controls, budgets, schedules, and contracts.
  • The technical foundation. You can confidently interpret construction drawings, specifications, schedules, contracts, and project documentation across multiple disciplines. You understand how construction projects are planned, procured, and executed and can assess construction progress, contractor performance, and project risks through both documentation reviews and site observations.
  • The analytical and risk assessment capability. You can evaluate project budgets, pay applications, change orders, cost-to-complete forecasts, and supporting documentation to identify risks and assess project health. You apply sound professional judgement when making recommendations and understand the potential impact of cost, schedule, scope, and construction-related issues on project outcomes and lending decisions.
  • The communication and stakeholder management skills. You can build credibility with lenders, developers, contractors, consultants, and project teams. You are comfortable leading conversations, asking thoughtful questions, and translating complex construction information into clear, concise reports and actionable recommendations for a variety of audiences.
  • The independence and accountability. You thrive in a remote environment where autonomy, organization, and responsiveness are essential. You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, balance travel with competing priorities, and take ownership of your work while maintaining the professionalism, attention to detail, and client service expected in a consulting environment.

Apply now

jobs.title: Associate Patient Access Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Hi.  We’re Hummingbird. We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it.
jobs.description:
Hi. We’re Hummingbird.

We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it. We partner with healthcare systems to transform how patients access care, enabling their providers to focus on what matters most – caring for patients. By managing patient access as a technology-enabled service, we help health systems stabilize costs and improve patient experience while creating good jobs that attract and retain talent in the industry. Our team of experts is obsessed with the connection between the people, processes, and technology that make healthcare organizations hum. Join us and help build the healthcare experience we want for our communities, our families, and ourselves.

Summary

Help patients get the care they need with patience, clarity, and compassion.

As an Associate Patient Access Specialist at Hummingbird, you’re the first voice patients hear when they reach out for care. Every call is a chance to make someone’s day a little easier, whether you’re scheduling an appointment, updating records, or helping someone log in to their MyChart account.

You’ll learn to navigate healthcare systems and practice empathy on every call, using your customer service skills to make each patient feel supported. You’ll also work with a close-knit team that supports you and celebrates your growth.

This is a starting point for a meaningful career in healthcare. You don’t need medical experience; you need great communication skills, curiosity, technical aptitude, and the desire to help others, while contributing as a dependable part of the patient access team. We will teach you the rest through hands-on training, coaching, and real-time support.

Responsibilities

Note: This posting is for our ongoing Patient Access Specialist Talent Pool. We interview continuously and anticipate frequent openings, with start dates typically 2-6 months after your application.

What You’ll Do

  • Be the first point of contact for patients calling to schedule or update appointments, ask about referrals or test results, request prescription refills, or get MyChart support.
  • You’ll spend most of your day talking with patients over the phone, supporting them through back-to-back calls in our remote call center environment.
  • Listen carefully, ask clarifying questions, and guide patients to the right next step.
  • Recognize when a patient needs clinical support and escalate calls that require medical guidance, urgent attention, or clinical review.
  • Use our phone system, reference materials, and Epic (our electronic medical record system) to schedule visits, update insurance/contact details, and keep patient information accurate.
  • Help patients use MyChart, a secure online portal, by setting up accounts, resetting passwords, and walking them through features like messaging or virtual visits.
  • Document each call clearly and follow established workflows to keep things running smoothly.
  • Escalate more complex questions to senior specialists or leads, knowing you have a team ready to support you.
  • Participate in ongoing training and coaching to build consistency and accuracy in workflows.
  • Contribute to a positive team culture where collaboration, curiosity, and kindness come first.

The Details

  • Location: Remote (U.S.-based)
  • Schedule: Full-time, Monday-Friday; hours vary based on patient access center hours
  • Compensation: Expected total range for the role is $17.00 to $22.00 per hour. New hires start between $17.00and $20.00, depending on experience and internal equity.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; 401(k); parental leave; career development support; and more
  • Training: Paid, structured onboarding and ongoing mentorship

Expectations for Focus & Presence

  • To support patients and each other, this role requires your full attention during scheduled work hours. Our Outside Employment Policy doesn’t allow overlapping work or “job stacking,” so any outside work must happen fully outside your Hummingbird schedule.
  • We’re a camera-ready team, and you’ll need to be on-camera during training and when needed during the workday after training ends.
  • We value connection, teamwork, and being present, which is what keeps our patients safe and our team supported. If that’s what you’re looking for, you’ll feel at home here. If you’re hoping to hold another job during the same hours, this job won’t be the best match.

About our Talent Pool

Hummingbird is growing fast, and we interview year-round for our Associate Patient Access Specialist Talent Pool. While we’re not hiring for this specific role right now, we typically add new specialists monthly, so start dates are often 2–6 months after applying.

Joining the talent pool means you’ll be among the first considered when opportunities open. We receive a lot of applications, so hearing back may take a little time, but we’ll keep you updated, usually within a couple of weeks. You may also be invited to complete an assessment or have a brief conversation with a recruiter as part of early screening.

Growth at Hummingbird

This role is the first step in our Patient Access career path. Associates receive structured training and ongoing coaching to build skills in scheduling, technology, and patient communication.

As you gain experience, you’ll take on more complex workflows and grow into Patient Access Specialist and Senior Specialist roles, with increased independence, system expertise, and peer support.

At Hummingbird, we believe good jobs should lead somewhere, and that starts here.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We’re on a mission to make healthcare more human. At Hummingbird, that means treating every patient — and every teammate — with empathy, respect, and clarity.

As an Associate, you’ll be supported from day one through training, coaching, and clear workflows that help you build confidence. As you grow, so will your independence and comfort navigating calls, systems, and patient needs.

Our specialists often share how much they value the balance of autonomy and trust here. You’ll start with a strong foundation, and over time you’ll have the chance to step into that same sense of ownership and balance as you advance.

A Note on Authentic Interviews

We believe the best hiring conversations are real ones. Notes are welcome, and jotting things down during the call is completely fine. What we ask is that you don’t use AI tools or similar assistance to generate your responses in real time.

We’re genuinely trying to get to know you: how you think, how you communicate, and what you’ve experienced. That connection matters to us, and it’s hard to find when answers are scripted rather than interactive.

We’re a team that makes healthcare more human. We’d love to meet the person behind your application.

Required & Desired Skills

What You'll Bring

  • Work experience helping people, whether in retail, hospitality, customer service, or another role where patience and professionalism matter.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to stay calm and clear when someone is stressed.
  • Confidence using multiple systems at once, learning new software tools quickly, and typing at least 35 WPM accurately while managing patient calls.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to stay organized while juggling several tasks.
  • A growth mindset and openness to feedback, eager to learn and build new skills.
  • Curiosity about healthcare and how it all fits together behind the scenes.

What Helps You Shine

  • Please note that we use both your resume and your written and oral communication throughout the hiring process to understand your fit for this role.
  • Thoughtful, clear responses help us see your attention to detail, your professionalism, and your ability to communicate with care — all skills that are essential for success on our team.

STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP & INNOVATION

CLIENT LEADERSHIP & ENGAGEMENT

PROJECT & TEAM LEADERSHIP

  • Contribute to business development activities, including proposals, pitches, client support and thought leadership.

COMMUNICATION & DELIVERABLES

  • Support development of articles, policy summaries, or dissemination plans where needed.

  • Connect the Health Innovation team with EVERSANA’s broader capabilities—spanning commercial, medical, data, regulatory, and agency services—to drive integration and value.

INCLUSION, INTEGRITY, AND GROWTH

  • Act with accountability and integrity, embracing our cultural values in all engagements.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Travel (not frequent: domestic and international)
  • Hours (minimum 40 hours per week)

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Demonstrated experience defining and implementing go-to-market (GTM) and commercialization strategies for digital health assets (e.g., digital therapeutics, digital companions, AI-driven platforms, hybrid drug-device combinations).

  • Experience leading client-facing strategy engagements and managing cross-functional delivery teams from planning through execution.

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

About Clinical Solutions

Elsevier Clinical Solutions delivers trusted, evidence-based content and technology-enabled solutions that support healthcare professionals, institutions, and patients across the care journey. Our portfolio includes Clinical And Drug Reference, Clinical Decision Support, Patient Engagement, Performance Improvement, Workflow Solutions, Clinical Pathways, Order Sets, Care Planning, and emerging AI-enabled solutions.

Our products help healthcare organizations improve clinical decision-making, support patient safety, reduce variability in care, enhance workflow efficiency, and promote the use of trusted evidence at the point of care.

About the Role

Elsevier is seeking a Physician Clinical Executive to drive the growth of Clinical Solutions across the APAC region. Based in Malaysia and reporting to the Product Sales Director, Clinical Solutions, this role serves as the physician-level clinical authority for commercial teams, customers, and partners, bringing deep clinical expertise and consultative leadership to the region.

The successful candidate will be a qualified medical doctor with clinical practice experience and the ability to act as a trusted clinical advisor to healthcare organizations across APAC. They will advise customers on the clinical value and strategic application of Elsevier’s Clinical Solutions portfolio, including Clinical Decision Support, solutions such: ClinicalKey, ClinicalKey AI, Drug Information, Clinical Pathways, and other Workflow Solutions.

This role will work closely with sales, product, marketing, customer success, implementation, and regional leadership teams to drive revenue growth, customer engagement, product adoption, and thought leadership across APAC.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the clinical authority and trusted physician advisor within sales engagements across APAC, leading opportunity identification, qualification, development, account planning, and solution-based customer engagements.
  • Deliver clinical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, and value discussions tailored to healthcare executives, physicians, pharmacists, nursing leaders, informatics teams, digital health stakeholders, and clinical leadership teams.
  • Partner with commercial teams to position Elsevier Clinical Solutions across hospitals, health systems, academic medical centers, ministries of health, private healthcare groups, and other provider organizations.
  • Lead conversations on clinical workflow integration, Clinical Decision Support, AI-enabled solutions, evidence-based practice, Care Standardization, Patient Safety, Clinical Quality, Medication Safety, Clinician Productivity, and Patient Engagement.
  • Translate clinical needs, physician workflow challenges, and healthcare priorities into effective solution positioning, while advising customers on driving informed clinical decisions, clinician usage, learner engagement, and patient interactions.
  • Lead post-sale physician engagement, gathering customer feedback, clinical insights, and outcome data to drive adoption, value realization, customer experience improvements, and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead the regional positioning and expansion of ClinicalKey AI and other AI-enabled Clinical Solutions, providing physician-led thought leadership on the responsible, ethical, safe, and effective use of AI in clinical workflows.
  • Drive customer and commercial team engagement on GenAI adoption, trust, governance, Clinical Safety, workflow impact, evidence-based use, change management, and the value of AI solutions for healthcare organizations and clinical education.
  • Synthesize and communicate market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, Healthcare Transformation priorities, Digital Health developments, Clinical Informatics trends, and physician workflow insights to inform product strategy, roadmap priorities, customer experience, and regional market requirements.
  • Represent Elsevier Clinical Solutions as a physician thought leader through customer meetings, conferences, webinars, industry forums, publications, and sales enablement initiatives, while leading training, knowledge sharing, clinician advisory activities, and cross-regional collaboration with clinical experts.

Requirements

  • Strong consultative and customer-facing skills, with the ability to engage credibly with physicians, healthcare executives, informatics teams, pharmacists, nurses, commercial stakeholders, and translate clinical challenges into solution-based recommendations and value propositions.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, storytelling, stakeholder management, analytical, and organizational skills, with the ability to synthesize complex clinical, technical, and commercial information.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively within commercial environments, partner with sales teams as a credible clinical expert, and work successfully across countries, cultures, functions, and time zones.
  • Knowledge of AI, GenAI, Responsible AI, and healthcare AI applications is a strong advantage; fluency in English is required, additional APAC languages are advantageous, and willingness to travel across APAC is required.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

This position is responsible for building strong talent pipelines and partnering closely with hiring leaders to support the company’s rapid growth.

The Director of Recruiting plays a critical role in helping ComputerCare scale while maintaining our commitment to exceptional service, accountability, and teamwork. Success in this role requires strong operational discipline, proactive sourcing, and the ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously while delivering an outstanding candidate experience.

This role supports approximately 70+ annual hires, requiring the ability to manage 10–20 active requisitions simultaneously while maintaining strong candidate experience and hiring quality. Most requisitions are hourly, technician-level field and repair roles that require continual pipeline replenishment; a smaller number are salaried technical, operational, and leadership hires that require a more strategic, consultative approach, including occasional roles supporting ComputerCare’s teams in Ireland, Singapore, and India.

Values in Action

We instead of me. Be accountable. Take initiative. Act with empathy. Embrace curiosity. Do the right thing.

The Director of Recruiting models and reinforces ComputerCare’s values through the hiring process by:

  • Delivering a service-oriented candidate experience that reflects the company’s commitment to customers and employees.

  • Demonstrating integrity and accountability in hiring practices and candidate evaluation.

  • Partnering with hiring managers to ensure hiring decisions reflect the collaborative culture of ComputerCare.

  • Continuously improving recruiting processes to support the company’s growth and operational excellence.

What You'll Do

    Essential Duties

    • Manage full-cycle recruiting across multiple departments, including Repair, IT, Sales, and Operations. Spans both high-volume hourly/field hiring and salaried technical, operational, and leadership searches.

    • Maintain an active pipeline of qualified candidates to support ongoing hiring needs.

    • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, success profiles, and hiring plans aligned with company growth.

    • Drive an efficient recruiting process that balances hiring speed with candidate quality.

    • Manage communication and scheduling throughout the candidate journey to ensure a positive experience.

    • Track key recruiting metrics (e.g., time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, source effectiveness) to improve hiring outcomes and share insights with leadership.

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for sourcing and screening on assigned requisitions, ensuring candidates are evaluated and represented consistently before being introduced to hiring managers or executive leadership.

    • Own and independently present a standing recruiting update to the Executive Leadership Team, translating pipeline and hiring data into resourcing recommendations.

    • Maintain a high level of confidentiality and discretion regarding all matters, data and documents.

    • Ensure the hiring process reflects ComputerCare’s commitment to service, integrity, and professionalism.

      • Build and maintain talent pipelines for frequently hired roles including repair technicians, IT support, sales, and operations positions.

      • Manage requisition workflow, interview coordination, and offer processes to maintain hiring velocity.

      • Provide hiring leaders with market insight regarding compensation, talent availability, and competitive trends.

      • Conduct reference checks as needed to confirm the suitability and integrity of potential hires.

      • Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies using job boards, referrals, professional networks, and other proactive channels.

      • Represent ComputerCare professionally in community and industry events to strengthen the company’s reputation as an employer.

      • Organize and participate in career fairs, networking events, and community initiatives, representing the company and building a strong talent pipeline.

      • Stay informed on industry trends and labor market conditions to maintain a competitive recruiting strategy.

      • Screen candidates for technical capability and cultural alignment, ensuring a structured and equitable selection process.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage 10–20 concurrent requisitions in a fast-paced environment.

  • Comfortable partnering with, and when necessary, respectfully challenging, senior leadership and hiring managers on role scope, sourcing channels, and candidate quality.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Proven ability to source and engage candidates across multiple platforms.

  • Experience partnering with hiring managers and influencing hiring decisions.

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills; able to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on relationship-building and candidate care.

  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ComputerCare’s system of record is Lever) and sourcing tools (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter).

  • Experience recruiting across technical and non-technical roles is a plus!

  • Achieving recruiting timelines that support operational needs

jobs.description:
Start: ab sofort | Level: Senior | Location: Deutschland, remote | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche)

Als IT Security Architekt (gn) – IAM & OnPrem verantwortest du das Sicherheits-Zielbild und die Standards für Identitäten und die On-Premises-Infrastruktur. Du entwirfst Referenzarchitekturen für Identity & Access Management, On-Prem Active Directory (inkl. hybrider Anbindung an Entra ID) sowie die zugehörige On-Prem-Infrastruktur und berätst die umsetzenden Teams. Die operative Umsetzung liegt bei den Fachteams; dein Beitrag ist Design, Standardsetzung und fachliche Beratung.

Deine Mission bei uns

  • Verantwortungsbereiche / Domänen

    • Identity & Access Management (IAM): Referenzarchitektur und Standards für Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Rezertifizierung, Joiner/Mover/Leaver-Prozesse und privilegierte Zugriffe (PAM).
    • On-Prem Active Directory: Härtungs- und Tiering-Konzepte, Absicherung privilegierter Konten, sichere Administrationsmodelle.
    • Entra ID (Hybrid): Sichere Kopplung von On-Prem AD und Cloud-Identität, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management – als Teil eines konsistenten hybriden Identitätskonzepts.
    • On-Prem Infrastruktur & Netzwerk: Sicherheitsvorgaben für Segmentierung, Zugriffs- und Übergangsarchitekturen sowie sichere Fernzugriffe im On-Prem-Umfeld.
    • OT / Produktionssicherheit (optional, zukünftig): Vorgesehen als zukünftige Erweiterung des Verantwortungsbereichs – Referenzarchitektur und Standards für die sichere Trennung und Anbindung von OT-/Produktionssystemen (Standort Elmshorn) an die IT. Entsprechende Kompetenz bzw. Bereitschaft, sich in das Thema einzuarbeiten, muss vorhanden sein.

    Architektur & Standards

    • Zielbild & Referenzarchitektur: Entwicklung von Sicherheits-Zielbildern und Referenzarchitekturen für IAM und die On-Prem-Infrastruktur.
    • Standards & Vorgaben: Erstellung verbindlicher Sicherheitsstandards, Guidelines und ADRs; Definition von Least-Privilege-, Tiering- und Security-by-Design-Prinzipien.
    • Risiko- & Architektur-Reviews: Bewertung bestehender und geplanter Lösungen, Identifikation von Schwachstellen und Ableitung von Maßnahmen – ohne selbst zu implementieren.

    Beratung & Enablement

    • Fachliche Beratung: Beratung aller technischen Teams (u. a. IT-Infrastruktur, Netzwerk, Engineering) zur sicheren Umsetzung der Vorgaben.
    • Tool-Auswahl & Einführung: Auswahl geeigneter IAM-/Security-Tools und fachliche Begleitung sowie Überwachung ihrer Einführung.

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

  • Erfahrung: Langjährige Erfahrung in Security-Architektur bzw. Identity-/Infrastruktursicherheit mit nachweisbaren Ergebnissen.
  • IAM: Fundiertes Verständnis von IAM-Konzepten und -Prozessen (Rollenmodelle, Rezertifizierung, Berechtigungsauswertung, PAM).
  • Active Directory & Entra ID: Tiefe Kenntnisse in On-Prem Active Directory (Härtung, Tiering) und Microsoft Entra ID inkl. hybrider Szenarien (Conditional Access, PIM).
  • Infrastruktur & Netzwerk: Verständnis für On-Prem-Infrastruktur- und Netzwerksicherheit (Segmentierung, sichere Zugriffe).
  • Arbeitsweise & Wirkung: Fähigkeit, Standards zu setzen, teamübergreifend zu beraten und Kolleg:innen fachlich weiterzuentwickeln; strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise.
  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von TQG zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.

Über uns

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements

  • 8+ years professional software development experience, with 3+ years in an architecture-focused role
  • Deep experience designing low-latency service architectures in AWS, including judgment about when distributed components (queues, caches, search projections) earn their place
  • Experience designing to explicit latency budgets (p95/p99), including synchronous durable commits in hot paths
  • Experience designing audit/evidence systems: append-only event logs, versioned or bitemporal fact models, and deterministic historical replay
  • Experience designing fail-open/fail-closed/degraded-state semantics and outage postures
  • Proven experience architecting secure multi-tenant environments, including tradeoff analysis (RLS vs. schema-per-tenant vs. database-per-tenant)
  • Deep experience with PostgreSQL/AuroraDB and Row-Level Security (RLS) at a data-modeling and architecture level
  • Expertise in designing and building scalable RESTful APIs
  • Experience architecting SDK integrations to other services
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript across the stack
  • Experience building capacity models and cloud cost/performance projections (AWS Well-Architected Framework)
  • Experience establishing technical standards, conducting architecture and code reviews, and mentoring engineering teams
  • Experience producing architecture documentation, diagrams, and technical decision records (ADRs)
  • Experience presenting and defending architecture decisions in client engineering and security reviews
  • Experience working with AI coding assistants as part of daily development
  • Substantial background architecting large, complex systems end-to-end
  • Ability to overlap US business hours
  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables
  • Client-focused dedication to team commitments
  • Best practices knowledge and adherence
  • Strong problem-solving ability and technical leadership skills
  • Positive mindset and can-do attitude
  • Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in compliance-sensitive or regulated domains (e.g., TCPA/DNC, fintech decisioning, audit-heavy systems)
  • Experience with event-driven design, message queues, and caching strategies at scale
  • Advanced degree

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

The successful candidate will be an experienced, hands-on designer capable of contributing throughout multiple phases of a project, from concept and schematic design through design development, construction documentation, and project coordination.

Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Principal Bid Owner (Public Sector)

About the Role

As a Principal Bid Owner, you will lead strategic, high-value public sector pursuits, shaping winning propositions and bid responses that help Kainos secure major digital transformation programmes. This is a leadership role focused on pursuit strategy, solution positioning and bid quality, rather than solely bid writing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop compelling value propositions, win themes and key messaging.
  • Own the overall bid narrative to articulate a winning bid solution, integrating technical, commercial and delivery content.
  • Leading storyboarding and response development, engaging subject matter experts effectively to secure required insight and evidence while using specialist time efficiently
  • Shape and challenge solutions to ensure they are credible, competitive and client-focused.
  • Collaborate with sales, delivery, technical and commercial stakeholders to drive successful outcomes.
  • Ensure submissions are high-quality, compliant and aligned to customer evaluation criteria.
  • Coach colleagues and contribute to bid best practice and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven success in senior pursuit, pre-sales or bid leadership roles
  • Strong proposal writing, editing and storytelling skills., with experience of holding the pen on complex bid responses
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decisions in complex environments.
  • Understanding of digital transformation, technology delivery and commercial considerations.
  • Knowledge of UK Public Sector procurement and bidding processes.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.

Ideal backgrounds: Bid Director, Capture Manager, Senior Bid Manager, Pursuit Lead, Pre-Sales Lead or Solution Lead with significant bid ownership experience.

Why Join Kainos?

We are building a world-class Business Development capability to support Kainos’ continued growth. You'll have the opportunity to shape some of the UK's most important public sector digital transformation programmes, working with clients including the Home Office, Defra, HMCTS, Department for Transport and FCDO. You'll join a collaborative, high-performing team where your expertise will directly influence Kainos' continued success and growth.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

The impact you will have
