jobs.description:
Director of Paid Social

Sociallyin | Atlanta, GA (Remote-friendly) | $80,000–$95,000

We're hiring a Director of Paid Social to own and grow our paid media department. This is a senior leadership role for someone who's ready to build something, not just maintain it.

About the role

Sociallyin is a social media marketing agency, and only a social media marketing agency. We've been operating for 15 years, we're 50 people strong, and we're actively investing in how AI changes the way agencies work.

Our paid media department runs over $200K+ in monthly ad spend across 30+ client accounts, spanning Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, YouTube, and more. Clients range from SMB to mid-market to enterprise. The function is solid, but the ceiling is significantly higher than where we are today, and we need a leader who can take it there.

We want someone who can manage a team of 5 (mid-level and junior buyers), elevate performance across the board, build the systems and playbooks we've been operating without, move the department upmarket, and develop the next generation of leaders inside it.

This isn't a seat-warmer role. You'll report directly to the founders, you'll have full authority over how the department runs, and you'll have real influence on where the agency goes next.

What you'll own

  • Team leadership and development. Managing a team of 5+ paid media specialists (middle and junior). Coaching them, growing their skills, and building a culture where people want to do their best work.
  • Department performance. Owning the results across every client in the paid book. Defining what good looks like, holding the team to it, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Strategy across platforms. Setting the strategic direction for paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, and YouTube. Knowing when to push budget, when to pull back, and when to test something new.
  • Client relationships. Acting as the senior paid voice in strategic client conversations. Building trust with marketing leaders at SMB through enterprise clients. Being the person clients want in the room when paid comes up.
  • Systems and playbooks. Formalizing what's currently tribal knowledge into repeatable processes. Building the operating system that lets the department scale without sacrificing quality.
  • Hiring and growth. Full authority to hire, restructure, and grow the team as the department scales. You'll be building the seat above yours and the seats below.
  • AI and tooling. Identifying where AI can sharpen our work, evaluating new tools, and making the calls on what we adopt. We want a leader who's curious about where this is going, not defensive about it.
  • Upmarket expansion. Helping us win and retain bigger, more sophisticated paid accounts. Being the kind of operator that enterprise clients trust.
  • Cross-functional partnership. Working closely with Account Management, Creative, and Strategy to make sure paid is integrated into the bigger picture, not running in a silo.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • The team is operating at a higher standard than when you arrived, and they know why.
  • You've put systems and playbooks in place that didn't exist before, and the team is actually using them.
  • Client retention in the paid book is up, and at least one account has expanded scope because of work you led.
  • Performance metrics across the department are trending in the right direction, with the data to prove it.
  • You've built a clear point of view on where the department is going and how we get there, and the leadership team is bought in.

Where this role can go

This is a department-building role at an agency that's actively scaling. As the paid book grows, so does the department, which means new roles emerge underneath you and broader influence for you over time. You'll have real say in what that path looks like, because you're building it.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of paid social experience, with at least 2-3 of those years in agency.
  • Direct team leadership experience. You've managed people, not just projects. You know how to coach a mid-level buyer and develop a junior one.
  • Real depth on these platforms: Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, YouTube, X. Comfortable across the rest, even if you'd lean on the team for the ones you know less.
  • Strategic thinking beyond the platform. You don't just optimize toward CPA. You understand the client's business, the funnel they live inside, and what paid actually needs to do for them.
  • A track record of building something. Systems, playbooks, training programs, hiring frameworks, reporting structures — something you put in place that outlasted you.
  • Strong client communication. You can hold your own in a room with a VP of Marketing or a CMO and walk out with their trust.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and where this work is headed. You experiment with new tools. You ask "could AI do this part?" before grinding through manual work.
  • An operator's instinct. You can read a P&L, think about margin, and understand why department profitability matters as much as performance.

What we offer

  • Salary: $75,000–$90,000 DOE
  • Remote-friendly with daily morning team standups
  • Direct exposure to founders and senior leadership
  • Full authority over how your department runs
  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Uncapped PTO, parental leave, paid volunteer time
  • Home office allowance
  • A fast-moving, experimentation-friendly environment where the right ideas actually ship
  • And more! (See our careers page)

What you will be expected to do

● Own application security responsibility for assigned business functions by performing threat

application product.

fixes through to closure.

actively triage false positives.

Istio service mesh, Keycloak/OIDC configurations, and IAM across AWS, DigitalOcean, GCP, and
Firebase.

including BOLA, BFLA, and privilege escalation.

and Firebase.

pipelines.

policies), and IAM concepts across at least one major cloud provider.

● Ability to script/automate (e.g., Python, Bash) to streamline testing, data collection, and
reporting.
● Interest in or experience with building AI based security tools that improve coverage or reduce
manual toil.

jobs.excerpt: About VictoriaMetricsWe are the company behind the popular open-source, high-performance time-series database and monitoring solution of the same name: VictoriaMetrics.
jobs.description:
About VictoriaMetrics

We are the company behind the popular open-source, high-performance time-series database and monitoring solution of the same name: VictoriaMetrics. We’ve also recently introduced our open source logs management solution, VictoriaLogs as well as a new open source database for traces, VictoriaTraces.

Fortune 500 companies use our products as their core observability solution. Our services are used by Spotify, WIX, Grammarly, CERN and thousands others. Our open source products have been downloaded 1B+ times to date.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who lives in the terminal and is passionate about system performance. In this role, you will be a key technical expert and the bridge between the Enterprise version of our open source Observability platform and our customers' most complex Linux-based infrastructures.

You won't just be selling software; you will be consulting with principal Software Engineers and Development Leads to help them instrument their applications, derive the best solution for their specific footprint, and gain actionable visibility into their distributed systems. As a Senior member of the team, you will focus on handling our most complex technical engagements and working closely with our Development team.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Technical Discovery & Consultation

  • Partner with Enterprise Sales to lead technical discovery for our largest strategic accounts, digging deep into the customer's current monitoring stack (metrics, logs, traces) and observability needs.

  • Consult with customers to analyze their infrastructure footprint (On-prem Linux, Cloud, Hybrid) and derive the most efficient, high-performance solution architecture using our Enterprise capabilities.

  • Act as a trusted advisor on observability and instrumentation best practices, articulating the distinct value of Enterprise features (such as advanced security, multi-tenancy, and downsampling) compared to the open source offering.

Advanced Solution Design & Demonstration

  • Architect and demonstrate sophisticated use cases for observability.

  • Lead the design and execution of complex Proof of Concepts (POCs) that prove value by instrumenting real workloads, often requiring hands-on work with Linux agents or OpenTelemetry collectors.

  • Architect scalable deployment plans for our agents/collectors across large-scale infrastructure (Kubernetes clusters, VMs, bare metal).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Development team to translate customer requirements into technical specifications and provide feedback on product capabilities.

  • Collaborate with the dedicated Support team to ensure technical success during complex Proof of Concepts and seamless handoffs for new customers.

  • Collaborate with Product Management to advocate for strategic features that support the evolving landscape of cloud-native infrastructure (e.g., eBPF, WASM).

  • Create advanced technical content (white papers, blog posts, sample dashboards, scripts) that establishes authority in the engineering community.

Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • Experience: 5+ years in Pre-Sales, SRE, DevOps, or Systems Engineering roles, with a proven track record of managing complex technical sales cycles.

  • Linux Mastery: You are an expert in the terminal. You know how to troubleshoot CPU spikes, memory leaks, and disk I/O bottlenecks using standard Linux tools (top, strace, tcpdump, vmstat) and can teach others how to do the same.

  • Observability DNA: Deep understanding of the "Three Pillars" (Logs, Metrics, Traces) and the business value of reducing MTTR (Mean Time To Resolve).

  • Problem Solving: You approach troubleshooting through the lens of observability. You can diagnose why metrics are missing, identify high-cardinality churn, optimize slow queries, or determine why alerts are failing to trigger.

Technical Skills

  • OS Internals: Deep knowledge of Linux distributions (RedHat/CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian) and core concepts (Systemd, File Systems, Networking).

  • Observability Tools: Experience with metrics products such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Splunk, or Datadog.

  • Containerization: Hands-on experience with Docker and container principles.

  • Scripting: Proficiency in Bash and at least one high-level language (Python, Go, or Ruby) for automation.

  • Networking: Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, and Load Balancing.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Kubernetes (instrumenting sidecars, DaemonSets, Helm charts) at scale.

  • Knowledge of at least one SSO provider and authentication workflows.

  • Advanced proficiency with PromQL for constructing complex queries.

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (ArgoCD, Terraform, Ansible, SaltStack).

  • Experience contributing to open-source projects.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Competitive Base Salary.

  • Remote-first culture / Flexible PTO.

  • Passionate team members.

  • Startup atmosphere.

This is not a Product Owner or delivery-management role focused on writing tickets and managing developers. Your primary mandate is to make sure our hotel customers successfully adopt, use, and get measurable value out of our platform. You'll spend your time understanding customer workflows, running experiments, and figuring out what drives real adoption — not executing a fixed roadmap handed to you.

What You'll Own

Hotel portal

Guest Communication platform

Revenue dashboards

Reviews and reputation management

Performance metrics and reporting

Customer notifications and emails

Onboarding experience

Product adoption and engagement

Client feedback collection and prioritization

What You'll Do

  • Define product vision and roadmap for our customer-facing products.
  • Deeply understand customer workflows and pain points — get close to real hoteliers, not just data.
  • Analyze user behavior using product analytics to find what's working and what's not.
  • Improve activation, adoption, engagement, and retention across the portal and related tools.
  • Optimize conversion from emails and notifications into real product usage.
  • Run customer interviews and usability testing as a core part of how you work.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, Design, and Engineering.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly based on customer impact and business value.
  • Define success metrics and monitor product KPIs on an ongoing basis.
  • Drive continuous, iterative improvements to the overall customer experience.

Requirements

  • What We're Looking For:
    • Entrepreneurial Mindset — You turn problems into opportunities, take ownership, test ideas quickly, and always find a way forward.
    • Customer-Obsessed — You'd rather talk to ten hoteliers than guess from a dashboard. You translate what you hear into product decisions.
    • Results-Driven — You care about impact, not process. You learn, measure, and iterate until adoption and engagement actually move.
    • Strong Execution — You move fast, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver. You turn 4-month projects into 4-week wins.
    • Solution-Oriented — You don't stop at "it's impossible." You propose alternatives, build them, and make them happen.
    • Resilience & Grit — You stay hands-on when things get tough and thrive on challenges.

      Requirements:

      • Experience building and owning client-facing platforms or portals — not just internal or backend products.

jobs.description:
Contract Psychologist 1099 / Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) – ABA Centers

1099 Independent Contractor | Remote

When providing services as a BCBA: $70–$110 per hour (based on experience and qualifications)

When providing services as a Licensed Psychologist: $80–$150 per hour (based on experience and qualifications)

Who We Are

We are the nation’s fastest-growing provider of autism care, delivering high-quality Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy across a rapidly expanding footprint. Since our founding in 2020, we’ve scaled from a single clinic to nearly 70 operating areas in more than a dozen states, supported by a high-performance corporate infrastructure and data-driven decision-making.

 

Recognized as the #5 fastest-growing private company in America by Inc. magazine, ABA Centers is a self-funded, founder-led organization—a rarity in today’s healthcare landscape. We’ve achieved this growth without private equity, relying instead on operational discipline, smart capital allocation, and a relentless focus on outcomes.

 

Our Origin Story

ABA Centers was founded by a father whose personal journey navigating autism care for his daughter revealed deep gaps in access, consistency, and quality across the system. Determined to disrupt the status quo in the autism care field and eliminate the unacceptably long wait lists for treatment, he built a company rooted in compassion, clinical excellence, and a relentless commitment to care that makes a difference.

 

Recognition & Awards

Our commitment to operational excellence, ethical leadership, and transformative care has earned our company and leadership national recognition from trusted sources, including:

  • Inc. 5000 – 5th Fastest-Growing Private Company in America
  • Financial Times – #1 on "The Americas' Fastest Growing Companies" 
  • EY Entrepreneur Of The Year® U.S. Overall
  • South Florida Business Journal’s Top 100 Companies
  • Florida Trend Magazine's 500 Most Influential Business Leaders
  • Inc. Best in Business, Health Services 

POSITION SUMMARY & PURPOSE

ABA Centers of America provides year-round therapeutic intervention for children, adolescents, and adults with autism spectrum disorder using the science of applied behavior analysis (ABA). Services are delivered in clinic, home, and community settings.

This dual-role 1099 contractor position combines the clinical responsibilities of a Licensed Psychologist (under the Director of the Diagnostic Services Department) with those of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst. The contractor will complete psychological/neuropsychological evaluations, review and sign reports, supervise and train diagnostic staff, and also maintain a caseload of 6–9 learners receiving insurance-funded or private-pay ABA services. The principal functions identified shall not be considered a complete description of all work requirements. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

POSITION ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

As Psychologist / Diagnostic Services

  • Provide comprehensive neuropsychological, psychological, and/or psychoeducational evaluations of clients with referral concerns related to learning, behavioral, emotional, and/or social difficulties.
  • Conduct in-person and/or virtual evaluations.
  • Provide written and oral feedback to clients (or legal guardians) regarding results, diagnostic impressions, and recommendations.
  • Compile written reports detailing evaluation findings, diagnosis(es), and recommendations for the medical record and sharing with patients/guardians and referral sources (in accordance with HIPAA).
  • Ensure timely documentation upload per departmental policy.
  • Provide direct supervision (individual/group) and training of Neuropsychological Testing/Assessment to Diagnostic Specialists (Psychometrists/Technicians).
  • Participate in weekly Regional Clinical Training Meetings and present at Weekly Psychology Assessment Didactic Seminars (PADS).
  • Remain current in the field and pursue continuing education related to pediatric psychological/neuropsychological testing.
  • Maintain an active license and good standing with the state board of psychology.
  • Comply with ABA Centers of America’s HIPAA privacy and security policies.

As Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA)

  • Design, implement, and monitor skill-acquisition and behavior-reduction programs.
  • Research literature related to specific learners’ programs.
  • Oversee the implementation of behavior-analytic programs by RBTs and caregivers.
  • Conduct assessments related to the need for behavioral intervention (e.g., preference assessments, functional assessments,
  • staff performance assessments).
  • Analyze and summarize assessment results and graph data as needed.
  • Write 6-month progress reports to secure insurance funding.
  • Provide staff and caregiver training.
  • Facilitate team meetings for each learner every other week.
  • Create goals for skill generalization and update program sheets as skills meet criteria.
  • Create or update data collection systems.
  • Be available to answer questions from technicians and caregivers; follow up to ensure generalization of objectives.
  • Complete and submit documentation in a timely manner to the billing agency.
  • Oversee the restricted hours of 1–2 Apprentices.
  • Oversee a maximum of 3 trainees seeking supervision toward Supervised Fieldwork experience (weekly 1-hour meetings,
  • documentation review, and competency development using BTS in program writing, training, assessments, parent training,
  • treatment plans, and other analytical tasks).
  • Delegate case management tasks to competent trainees and provide feedback.
  • Be willing and able to supervise others seeking BCBA certification weekly.
  • Shared / Collaborative Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with families, schools, and ASD service providers in the child’s community.
  • Collaborate with all team members to facilitate the mission of ABA Centers of America, including attending routine
  • departmental and general staff meetings.
  • Actively seek supervision when needed.

Requirements

Education and Experience Requirements

Psychologist track: Doctoral Degree in Clinical Psychology or Developmental Psychology (Psy.D. or Ph.D.) with specific training in assessment of pediatric and adolescent neurodevelopmental disorders, including specific learning disorders, ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, and intellectual disability. Prior training and experience with administration, scoring, and interpretation of neuropsychological tests required. Experience administering measures of Intellectual Functioning, Development, Autism Spectrum Disorder (including the ADOS-2), Social Communication, and Emotional and Behavioral Functioning.

BCBA track: Minimum of a Master’s Degree in Applied Behavior Analysis (required) and current BCBA certification/licensure.

Two years’ experience in the ABA field preferred. Excellent report-writing skills.

  • Ability to effectively collaborate with families, schools, and ASD service providers.
  • Effective organizational, time-management, prioritization, communication, interpersonal, and team skills.
  • Ability to pass background and drug screens.
  • Willingness to sign company NDA and any revisions thereafter.
  • Maintain clean background/drug screenings and driving record (required).
  • English proficiency required; Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Technology / Equipment Used

  • Computer/Laptop
  • Fax/Copy/Scanner Machine
  • Telephone System
  • Calculator

Work Environment / Physical & Mental Demands

Most work (approximately 95%) is performed indoors in a temperature-controlled environment. Potential exposures to workplace violence and hazards are low. Physical and mental demands are consistent with the requirements of providing clinical evaluations and ABA services in clinic, home, and community settings (standing, walking, bending, crouching, carrying, sitting, reading, light lifting, moderate mental stress, and high collaboration with others).

Benefits

Compensation and Contractor Status

  • 1099 Independent Contractor role.
  • Rates as listed above based on the type of service provided and the contractor’s experience/qualifications.
  • Contractors are responsible for their own taxes, licensure, and professional liability coverage.
  • No employee benefits are provided.

jobs.excerpt: Stratos Wealth Enterprises | Reports to: Lou Camacho, President | Flexible location | Travel up to 50% Position summaryAt Stratos Wealth Enterprises, we are building a scaled, high-performing, advisor-centric enterprise.
jobs.description:
Stratos Wealth Enterprises | Reports to: Lou Camacho, President | Flexible location | Travel up to 50%

Position summary

At Stratos Wealth Enterprises, we are building a scaled, high-performing, advisor-centric enterprise. We are seeking a Senior Relationship Manager who will serve as the strategic partner to advisory firms where Stratos Wealth Enterprises holds either an outright, majority, or minority ownership interest. The role will manage our most complex enterprise relationships, sitting at the intersection of consulting, operations, and leadership.

This role carries real accountability. You will own retention, expansion, integration, and operating performance across a portfolio of strategic, acquired, high-value, and unusually complex firms. You will engage founders, chief executives, senior advisors, and operating leaders to set multi-year direction, then convert that direction into measurable outcomes with clear owners and dates.

Success demands the gravitas, judgment, and business acumen to sit across the table from an owner-operator, earn trust quickly, and still challenge them to elevate performance. You will lead through influence rather than authority, align stakeholders across Stratos and our parent company, SEI, and translate enterprise strategy into practical plans that partner firms actually adopt. The role is flexible in location and expects travel up to 50 percent.

Key responsibilities

Strategic relationship leadership

  • Own executive-level relationships for an assigned portfolio of strategic, enterprise, acquired, and integration-intensive firms.
  • Build deep, durable relationships with founders, partners, and senior leadership teams, reducing key-person dependency and broadening sponsorship on both sides of the partnership.
  • Establish multi-year relationship strategies that align firm priorities, Stratos capabilities, commercial objectives, service commitments, and risk considerations.
  • Lead executive business reviews with founders, CEOs, and operating leaders, using data to frame decisions, surface risk, and create accountability.
  • Anticipate retention risk, competitive threats, succession events, leadership change, and service or integration issues, and mobilize a response before value is at risk.
  • Coordinate with Stratos’ Corporate Development and M&A teams to onboard, integrate, and support new firms joining Stratos Wealth Enterprises.

Practice integration and assimilation

  • Lead post-acquisition integration efforts and ensure seamless onboarding into the Stratos ecosystem.
  • Partner with firm leadership to align business models, processes, technology, talent, and culture with enterprise standards while protecting what makes each practice distinctive.
  • Identify integration risk early and implement solutions that accelerate time to value.
  • Connect integration milestones to relationship goals so onboarding, adoption, and growth advance together rather than sequentially.

Commercial growth, value creation, and negotiation

  • Work directly with partners to develop and execute growth strategies, both organic and inorganic.
  • Drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation, advisor productivity, and client experience across the portfolio.
  • Serve as a thought partner on succession planning, talent development, market expansion, and practice economics.
  • Lead or coordinate complex commercial discussions, scope of decisions, service commitments, and negotiations, partnering with finance, legal, compliance, sales, product, and executive leadership as required.
  • Balance growth objectives against fiduciary, suitability, conflict-management, compliance, and client-interest considerations, and maintain a clear, data-supported view of relationship economics, pipeline, and forecast.

Operational excellence and process optimization

  • Evaluate and improve operational workflows to increase efficiency, scalability, and consistency.
  • Implement best practices across finance, technology, compliance, and client service.
  • Promote enterprise-wide adoption of standardized processes while preserving entrepreneurial flexibility where it creates advantage.
  • Identify effective practices in one firm and scale them across the network.

Accountability and performance management

  • Establish clear performance metrics and KPIs tied to growth, profitability, and efficiency.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with partner firms and deliver actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Act as a coach and advisor: challenge assumptions, hold leaders accountable to agreed goals and enterprise standards, and drive performance.
  • Maintain disciplined records of plans, commitments, opportunities, risk indicators, and forecasts in our CRM and reporting tools.

Cross-enterprise leadership and escalations

  • Serve as the key connector between partner firms and internal Stratos and SEI resources.
  • Direct coordinated responses across investment management, operations, service, product, technology, compliance, legal, finance, marketing, onboarding, practice management, and sales.
  • Own major escalations from diagnosis through resolution, establishing decision rights, communications, timelines, and executive visibility.
  • Represent Stratos’ perspective in enterprise prioritization and strategy credibly with partner-firm executives.
  • Mentor other relationship managers, lead selected enterprise initiatives, and strengthen the discipline of segmentation, relationship planning, business reviews, and escalation management.

How success will be measured:

Performance in this role is evaluated across growth, integration, operating, and relationship outcomes:

  • Revenue and earnings growth: expansion of top-line revenue and improvement in EBITDA margins across partner firms.
  • Retention and relationship health across strategic and enterprise accounts, including executive sponsorship and trust, and overall relationship health as measured by Net Promoter Score
  • Operational efficiency: reduced redundancy, improved workflows, and increased scalability.
  • Expense management: optimization of cost structures without compromising growth.
  • Enterprise scale: adoption of shared systems, processes, and strategic initiatives across the network including utilization of Stratos, SIM, and SEI capabilities
  • Integration, transformation, and major-initiative milestones where assigned.
  • Quality and speed of major issue resolution, negotiation, cross-functional execution, mentoring, forecast accuracy, and control discipline.

Compensation consists of a competitive base salary plus performance-based incentive compensation tied to these outcomes.

Core competencies

• Strategic thinking and execution

• Leadership and influence

  • Relationship management and executive presence

• Commercial and financial judgment

• Operational excellence

• Change management

  • Accountability, collaboration, and enterprise mindset

Why this role matters

This role is central to realizing the Stratos vision of a unified, scalable, high-performing enterprise that still preserves the entrepreneurial spirit of our partner firms. The leader who takes it will shape the trajectory of our growth, strengthen our culture, and elevate the performance of the entire network. If you want to build something at scale rather than administer something already built, this is the seat.

Benefits and rewards

To help you stay energized, engaged, and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits through our parent company, SEI, including comprehensive care for your physical and mental well-being, a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, a flexible working environment, support for working parents, and Flexible Time Off so you can relax, recharge, and be there for the people you care about.

Equal employment opportunity

Stratos Wealth Enterprises and SEI are equal opportunity and affirmative action employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color,

religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Requirements

What we need from you

  • Ten to fifteen or more years of senior experience in wealth management, registered investment advisers, advisor platforms, custody, asset management, broker-dealer services, financial services consulting, or comparable strategic client coverage.
  • A proven track record of working directly with founders, business owners, and executive teams, and of owning complex, high-value business relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex integrations, transformations, or scaling initiatives, and to carry major negotiations and escalations to resolution.
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience driving P&L performance and operational improvement, and deep knowledge of advisor and wealth-firm economics and operating models.
  • Working command of investment and custody concepts, platform technology, and the regulatory environment supporting RIAs and hybrid firms.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with executive presence, credibility, and the ability to deliver constructive challenge.
  • Experience influencing without direct authority and aligning diverse stakeholders around a common vision, along with a high level of emotional intelligence, adaptability, and resilience.
  • FINRA Series 65 or Series 66 registration, active.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, and willingness to travel up to 50 percent.

What we would like from you

  • Experience with enterprise RIAs, acquired practices, national advisor platforms, multi-custody firms, or complex hybrid organizations.
  • Experience leading post-acquisition integration, transformation, succession planning, practice growth, or executive-level business planning.
  • FINRA Series 7 registration, and a CFP, CIMA, CRPC, CFA, or MBA credential.
  • Fluency with CRM, portfolio accounting, financial planning, and custodial platforms.
  • Experience mentoring relationship professionals or leading relationship management practice without necessarily having direct reports.
  • Consulting or advisory experience serving owner-led businesses through periods of rapid growth or change.
  • Someone who will embody our values of People First, Empower Entrepreneurs, Positive Can-Do Attitude, Embrace Collaboration, and Do the Right Thing.

About Halborn Inc

Our mission is to provide value-add security services and products to the world’s most cutting edge technology firms and that starts with blockchain tech. Founded in 2019, Halborn is an elite cyber security company focused on solving complex adversarial problems unique to the cryptocurrency and fintech industries. From breaches and social engineering to stolen private keys and economic hacks, Halborn solves it. Our clientele are the exclusive blockchain companies as well as new startups with high growth trajectories.

Our Culture

Halborn is a globally distributed team of 100+, looking to grow our elite team of white hat hackers, sales professionals, security engineers and DevSecOps specialists who value independence, want to make their own hours, work for themselves and have a passion for the ever evolving cryptocurrency industry.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Halborn Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, education, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics and celebrates the diversity of its growing team.

We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas at this time.

Recruitment agencies and consultants may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Halborn does not accept unsolicited agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Halborn Inc.

We are looking for a full stack developer who is comfortable owning a feature from the database schema to the last pixel and who already builds with AI as a core part of how they work, not as a novelty. You will build the platforms our security researchers use to run engagements, the products our clients use to consume findings, and the AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate at a scale that should not be possible. The work is real product engineering against real adversarial conditions, and the security bar is high because our customers are the reason it has to be.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and ship features end to end across a React and TypeScript front end and Python or Node.js services, taking ownership from technical design through production support.
  • Model data and design APIs that hold up as requirements change — clear contracts, sane migrations, and schemas that will not need to be rescued in six months.
  • Build AI-native product capabilities: LLM orchestration, agentic and multi-step workflows, retrieval over engagement data, and structured output that downstream systems can rely on.
  • Use AI coding tooling aggressively in your own development loop while maintaining the review discipline that keeps generated code from becoming a liability.
  • Automate internal engineering and security workflows, turning processes our researchers currently run by hand into durable product surface.
  • Write secure code by default — input validation, authentication and authorization, secrets handling, dependency hygiene — and treat security review as part of shipping, not a gate at the end.
  • Participate in code review as both author and reviewer, raising the standard of the codebase rather than just approving diffs.
  • Deploy and operate what you build: containerized services, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and the on-call ownership that comes with running production systems.
  • Collaborate directly with security researchers, auditors, and product stakeholders to translate deep domain expertise into software that non-experts can use.
  • Contribute to technical direction — framework choices, architecture, and the tradeoffs behind them — and document decisions so the team can move without you in the room.

Qualifications

  • 4 or more years building and shipping production web applications, with genuine ownership on both the front end and the back end.
  • Strong React and TypeScript, including modern state management, component architecture, and CSS competent enough to build an interface without a designer hovering.
  • Strong server-side skills in Python, Node.js, or both, with production experience designing REST or GraphQL APIs.
  • Solid relational database experience — PostgreSQL preferred — including schema design, query performance, and migrations.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines you configured yourself.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward development practice: you integrate LLM APIs into real products, you use AI coding assistants as part of your daily loop, and you can articulate where they accelerate you and where they need a human.
  • Security-minded engineering instincts and a working understanding of common web vulnerability classes and how to prevent them.
  • Excellent asynchronous written communication and the self-direction to own outcomes across time zones without being managed day to day.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity in a constantly changing and evolving work environment where growth is non-stop.
  • Willingness to learn the technical aspects of blockchain and cybersecurity.

Bonus Points

  • Web3 development experience — ethers.js or viem, wallet integrations, RPC providers, or Solidity and Rust smart contract familiarity.
  • Experience building agentic systems, working with the Model Context Protocol, vector databases, or evaluation frameworks for LLM features.
  • DevSecOps experience: infrastructure as code, secrets management, supply chain security, or automated security scanning in CI.
  • Prior work at a cybersecurity, fintech, or crypto company, or on products handling sensitive customer data.
  • Experience taking a product from zero to one on a small team.
  • Open source contributions.
  • Knowledgeable of the latest trends in Blockchain and DeFi.

jobs.excerpt: About Halborn Inc Our mission is to provide value-add security services and products to the world’s most cutting edge technology firms and that starts with blockchain tech.
jobs.description:
About Halborn Inc

Our mission is to provide value-add security services and products to the world’s most cutting edge technology firms and that starts with blockchain tech. Founded in 2019, Halborn is an elite cyber security company focused on solving complex adversarial problems unique to the cryptocurrency and fintech industries. From breaches and social engineering to stolen private keys and economic hacks, Halborn solves it. Our clientele are the exclusive blockchain companies as well as new startups with high growth trajectories.

Our Culture

Halborn is a globally distributed team of 100+, looking to grow our elite team of white hat hackers, sales professionals, security engineers and DevSecOps specialists who value independence, want to make their own hours, work for themselves and have a passion for the ever evolving cryptocurrency industry.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Halborn Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, education, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics and celebrates the diversity of its growing team.

We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas at this time.

Recruitment agencies and consultants may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Halborn does not accept unsolicited agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Halborn Inc.

Responsibilities

  • Own the test strategy for Halborn's internal engineering platforms and client-facing products, from unit and integration coverage through end-to-end and regression suites.
  • Design, build and maintain automated test suites in code — UI, API, and data-layer — and keep them fast, deterministic, and trusted by the engineers who depend on them.
  • Use LLM-assisted tooling to accelerate test authoring, generate edge cases from specs and diffs, triage failing runs, and summarize regressions for the team.
  • Build and tune quality gates in CI/CD so that broken builds never reach a client environment, and so that the feedback loop stays measured in minutes.
  • Identify manual QA processes and automate them out of existence — release checklists, environment setup, test data generation, smoke verification, reporting.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and file defects with unambiguous repro steps, expected versus actual behavior, and enough context for an engineer to fix it without a follow-up conversation.
  • Partner with security engineers to fold security regression checks — authentication, authorization, input handling, secrets exposure — into the standard pipeline.
  • Run performance, load, and reliability testing against services handling sensitive audit and engagement data.
  • Define and report the quality metrics that matter: escaped defect rate, flake rate, coverage of critical paths, and time to detection.
  • Contribute to release readiness decisions and act as an informed voice on whether something ships.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years in QA engineering, SDET, or test automation, with a demonstrated shift from manual execution toward automated coverage.
  • Strong programming ability in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python — you write test code that other engineers are willing to read and maintain.
  • Hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent.
  • Practical API testing experience, including contract, integration, and negative-path testing against REST or GraphQL services.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar) and comfort owning pipeline configuration yourself.
  • Daily, deliberate use of AI coding assistants and LLM tooling in your own workflow, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they must be verified.
  • Comfort with Git, containerized local environments, and reading application code to understand what you are testing rather than testing blind.
  • Excellent written communication — in a distributed, asynchronous team, a well-written bug report or test plan is the deliverable.
  • High autonomy and strong self-direction in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift.
  • Willingness to learn the technical aspects of blockchain, smart contracts, and cybersecurity.

Bonus Points

  • Experience testing Web3 applications — wallet flows, testnets, RPC interactions, or smart contract tooling such as Foundry or Hardhat.
  • Experience building evaluation harnesses for LLM-powered features, including regression testing of non-deterministic output.
  • Background in security testing, OWASP methodology, or hands-on time with tools like Burp Suite.
  • Performance and load testing with k6, Locust, JMeter, or similar.
  • Experience with observability tooling and using production telemetry to find gaps in test coverage.
  • Open source contributions to testing frameworks or developer tooling.
  • Knowledgeable of the latest trends in Blockchain and DeFi.

jobs.description:
Pay: $60–$120/hour equivalent, paid per accepted task

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor

Time Commitment: 15+ hours per week

Schedule: Flexible

micro1 is looking for Computational Mathematicians, Statisticians, and Optimization Experts with prior professional AI-training or model-evaluation experience to support a project focused on improving advanced AI systems.

You will use your mathematical expertise and programming skills to create challenging technical tasks, evaluate model-generated code and reasoning, identify failures, and establish objective standards for correct solutions. This role is intended for candidates who have completed substantive AI-training work involving mathematical, statistical, or optimization content.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Create realistic computational mathematics and statistics tasks that challenge advanced AI models.
  2. Develop task instructions, reproducible environments, reference solutions, and evaluation criteria.
  3. Evaluate model-generated proofs, calculations, code, models, optimizations, and technical deliverables.
  4. Identify logical errors, invalid assumptions, numerical instability, incorrect statistical methods, or reproducibility failures.

Required Qualifications

  1. Prior paid experience training, evaluating, benchmarking, or improving AI systems on mathematical or technical tasks.
  2. Strong practical proficiency with Python.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one relevant mathematical specialization.
  4. Hands-on experience using computational methods for numerical analysis, optimization, statistics, theorem proving, modeling, or scientific computing.

Relevant specializations may include applied mathematics, scientific computing, operations research, optimization, formal mathematics, theorem proving, probability, statistics, numerical methods, and mathematical modeling.

Public Proof of Skill

Strong applicants should provide evidence such as:

  1. Peer-reviewed publications or preprints
  2. Public mathematical, statistical, or optimization code
  3. Google Scholar, ORCID, arXiv, or equivalent research profiles
  4. Open-source numerical or mathematical software contributions
  5. Competition, theorem-proving, or optimization results
  6. Reproducible notebooks, models, proofs, benchmarks, or technical projects

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience creating AI-training tasks, reference answers, rubrics, graders, or benchmark problems.
  2. Experience reviewing other AI trainers’ technical submissions.
  3. A master’s degree, PhD, or equivalent record of substantial computational work.
  4. Experience with NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, pandas, Pyomo, OR-Tools, Lean, Coq, or comparable tools.
  5. Experience validating numerical solutions, statistical results, optimization outputs, or formal proofs.
  6. Availability to begin immediately.

Application Process

  1. Submit your application, AI-training experience, specialization, and public technical evidence.
  2. Complete an AI interview containing technical and integrity checks.
  3. Complete a hiring-manager review.
  4. If selected, complete project onboarding and begin your first assigned task.

Compensation

  1. Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid for tasks that meet project specifications and quality requirements. Task availability and completion time may vary.

Location: Bremen / Remote in Germany · Full-time

About Synera

Synera builds the AI agent platform that lets hardware engineers connect their tools and automate their workflows. We sell to the world's leading engineering organizations and we run our own company the same way we build our product: automated, data-driven, and AI-first

About the role

We are building an internal superagent: an AI layer over all of Synera's business data and tools that every employee can delegate work to. Its intelligence is only as good as the data underneath it, and that data foundation is yours to own, build, and shape.

That means the data warehouse, expanded from a GTM reporting store into Synera's system of insight: GTM data, product telemetry, engineering work, support, finance, and everything in between. It means every connector into it and the interfaces that let agents query it. And it means working with every team to get their data out of heads and meetings and into a form an agent can use. An agent is only as intelligent as the data underneath it. We are looking for a builder.

Who you are:

  • SQL is second nature; you have built ETL/data pipelines (Airflow or similar) and data models and are strong in data extraction and transformation.

  • You have built the data layer behind LLM applications: retrieval, embeddings and vector search, context design, MCP and comparable tool interfaces. Hands-on evidence beats a course.

  • You have integrated multiple systems: APIs, webhooks, auth models, rate limits and unannounced schema changes. You can debug a discrepancy across three tools until you find which definition was wrong, and you think about data access and privacy by default.

  • An automator by instinct: scripts, APIs, workflow tools, and AI agents are how you scale yourself. You use LLMs as a daily working tool, not a novelty and the idea of building the data brain behind a company-wide AI agent excites you.

  • You have built reporting and forecasting people actually use and know the difference between a dashboard and an answer.

  • You work in English confidently; German is a plus. You communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues, sales reps, marketers, and executives alike.

  • Ownership mentality: you document what you build, you notice what nobody asked about, and you would rather fix the system than the symptom

Why this role

You will own a whole machine, not a slice of one, with the mandate, the modern stack, and the AI tooling to build leverage instead of backlog. You will lay the data foundation for Synera's superagent, and you report into Business Operations with a direct line to how the company is run.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the data warehouse (Timescale): Synera's single source of truth for data, it's design and development to always be cutting edge.

  • Extract data from our GTM and business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, product, finance, ...) into our data warehouse reliably, and structure & annotate it so it can be queried.

  • Build and own data flows: ETL pipelines (Airflow/Timescale), data models, and the sync jobs that keep systems consistent.

  • Turn data into foresight: build the reporting and forecasting layer (Power BI, Salesforce reports, forecast models) that leadership runs on and extrapolate from pipeline, funnel, and usage data to where the business is heading.

  • Make the data agent-ready: model and expose it (warehouse models, APIs, MCP connectors, permissions, governance) so AI agents, and ultimately our superagent, can consume it.

  • Build the retrieval layer for what is not in tables (documents, wiki content, tickets, meeting transcripts): chunking, embeddings, indexing. Agents working on outdated data give outdated and often wrong answers.

  • Engineer, don't improvise: transformations are version-controlled, tested, and documented..

  • Treat data quality as a product: monitoring, validation, and hygiene are built in,

  • Team enablement: You partner with every team to get their data into the warehouse and into a state an agent can act on, and change how it gets created so machine-readable is the default.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • 3 months: you own the warehouse and its ingestion landscape end to end, the datasets the reporting and forecasting cycle runs on reconcile, and you have a prioritized map of the company data the superagent is missing.

  • 6 months: Across Synera, data flows are documented, monitored, and trustworthy; team self-serve the answers they used to ask you for.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • 12 months: your data foundation becomes the knowledge layer of Synera's superagent. AI agents across the company answer questions and execute work on data you made trustworthy.

Neptune Software is the AI execution layer for SAP. Enterprises are moving from software that records to software that acts — AI agents running routine work while people govern the exceptions. What stands in the way isn't the models; it's that the logic agents need to act on is locked inside SAP. Neptune runs inside the customer's own landscape and makes that logic executable by AI: agent-ready context, governed tools, and applications where agents act under the customer's own authorizations, with guardrails enforced by the platform — not by the prompt. With Naia, our AI layer, teams build from natural language and deploy agents on ECC today that carry to S/4HANA unchanged, always at Clean Core. SAP-certified, 500+ enterprises, fifteen years in production: we are where core business systems learn to act.

Location

Remote - Spain

Position
As a Product Manager, you will act as a conduit between our customers, all our internal teams, and the community at large. You will work with clients to understand their needs and desires and use your technical and communication skills to align them to internal workstreams within Engineering, Solution Consulting, and Marketing. In addition, you will work closely with our Customer Success department.

As a Product Manager, you will explore and develop product ideas, whether as a result of discussions with clients and partners, via market research, or by investigating open-source technologies. You will help craft, manage, and roll out comprehensive enablement material via marketing channels, community content, and social media.

You will be hands on with the products and services that our internal and external customers utilize, understanding its benefits and limitations, focusing on bringing the best out of every facet of the platform and the supporting ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Thorough understanding of the overall market, leading vendors, and open-source technologies
  • Work closely with stakeholders (customers, partners, and community) to understand needs and priorities
  • Translate market and stakeholder needs into product requirements
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Solution Consulting team on feature ideas to prioritize and bring potential solutions to life
  • Drive the Business Development in close alignment with our Customer Success team as well as the Sales team
  • Become the Company’s Product Advocate and outbound spokesperson via video content, podcasts, webinars, and written releases
  • Co-own product specifications, requirements, and release plans
  • Collect and synthesize inputs from Engineering, Sales, Marketing team, and the general market to lead business and products direction
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure quality product output, timeliness, and market requirements
  • Drive and operate internal Project Management and Pre-Sales topics in collaboration with other teams in Neptune Software
  • Nurture and grow developer (& partner) community, Neptune Heroes, Social Media presence Create internal and external technical enablement material and collaterals for internal (Pre-Sales) and external audiences (Academy, E-Learning, and Classroom-Training)
  • Create internal competitive analysis content
  • Maintain a growing library of Marketplace items, consisting of modular Application Building Blocks to comprehensive Add-On solutions designed to enhance the product offering
  • Contribute towards the roll out of our innovative AI Assistant integration
  • Assist with various internal project initiatives to help improve quality of work and service within the business and for our customers
  • Contribute toward the management and improvement of the public facing demo environment

your profile

  • Bachelor/Master’s degree in computer science or software product management
  • 3 - 7 years of software product management or related experience
  • Strong technical aptitude — comfortable with software architecture concepts and hands-on with AI tools; formal coding experience is helpful but not essential
  • Exceptional strategic communications skills
  • Experience with enterprise architecture
  • A confident and trusted advisor who can provide accurate inside into market development and client needs
  • Customer and service-oriented mindset and like to pass on knowledge and experience
  • Networking is not a foreign concept, you have the ability to build effective working relationships and work closely with our global go-to-market team and local sales team, but also with our customers and partners
  • Able to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a hands-on mentality in a hyper-growth environment
  • Strategic mindset, long-term-planning with passion for detail and excellence
  • First-class written skills in English
  • Comfortable working in Confluence and GitHub — documenting specs and decisions, and navigating repos, issues, and pull requests alongside Engineering
  • Experience with low-code / no-code application platforms is a plus, not a requirement — we will train the right candidate
  • SAP knowledge (ECC, S/4HANA, or ABAP/SAP development) is a plus, not a requirement
  • Microsoft or cloud platform technology know-how is welcome

why us?

  • International work environment;
  • Emerging and leading technology;
  • Work on exciting projects for the largest companies in the world;
  • The opportunity to be part of a success story.
  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunity to build real things and make a difference by putting your code into production.

With offices in New Jersey, Boston, Costa Rica, and Eastern Europe, we execute the full software lifecycle, from architecture and design through development, QA and application maintenance & support. You will lead architectural decision-making across multiple workstreams, produce reference architectures and migration roadmaps, and work hands-on with engineering teams tovalidatedesigns through prototypes and proofs of concept. What qualificationsmake youanAubrantArchitectand Lead?

  • You are comfortable navigating hybrid environments. You understand that modernization is rarely a clean lift-and-shift; you know how to design transitional architectures that bridgeon-premisesystems and cloud services without disrupting business operations.
  • You communicate architecture in business terms. When you present to senior leaders, you translate technical trade-offs into cost, risk, timeline, and capability impact.
  • You have a builder's instinct. Youvalidateyour designs with working prototypes and proofs of concept, not just diagrams. You believe architecture should be proven, not assumed.
  • You thrive in ambiguity. Legacy modernization is messy; you bring structure, prioritization, and clarity to environments where documentation issparseand tribal knowledge is the norm.

Responsibilities:

  • Design andvalidatemigration strategies (re-platform, re-architect, re-factor) for individual system components, balancing speed, risk, and long-term maintainability.
  • Build and oversee proofs of concept and reference implementations that de-risk critical architectural decisions before full-scale engineering begins.

Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Present architectural strategies, options, and progress to senior technical and business leadership, translating complex technical concepts into clear business impact.
  • Collaborate with the client's existing architecture, engineering, and infrastructure teams toalignstandards, governance, and shared technical direction.
  • Partner with program management to ensure architectural decisions are reflected in delivery plans, resource needs, and risk assessments.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, orrelateddiscipline, or equivalent experience.
  • MUST be proficient in written and spoken English (85%).
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in asolutionsarchitect or enterprise architect capacity.
  • Demonstrated mastery of architectural design across the full application stack: front-end (React, Angular, or equivalent modern frameworks), API/services tier (RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures), and data layer (relational databases, NoSQL, data pipelines).
  • Deepexpertisein Microsoft Azure cloud services, including App Services, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure DevOps, and AzureNetworking(VNets, Private Link, ExpressRoute).

  • Strong experience with application modernization strategies: monolith decomposition, strangler fig pattern, database migration, and phased re-platforming.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Reporting to executive leadership, the Senior Director of Product Management – Risk & Quality is a key leader within Innovaccer’s Payer vertical. In this role, you will hold end-to-end accountability for the product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market (GTM) execution across our Risk Adjustment, RADV/Audit Readiness, Quality (HEDIS/Stars), and Compliance solution portfolio.

We are looking for a seasoned product leader who possesses deep domain expertise in clinical and financial risk operations across Commercial (ACA), Medicare Advantage, and Managed Medicaid markets. You will translate complex regulatory requirements, coding workflows, and risk-capture dynamics into a market-leading, AI-native product platform that drives verifiable revenue accuracy, audit defensibility, and operational efficiency for our health plan partners.

A Day in the Life

1. Product Strategy & Domain Leadership (Risk & Quality)

  • End-to-End Portfolio Vision: Own the multi-year product strategy for Risk Adjustment (Prospective, Concurrent, and Retrospective), RADV Audit Management, Risk Analytics, and integrated Quality/HEDIS products.
  • AI-First Innovation: Translate market needs into an AI-native product roadmap—leveraging NLP, LLMs, and automated chart retrieval/coding engines to eliminate manual touchpoints and maximize risk accuracy.
  • Regulatory Agility: Stay ahead of evolving CMS, HHS, and state regulatory landscapes (e.g., V28 model updates, RADV audit rule changes, submission deadlines) to ensure continuous product compliance and market differentiation.
  • Strategic Alignment: Partner with VP Payer, CPO, and Market President- Payer Growth to shape the overall Payer product narrative and co-own revenue targets for your products.

2. Execution, Architecture & AI-Native Product Craft

  • Harmonized Suite: Direct and develop product managers to unify risk analytics, suspecting, chart review, coding workflows, and audit trail tools into a single, seamless product experience.
  • AI-Native Operational Rigor: Enforce an AI-first development lifecycle—from discovery and automated feedback synthesis to generative prototyping and intelligent backlog management.
  • Delivery & Quality: Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Clinical SMEs, and Platform teams to build scalably on Innovaccer's Healthcare Intelligence Cloud, maintaining a predictable release cadence.
  • Impact & ROI Metrics: Establish strict outcome-based success metrics (e.g., chart review accuracy, suspecting yield rates, RADV audit mitigation rate, coding velocity) and track customer value realization.

3. Customer, GTM & Market Engagement

  • Executive Single Point of Contact (SPOC): Build direct relationships with plan executives (CMOs, Chief Risk Officers, Actuarial Leads, VPs of Risk Adjustment) to understand operational pain points and serve as the product authority for strategic discussions and escalations.
  • GTM Enablement & Revenue Co-Ownership: Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success to refine sales pitches, participate in key customer pursuits, support upsell/cross-sell initiatives, and validate product-market fit.
  • Industry Representation: Represent Innovaccer’s Risk Adjustment perspective in external forums, industry advisory boards, and regulatory consultations.

What You Need

  • Experience: 10+ years in Product Management or related technology leadership roles, with at least 5+ years of direct experience building and scaling Risk Adjustment, RADV/Audit, or Quality solutions for health plans/payers.
  • Domain Mastery: Deep expertise in Risk Adjustment methodologies (CMS-HCC, RxHCC, HHS-HCC), coding workflows (ICD-10, MEAT criteria), retrospective chart reviews, prospective point-of-care nudges, and RADV audit prep.
  • AI & Data Fluency: Proven track record of shipping AI/ML capabilities into healthcare workflows (e.g., NLP for unstructured clinical documentation, predictive suspecting models, generative summaries for coders).
  • Enterprise Scale: Demonstrated success in shipping and embedding SaaS products within complex payer environments and multi-payer enterprise systems.
  • People Leadership: Strong track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product management teams while fostering a culture of ownership and AI adoption.
  • Communication & Influence: Exceptional memo-writing and executive presentation skills; comfortable discussing risk models with actuaries, NLP accuracy with data scientists, and ROI with CFOs.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Business, or related quantitative field required; Master’s/Advanced degree preferred.

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

Here’s What We Offer

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
  • Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
  • Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.

Wir stehen vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschub – mit klarem Produkt-Markt-Fit, KI-first-DNA, gesellschaftlichem Hebel und einem einzigartigen Marktzugang, den kein anderer Anbieter in dieser Form replizieren kann.

jobs.title: Business Improvement Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Job description:The RoleThe Process and System Specialist will own the ongoing analysis, improvement, documentation, and implementation of the company's operational systems and processes.
jobs.description:
Job description:

The Role

The Process and System Specialist will own the ongoing analysis, improvement, documentation, and implementation of the company's operational systems and processes.

This role sits at the intersection of people, processes, systems, technology, and organizational change. You will investigate how work is actually being done, compare execution against documented processes, identify root causes, design practical improvements, document the new standard, implement changes, and measure whether they are working.

The goal is not to create documentation for its own sake. The goal is to build an operating environment where processes are clear, systems support execution, responsibilities are understood, changes are adopted, and critical knowledge is not dependent on individual employees.

This is an analysis-heavy role (approximately 70% analysis / 30% communication and persuasion) for someone who enjoys turning operational complexity into clear, scalable systems.

What You'll Own

1. Process Analysis & Operational Diagnostics

  • Audit existing processes, workflows, and SOPs against actual day-to-day execution.
  • Map how work moves across teams, systems, and functions.
  • Identify gaps between how work is supposed to happen, how it actually happens, and what the systems support.
  • Shadow and interview team members to understand real-world workflows and operational friction.
  • Identify bottlenecks, duplication, unnecessary steps, handoff failures, and recurring issues.
  • Determine whether problems are caused by process design, systems, documentation, capability, accountability, or unclear ownership.
  • Use data and evidence to validate problems rather than relying solely on anecdotal feedback.
  • Translate findings into clear recommendations and prioritized improvement opportunities.

2. Process Design & Improvement

  • Design clear, practical, and scalable processes that improve consistency, efficiency, accuracy, and accountability.
  • Break complex problems into smaller, manageable, and testable improvements.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, revenue impact, urgency, feasibility, and potential for quick wins.
  • Redesign workflows where existing processes are inefficient, unclear, or overly dependent on individual knowledge.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or eliminate unnecessary work.
  • Test proposed changes before broader implementation.
  • Measure outcomes and continuously refine processes based on actual performance.

3. Systems & Workflow Optimization

  • Evaluate whether existing systems and tools effectively support the company's workflows.
  • Identify gaps between business processes and system capabilities.
  • Improve the way teams use core platforms, including:
  • Notion — knowledge management and SOPs
  • ClickUp — task and workflow management
  • Slack — internal communication
  • Cubby — property management
  • Google Workspace — documents, files, and collaboration
  • Identify opportunities for better workflows, automations, integrations, reporting, and information flow.
  • Reduce unnecessary manual work, duplicate data entry, and fragmented information.
  • Help establish clear ownership for critical systems, workflows, and information.
  • Ensure systems remain aligned with evolving business processes.

4. Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Build, restructure, and maintain a scalable SOP and process documentation framework.
  • Maintain Notion as a practical and reliable source of truth for operational knowledge.
  • Convert validated processes into clear, usable documentation.
  • Create process maps, workflows, checklists, decision trees, and other documentation where appropriate.
  • Ensure documentation clearly communicates what to do, how to do it, who owns it, and what outcome is expected.
  • Establish documentation standards, ownership, review cycles, and version control.
  • Identify and eliminate outdated, duplicative, or conflicting documentation.
  • Build systems that reduce reliance on tribal knowledge and individual employees.

5. Organizational Change & Implementation

  • Own the implementation of approved process and systems changes from planning through adoption.
  • Develop practical rollout plans, communication strategies, training materials, and implementation timelines.
  • Work closely with department leaders and team members to introduce new ways of working.
  • Communicate the why behind changes and connect new processes to business outcomes.
  • Identify resistance, confusion, capability gaps, or other barriers to adoption.
  • Provide training and support during implementation.
  • Monitor adoption after rollout and address gaps when teams revert to old habits.
  • Ensure process improvements become part of normal operations rather than remaining theoretical recommendations.

6. Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop practical ways to measure whether processes are working.
  • Build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms where needed.
  • Establish meaningful KPIs and measurable outcomes for key processes.
  • Use operational data to identify recurring problems, trends, and systemic weaknesses.
  • Distinguish between activity and results — completing a process does not necessarily mean the process is effective.
  • Create feedback loops that allow processes to be continuously evaluated and improved.
  • Use a no-blame, evidence-based approach to identifying and solving operational problems.

7. AI & Modern Productivity

  • Use AI tools to improve the speed and quality of research, analysis, documentation, process design, and operational work.
  • Demonstrate practical familiarity with Claude and other leading AI tools.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate AI into documentation, knowledge management, workflow analysis, reporting, and repetitive operational tasks.
  • Use AI as a productivity and problem-solving tool while maintaining appropriate judgment, accuracy, confidentiality, and human oversight.
  • Help the organization identify practical AI applications that improve efficiency without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Requirements

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in process improvement, business systems, business operations, business analysis, organizational effectiveness, or a related field.
  • Proven experience analyzing, designing, documenting, and improving business processes.
  • Strong experience creating and maintaining SOPs, workflows, process maps, and operational documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to take a process improvement from diagnosis through implementation and adoption.
  • Strong understanding of organizational change and change implementation.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach.
  • Ability to identify root causes rather than simply addressing symptoms.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and moving parts simultaneously.
  • High ownership mentality and strong follow-through.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Experience working with remote or distributed teams.
  • Proficiency with modern productivity and workflow tools such as Notion, ClickUp, Slack, and Google Workspace.
  • Legitimate hands-on familiarity with AI tools, particularly Claude, and the ability to demonstrate how you have used AI to improve your work.
  • Ability to prioritize initiatives based on business impact, urgency, feasibility, and expected outcomes.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Ability to work full-time during Oklahoma business hours (9am–5pm CT).

Strong Plus

  • Experience in self-storage, real estate, property management, hospitality, or another operationally intensive environment.
  • Experience with property management software, including Cubby, AppFolio, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting multiple properties, locations, departments, or teams simultaneously.
  • Experience with operational reporting, KPI tracking, dashboards, or performance measurement.
  • Experience implementing organizational change across multiple departments or teams.
  • Experience designing scalable knowledge management systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation, integrations, or no-code/low-code tools.
  • Experience working remotely with US-based companies or distributed international teams.

You Are Not a Fit If

  • You require constant direction to identify problems or prioritize your work.
  • You prefer maintaining existing processes rather than analyzing and improving them.
  • You are primarily an administrator or documentation writer rather than a process owner and implementer.
  • You create SOPs but do not care whether people actually follow them or whether they produce results.
  • You struggle to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and moving parts simultaneously.
  • You are reactive rather than proactive and investigative.
  • You jump to solutions without first understanding the root cause.
  • You avoid difficult conversations or operational follow-up.
  • You rely on assumptions instead of data, evidence, and measurable outcomes.
  • You struggle to get people aligned around process or system changes.
  • You are uncomfortable challenging inefficient or outdated ways of working.
  • You view AI as a buzzword rather than a practical tool for improving how work gets done.
  • You prefer purely administrative work over systems ownership, process improvement, and organizational change.

Benefits

  • Client Relationship: You will be directly working with the client. This means that you will communicate with the client, provide services, and address any client-related matters independently.
  • Payments: All payments for your services will be handled by the client. Elevate and Delegate is not involved in processing your payroll. Your salary will directly go to you.
  • Vacation Leaves and Holidays: While we may have recommendations or guidelines regarding vacation leaves and holidays, the decision is entirely at the discretion of the client. You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard.

---

Application Process:

  • As part of your application, you’ll be asked to record your responses to the initial interview questions through a Loom video (questions & instructions are in the application page).
  • Our team will carefully review your submission, and if shortlisted, we’ll share your responses with the client for their review and next steps.
  • Please treat this recording as you would a real interview:
    • Come prepared and make sure you’re clearly visible on camera.
    • Record your answers in a quiet, well-lit, and clutter-free space with a stable internet connection.
  • We’re excited to get to know you better! Show us your personality and strengths. We encourage you to answer authentically and in your own words, without reading from a script or using AI tools.
