Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

We are currently searching for a Workday Adaptive Planning Senior Consultant to join our growing Baker Tilly Digital Advisory Services consulting practice. As a part of Baker Tilly, you will find that our global brand and entrepreneurial environment will give you the support you need to apply your industry and technical experience to build your career across a wide range of services to meet our clients’ important needs. You will contribute to some of the most important activities in our firm which include operating and growing the business, serving the client, developing people, and shaping our culture.

As a member of our team, you will support organizations who have selected Workday Adaptive Planning as their Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solution . The Workday Adaptive Planning Senior Consultant will be part of a team that implements, supports, and uses Workday Adaptive Planning to help clients improve their financial reporting, planning and forecasting processes. As part of this team, the position will work with a wide variety of projects and roles.

Role Summary
Delivers assigned implementation workstreams while developing expertise in Workday Adaptive Planning configuration, integrations, reporting, and client advisory. Serves as a trusted project team member and mentors associate consultants.

Responsibilities

  • Support Workday Adaptive Planning implementation projects from discovery through deployment by delivering assigned workstreams, maintaining high-quality deliverables, and meeting project timelines and client expectations

  • Facilitate working sessions with client teams to map out their business operations, define goals for their planning cycles, and identify key metrics that drive decision-making

  • Build, configure, and maintain financial forecasting and planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning, ensuring they meet client requirements and align with best practices

  • Support the implementation process from start to finish, including configuration, testing, and optimization of Workday Adaptive Planning

  • Configure, implement, and troubleshoot integrations using JavaScript, SQL, APIs, JDBC, and other integration platforms to incorporate data from a variety of ERP and source systems into Workday Adaptive Planning

  • Help clients streamline their financial processes by automating workflows and reports using system capabilities

  • Identify opportunities to reduce the time clients spend compiling data, allowing them to focus more on analysis and strategy

  • Provide training to client teams to ensure they can effectively use the tools and systems implemented

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required; major in accounting, finance, business analytics, management information systems, fin-tech or information systems preferred

  • Experience in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), financial systems, or consulting preferred

  • Workday Adaptive Planning or financial systems experience preferred

  • Strong experience in JavaScript, SQL, and other integration platforms to incorporate data from a wide variety of ERP systems into Workday Adaptive Planning

  • Minimum of 3 years of corporate financial accounting experience required

  • Minimum of 1 year of corporate financial planning experience required

ABOUT US

GoGlobal is the leading professional services company to guide, establish and manage global operations with compliance and confidence. With a presence in over 140 countries on six continents and growing, we make running a global business easy.

  • HR Solutions: Global recruitment, Employer of Record (EOR), Agent of Record (AOR), Global benefits, Global payroll, International HR Consulting
  • Finance Solutions: Accounting & Tax

For more information, please visit GoGlobal.com

OVERVIEW

We Measure Success by Results, Not Hours Worked

At GoGlobal, we give you the autonomy to make decisions that create real impact. We prioritize results over hours worked, focusing on quality of outcomes rather than tracking time.

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

  • A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact
  • Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team
  • Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

  • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way
  • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
  • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world
  • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success
  • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership
  • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions
  • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. About Sciene
At Sciene, the mission is to empower professional services firms with cutting-edge, customized AI solutions — enhancing automation, analytics, and optimization across industries while prioritizing security, cost efficiency, and state-of-the-art technology.
Our flagship product, the Sciene AI Companion, is an autonomous customer success platform deployed across Quartile — the world's largest retail media optimization platform, managing performance marketing for 1,000+ brands. It automates relationship-heavy enterprise workflows end to end: generating personalized email replies in the CSM's own voice (8x faster), building full presentation decks for client meetings (12x faster), and detecting and diagnosing account fluctuations before anyone has to ask (6x faster). None of this replaces human judgment — it removes the work that was getting in the way of it.
Read more about how we built it: Sciene AI Companion: Building an Autonomous Customer Success Platform on Databricks

OVERVIEW:

Sciene runs a production agentic AI platform: a config-driven engine where every product is an agent with its own identity, skills, tools, and quality gates, executing ReAct loops against real business data across multiple LLM providers. The platform is built; what it needs now is deeper machine learning judgment behind every model decision it makes.
The Senior ML Specialist is the team's authority on how these models actually work and how to measure them. You will decide which models run which tasks and prove it with statistically sound benchmarks, design the evaluation methodology the whole team relies on, build classifiers and fine-tuned models where they beat prompting, and diagnose model behavior from first principles rather than by trial and error. You will do this inside a production codebase — shipping, operating, and monitoring what you design.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR:
This is a machine learning role first and a software engineering role second. We are looking for someone whose core professional background is in machine learning and statistics — not a software engineer who adopted LLM APIs in the last few years. You should be able to explain from first principles how a large language model is trained and why it behaves the way it does, reason about model outputs as probabilistic objects, and tell whether a difference between two models on a benchmark is real or noise.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years of applied machine learning experience, with a substantial part predating the current generative AI wave — training, evaluating, and deploying models, not only integrating LLM APIs
  • Strong foundation in statistics and probability: hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sampling and sample-size reasoning, bias/variance, calibration, and the ability to state when a measured difference is statistically meaningful
  • Deep understanding of LLM and generative AI theory: transformer architecture and attention, tokenization, embeddings, the training pipeline (pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, RLHF/DPO), decoding strategies (temperature, top-p, sampling vs. greedy), scaling behavior, and the known failure modes — hallucination, sycophancy, long-context degradation, prompt sensitivity — and why they occur
  • Hands-on classical ML and NLP: classification, clustering, feature engineering, text classification, embeddings and semantic similarity — and the judgment to know when a small trained model outperforms an LLM on cost, latency, or accuracy
  • Experience fine-tuning models (LoRA/PEFT, supervised fine-tuning, or full fine-tuning) and building the datasets for it — and equally, knowing when prompting or retrieval is the better answer
  • Experience designing evaluation methodology for AI systems: building offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and its known biases, inter-rater agreement, regression benchmarks, and significance testing on results
  • Production-grade Python: PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, and modern async Python; comfortable shipping into a FastAPI/Pydantic codebase with tests and CI — this role ships code, not only notebooks
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major LLM provider API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), including structured outputs and tool/function calling, and an understanding of the trade-offs between models and providers
  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent demonstrated depth (publications, competition results, released models or research code)
  • The autonomy expected of a senior: you own a problem end to end — from framing to shipped, measured outcome — and are accountable for the result

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Publications, research, or open-source contributions in NLP or machine learning; strong Kaggle or equivalent competition record
  • Experience with retrieval systems: embedding model selection, chunking strategies, reranking, and retrieval quality evaluation
  • Experience with agent evaluation: trajectory analysis, tool-use accuracy, multi-step task success metrics
  • Experience with model cost and latency optimization: model routing, distillation, prompt caching, quantization
  • Experience with Databricks (MLflow, model serving, Delta Sharing) and with Azure (Container Apps, Key Vault) and Docker
  • Experience with observability stacks: OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Loki, structured logging
  • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-integration standards
  • Track record of shipping something from 0 to 1 in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift often

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own model strategy across the platform: evaluate and select models per task (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and emerging providers) using our benchmark and LLM-as-judge harness, and make the decision defensible with proper statistical treatment of the results
  • Design and maintain the evaluation methodology the team relies on: offline eval sets, judge calibration and reliability, regression benchmarks, and quality metrics that go beyond "it looks right"
  • Build classification and fine-tuned models where they beat prompting — for routing, categorization, and detection tasks — including dataset construction, training, evaluation, and deployment
  • Design, develop, and ship agentic AI products on our platform: agent identities, reusable skills, tool integrations, and structured outputs — often config-driven, with platform-level code changes when the engine needs to grow
  • Do prompt and context engineering grounded in how models actually process context: system prompt assembly, context injection from live data sources, thread/memory management, and structured output design with Pydantic schemas
  • Own output quality: design deterministic enforcers, validation quality gates, and LLM-as-judge evaluators, and measure whether the judges themselves are reliable
  • Diagnose model behavior from first principles — hallucination, inconsistency, drift across model versions — and turn the diagnosis into fixes in prompts, retrieval, guardrails, or model choice
  • Build and extend agent tools that query Databricks, MongoDB, and external systems, and integrate agents with the broader ecosystem via the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Operate what you ship: instrument services with OpenTelemetry, monitor quality, latency, and cost in Grafana, and improve them over time
  • Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, and product to deliver end-to-end AI solutions, and raise the team's ML fundamentals through reviews and knowledge sharing
  • Follow the research literature critically and bring in techniques that hold up on our data — not every paper does
  • Document and maintain the codebase, ensuring code quality and adherence to best practices

*This is a PJ contract based in Brazil.

jobs.description:
Principal AI Engineer — Velsera

AI Platform & Enablement · Reports to the CTO · Senior individual contributor

About the role

Velsera builds software and infrastructure for precision medicine — research platforms, clinical and diagnostic applications, and the systems that keep them running in regulated environments. We are adding AI capability across that portfolio and inside our own operations: governed model access, self-hosted and managed LLM serving, evaluation and audit, and integration into the products and business processes people already depend on.

This is a deliberately broad role. You will be deployed where the highest-value AI work is at the time — a customer-facing product capability in one quarter, an internal enterprise workflow in the next, a strategic account or funded program after that. The mandate stays the same wherever you land: design and ship production AI systems that hold up under real compliance requirements, work across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and leave behind reusable patterns rather than one-off builds.

You will set technical direction for what is expected to grow into an AI platform and enablement team.

What you'll work on

  • Build a governed model access layer — self-hosted open-weight models, cloud-managed models (Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI), and customer- or partner-supplied models — designed to be consumed by more than one product or business function.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into product experiences and enterprise workflows across batch, interactive, and agentic patterns.
  • Establish the patterns everyone else reuses: evaluation, versioning, approvals, audit trails, cost control, guardrails, and safe rollout and rollback.
  • Partner with product, engineering, security, QARA/compliance, IT, and scientific and commercial teams to introduce AI-native architectures that people can actually adopt.
  • Move between assignments as business priorities shift, and make what you build in one part of the business usable in the next.

What you'll deliver (first 6–12 months)

  • A production-ready, compliant AI/LLM serving and invocation layer that at least two products or business functions adopt — multi-tenant, auditable, and secure.
  • A model governance workflow (intake, evaluation, approval, versioning, deprecation) that satisfies both regulated customers and our own quality system.
  • Two or three AI capabilities shipped end to end in different parts of the business — for example a customer-facing product feature, an internal process automation, and assisted validation or compliance tooling.
  • Integration patterns that preserve reproducibility, traceability, and standards alignment wherever the work lands.
  • Operational readiness: monitoring, evaluation harnesses, incident playbooks, cost visibility, and measurable SLOs for key AI services.
  • A defensible internal point of view on where we should build, buy, or not use AI at all — backed by what you shipped.

How we build (and what we'll expect you to optimize for)

You will make trade-offs in an environment that is multi-product, multi-cloud, standards-driven, and compliance-heavy. A few things matter a lot here:

  • Reusability over one-offs. Design the second and third use case into the first one. A solution that only works for one product or one team is a partial solution.
  • Standards and clean interfaces. Prefer open standards and well-defined boundaries over bespoke integrations.
  • Multi-cloud, multi-deployment reality. AWS, Azure, and GCP are all in play, alongside customer-managed and self-hosted environments. Avoid hard dependencies on a single provider's AI stack.
  • Security and auditability by default. Access control, logging, traceability, and data governance are part of the design, not add-ons.
  • Reproducibility. AI features have to fit into workflows and processes that need to be repeatable and explainable, sometimes years later.
  • Proportion. Ship the smallest thing that genuinely works, then harden it. Governance that makes a workflow unusable has failed.

Requirements

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 7+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years shipping AI/ML systems to production.
  • Strong Python, plus one of Java, Go, or TypeScript; comfortable in a polyglot codebase and in production code review.
  • Hands-on experience with secure cloud architecture on at least one major cloud — network isolation, IAM boundaries, private connectivity, audit logging — and readiness to work in the others.
  • Experience operating or integrating model serving across delivery modes: self-hosted open-weight models, managed model APIs, and customer-provided models.
  • MLOps/LLMOps experience with tooling such as AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or equivalent.
  • Built governance for ML/LLM systems: evaluation, versioning, approvals, rollout and rollback, deprecation.
  • Comfortable designing for regulated or audited environments (HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, FedRAMP, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar).
  • Experience with RAG and LLM tool-use/agentic patterns beyond prototypes, including how you evaluated them.
  • Track record integrating with systems you don't own — existing products, third-party SaaS, enterprise data sources — without breaking them.
  • Clear written communication for mixed audiences: engineering, product, security and compliance, business stakeholders, and scientists.
  • Comfort switching context across problem domains and starting from ambiguous requirements.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in genomics, biomedical data, or life sciences platforms.
  • Software built under a quality management system (ISO 13485, IEC 62304, IVDR) or in clinical/diagnostic contexts.
  • Integrating AI capabilities into workflow or orchestration engines (CWL/WDL/Nextflow or similar).
  • Familiarity with GA4GH standards (WES/DRS/TRS) and/or clinical data models (FHIR, OMOP).
  • Enterprise systems integration: CRM, ERP, ITSM, document and quality management, collaboration suites.
  • Production experience on more than one cloud, with pragmatic multi-cloud trade-off judgment.
  • Experience on customer-funded or grant-funded engagements alongside product and services teams.

This role is a fit if…

  • You want to build the platform layer and the capabilities on top of it — not model research or prompt engineering alone.
  • You would rather solve four different problems well across a business than the same problem for three years.
  • You are energized rather than frustrated by environments where auditability, access control, and traceability are hard requirements.
  • You like improving live production systems without breaking what customers and colleagues rely on.
  • You are willing to say no to AI when it is not the right tool, and to say so in writing.

Why join

You'll shape how AI gets built across Velsera — in the products our customers run sensitive biomedical data through, and in the way we operate as a company. The constraints are real, the users are close, and the scope of ownership is unusually broad for a single role.

Benefits

Our core values

People first. We create collaborative and supportive environments by operating with respect and flexibility to promote mental, emotional and physical health. We practice empathy by treating others the way they want to be treated and assuming positive intent. We are proud of our inclusive diverse team and humble ourselves to learn about and build our connection with each other.

Patient focused. We act with swift determination without sacrificing our expectations of quality. We are driven by providing exceptional solutions for our customers to positively impact patient lives. Considering what is at stake, we challenge ourselves to develop the best solution, not just the easy one.

Integrity. We hold ourselves accountable and strive for transparent communication to build trust amongst ourselves and our customers. We take ownership of our results as we know what we do matters and collectively we will change the healthcare industry. We are thoughtful and intentional with every customer interaction understanding the overall impact on human health.

Curious. We ask questions and actively listen in order to learn and continuously improve. We embrace change and the opportunities it presents to make each other better. We strive to be on the cutting edge of science and technology innovation by encouraging creativity.

Impactful. We take our social responsibility with the seriousness it deserves and hold ourselves to a high standard. We improve our sustainability by encouraging discussion and taking action as it relates to our natural, social and economic resource footprint. We are devoted to our humanitarian mission and look for new ways to make the world a better place.

Position Overview:

The Senior Director, Agile Delivery is a senior practitioner and organizational leader responsible for scaling and standardizing agile delivery practices across Vibrant’s Tech division. This role serves as the connective tissue between product, engineering, and data teams—ensuring that cross-functional pods operate with clarity, cadence, and continuous improvement. The Director will establish and sustain delivery infrastructure (ceremonies, tooling, metrics, coaching) that enables Vibrant’s Tech organization to execute reliably against program commitments.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Design and steward a Tech-wide agile operating model that works across Engineering, Product, Data, and Enterprise IT pods; establish consistent sprint rhythms, definition-of-done standards, backlog hygiene practices, and release planning cadences.

  • Strategically design the organization's approach to Agile, scaling methodologies across departments to align org-wide goals with execution.

  • Adapt agile methods (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe elements) to fit Vibrant’s hybrid program/product context, including grant-funded deliverable timelines with external reporting obligations.

  • Partner with pod leads and VPs to track delivery velocity, surface blockers, and facilitate impediment resolution across TECH’s program portfolio.

  • Own cross-pod dependency management and integrated release planning; maintain a rolling TECH delivery roadmap updated on a regular cadence.

  • Build and maintain delivery dashboards (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) providing real-time visibility to leadership and stakeholders.

  • Manage budget for multiple agile teams, monitoring actual spend against budgeted forecast.

  • Coach and mentor embedded scrum masters, product owners, and technical leads on agile principles and practices; design and facilitate agile training programs and communities of practice across Tech.

  • Serve as the primary liaison on delivery governance questions from the CTO office, program leadership and external partners.

  • Translate delivery metrics into executive-ready narratives; present delivery status, risk, and trend data at departmental meetings, executive check-ins and board touchpoints as needed.

  • Champion a culture of psychological safety, retrospection, and iterative improvement across all Tech pods.

  • Lead complex, cross-domain delivery engagements and establish delivery patterns that can be repeated across future programs and grant cycles.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Deep hands-on fluency with Scrum and Kanban; demonstrated success adapting agile frameworks to distributed, mission-driven, or grant-funded environments.

  • Proficiency with delivery tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, or equivalent; experience building delivery dashboards and KPI frameworks for cross-functional organizations.

  • Demonstrated success leading delivery transformation across multi-team or multi-program organizations, including navigating organizational change.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration or related field.

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in agile delivery, program management, or related roles; 5+ years in a leadership or coaching capacity.

jobs.description:
Contracts Administrator – Contract Lifecycle Management & Legal Operations | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Contracts Administrator to manage the complete contract lifecycle — from intake and drafting through internal approvals, execution, storage, renewals, compliance tracking, and reporting.

This is a process-driven role for someone who understands that effective contract lifecycle management (CLM) is essential to reducing legal, financial, compliance, and operational risk.

You’ll work cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, Finance, Sales, Information Security, Compliance, and executive stakeholders to ensure agreements move efficiently while remaining accurate, properly approved, compliant, searchable, and audit-ready.

If you have hands-on contract administration or legal operations experience and thrive in structured, detail-heavy environments, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Contract Intake & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage contract requests including:
    • NDAs
    • Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
    • Statements of Work (SOWs)
    • Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)
    • Vendor agreements
    • Amendments
    • Renewals
  • Review incoming requests for completeness before initiating contract workflows
  • Confirm business terms, pricing, counterparties, jurisdictions, and compliance requirements
  • Route agreements through appropriate review and approval processes
  • Track contract status from intake through execution
  • Maintain execution timelines against established SLAs
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding reviews and approvals

Contract Drafting, Review & Redlining

  • Draft and format agreements using approved templates and clause libraries
  • Redline contracts using Microsoft Word Track Changes
  • Apply approved legal playbooks and fallback language
  • Identify and escalate non-standard provisions involving:
    • Indemnification
    • Limitation of liability
    • Intellectual property
    • Data privacy and security
    • Termination rights
    • Service-level agreements (SLAs)
  • Maintain clear records of contract deviations, approvals, and rationale
  • Ensure document versions remain accurate throughout negotiations

Approvals & Contract Governance

  • Coordinate contract reviews across:
    • Legal
    • Finance
    • Procurement
    • Information Security
    • Privacy
    • Leadership
  • Verify pricing, budget approvals, vendor documentation, and compliance requirements
  • Ensure agreements follow established approval matrices and governance policies
  • Track outstanding approvals and follow up with stakeholders to prevent unnecessary delays
  • Maintain appropriate documentation of approvals and exceptions

Execution & Contract Repository Management

  • Manage electronic signature workflows using platforms such as DocuSign or Adobe Sign
  • Confirm signer authority and signature requirements
  • Ensure fully executed agreements are properly stored
  • Maintain accurate records within CLM and contract management platforms such as:
    • Ironclad
    • Icertis
    • Agiloft
    • ContractWorks
    • Conga
    • SharePoint
  • Maintain contract metadata including:
    • Contract value
    • Effective and expiration dates
    • Renewal dates
    • Notice periods
    • Jurisdiction
    • Data-processing requirements
  • Ensure contracts remain searchable and accessible to authorized stakeholders

Renewals, Obligations & Compliance

  • Track:
    • Contract expiration dates
    • Renewal deadlines
    • Auto-renewal provisions
    • Notice periods
    • Pricing escalators
    • Contractual obligations
  • Maintain proactive reminders to prevent missed deadlines
  • Support compliance requirements involving:
    • GDPR
    • CCPA
    • HIPAA
    • PCI-DSS
    • Internal controls
  • Maintain complete approval, execution, and signature trails
  • Ensure contract records remain audit-ready

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Track and report on:
    • Contract cycle times
    • SLA adherence
    • Renewal pipelines
    • Clause deviations
    • Standard-term usage
  • Improve contract templates, clause libraries, workflows, and documentation
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive contract administration processes
  • Help develop scalable and self-service contracting workflows
  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements to contract operations

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in contracts administration, contract lifecycle management, legal operations, procurement operations, or a related function
  • Hands-on experience managing contracts throughout their lifecycle
  • Experience with CLM systems, contract repositories, and e-signature workflows
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Word Track Changes
    • Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
    • PDF editing tools
  • Working understanding of common contractual provisions, including:
    • Indemnification
    • Limitation of liability
    • Confidentiality
    • Intellectual property
    • Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)
    • Service-Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to coordinate multiple contracts and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience within SaaS, technology, healthcare, finance, or other regulated industries
  • Familiarity with vendor risk management and procurement workflows
  • Experience handling security questionnaires
  • Experience maintaining clause libraries and contract templates
  • Familiarity with legal playbooks and approval matrices
  • Exposure to:
    • GDPR
    • HIPAA
    • PCI-DSS
    • SOX
    • Similar compliance frameworks

Tools & Technology

Ironclad | Icertis | Agiloft | ContractWorks | Conga | SharePoint | DocuSign | Adobe Sign | Microsoft Word | Excel | Google Sheets | PDF Editing Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Catch small contractual and documentation inconsistencies quickly
  • Enjoy structured, process-heavy work
  • Can manage a high volume of agreements without sacrificing accuracy
  • Follow deadlines closely and proactively manage renewals
  • Communicate effectively across legal and non-legal teams
  • Understand when an issue can follow the standard process and when it requires escalation
  • Take ownership of contracts from initial request through execution and ongoing management
  • Keep documentation organized even while managing multiple competing priorities
  • Look for opportunities to make contracting workflows faster and more scalable

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing new contract requests and checking agreements awaiting internal approval or signature.

Throughout the day, you could draft or redline agreements, coordinate approvals with Legal or Finance, manage DocuSign workflows, update CLM records, monitor upcoming renewals, verify contractual obligations, and prepare contract reporting.

You’ll also work with stakeholders to resolve bottlenecks and continuously improve contracting processes, templates, and documentation.

In short: you ensure contracts move efficiently while remaining accurate, compliant, properly approved, searchable, and proactively managed throughout their lifecycle.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Contracts executed within SLA timelines
  • Zero missed renewal or notice deadlines
  • High contract metadata accuracy
  • Complete and audit-ready documentation
  • Reduced contract cycle times
  • Consistent adherence to approval workflows
  • Reduced non-standard clause deviations
  • Accurate renewal and obligation tracking
  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction with contract operations

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-impact role supporting critical business operations
  • Cross-functional exposure to Legal, Finance, Procurement, Compliance, Security, and leadership
  • Opportunity to improve and scale contract lifecycle processes
  • Strong ownership over contract governance and operational accuracy
  • Hands-on exposure to modern CLM and legal operations workflows
  • Fully remote environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Legal Operations Manager
    • Contract Manager
    • Procurement Operations
    • Commercial Operations
    • Contract Management Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Task – NDA Redlining Exercise / Contract Tracker Creation
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in contract administration, contract lifecycle management, or legal operations and enjoy managing detailed workflows, coordinating stakeholders, and keeping high-volume agreements accurate and organized, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of contracts from intake and redlining through execution, renewal, compliance tracking, and reporting.

jobs.title: Rev/Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, the Rev/Marketing Operations Manager owns HubSpot end to end — the instance, the data model, and the daily campaign build — and is the architect of how Agility measures marketing's impact on revenue.
Our attribution challenge is real and unsolved: our CRM lifecycle doesn't follow the textbook pattern, so conventional attribution models don't work here out of the box. You will establish HubSpot as the initial source of truth for marketing data, design a measurement approach that fits how our systems actually behave, evaluate first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch attribution in HubSpot, and make a defensible recommendation. Just as important as building the model is explaining it: you will articulate the methodology — clearly and credibly — to the VP of Marketing, the broader organization, and our sales partners.

This is a builder's seat, not an administrator's. You will build and launch campaigns in HubSpot on a daily basis, executing on behalf of the Associate Director, Demand Generation, who sets campaign priorities and briefs; you own build quality, instance governance, and measurement truth. You will partner closely with our Salesforce Administrator on the CRM boundary.

This role reports directly to the Director of Marketing — deliberately outside the campaign organization — so that measurement remains independent and credible with every stakeholder it serves.

You will also instrument our conversational AI pilot, including capturing baseline website conversion rates before go-live, so that the pilot's impact is measured honestly from day one.

What Success Looks Like

  • A recommended attribution model (first-touch, last-touch, or multi-touch) is implemented in HubSpot, documented, and understood by marketing, sales, and leadership — with the methodology presented and defended in plain language.
  • HubSpot operates as the initial source of truth for marketing data, reconciled cleanly with the Salesforce contact structure.
  • Campaigns ship daily and weekly — on brief, on time, and to a quality standard — in support of demand generation priorities.
  • Email compliance runs clean across all regional lanes — CAN-SPAM (US), CASL (Canada), GDPR/PECR (UK-EU) — with zero compliance incidents.
  • The conversational AI pilot has a documented pre-launch conversion baseline and live measurement of its impact on conversion and meetings booked.
  • Lead scoring, routing, and lifecycle workflows are rebuilt, documented, and trusted by sales.

What You'll Do

Attribution & Measurement

  • Design and implement Agility's marketing attribution model in HubSpot, working within the realities of our CRM lifecycle rather than the textbook version.
  • Evaluate first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch approaches; recommend one and defend the trade-offs.
  • Present the methodology and its reporting to marketing, sales, and executive stakeholders, and iterate based on what the business needs to see.
  • Build and maintain the dashboards leadership uses to make budget decisions — and be able to dissect and rebuild any dashboard from the underlying data.

Campaign Build & Execution

  • Build, QA, launch, and monitor campaigns in HubSpot daily on behalf of the Associate Director, Demand Generation: emails, nurtures, workflows, forms, landing pages, lists, and segmentation.
  • Operate the regional outbound email lanes and their differing consent regimes.
  • Own campaign build quality end to end: deliverability, rendering, tracking, and data hygiene.

Platform Governance & Compliance

  • Own the HubSpot instance: architecture, permissions, integrations, data model, naming conventions, and documentation.
  • Own compliance operations across CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR/PECR, including consent management, suppression, and auditability.
  • Partner with the Salesforce Administrator on the HubSpot–Salesforce boundary: sync health, field mapping, and the lead lifecycle handoff.
  • Design and maintain routing and SLA flows for our no-SDR motion, including the chatbot-to-calendar handoff.
  • Operate the dedicated cold-outbound sending stack alongside HubSpot — domain and mailbox health, warmup, and bidirectional sync (suppression lists out, activity and replies in) — keeping true cold email off the marketing platform in line with its acceptable-use policy.
  • Maintain the data-rights workflow: a documented path to delete or suppress a contact across HubSpot, the outbound sequencer, and enrichment exports.

AI & Pilot Measurement

  • Instrument the conversational AI pilot: capture the pre-launch website conversion baseline, define success metrics, and report pilot performance.
  • Apply HubSpot's current AI capabilities — such as Breeze, AI-assisted workflows, and predictive scoring — where they demonstrably improve speed or quality.
  • Continuously evaluate new HubSpot releases and recommend adoption where warranted.

Why You'll Bring

  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot expertise — administration, campaign build, reporting, and data model — in a live production instance (Marketing Hub required; HubSpot certifications an asset).
  • Demonstrated fluency with HubSpot's current AI and agentic capabilities (for example Breeze, AI-assisted workflows, and predictive scoring), applied in production — this platform evolves monthly, and you keep pace.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and experience managing a HubSpot–Salesforce integration, with the comfort to design around non-standard CRM structures.
  • Proven attribution experience: you have built — not just read — attribution reporting, and you can explain the trade-offs of competing models to non-technical audiences.
  • Email compliance experience across at least two of CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR.
  • Experience operating or supporting a dedicated cold-email stack — sequencer, secondary sending domains, warmup, deliverability monitoring — and syncing it cleanly with a CRM.
  • An analyst's mindset: you dissect dashboards down to the underlying data, rebuild what's broken, and treat measurement accuracy as a matter of professional pride.
  • A sense of urgency and a test-and-learn habit: you review the numbers weekly, form hypotheses, and iterate.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Collaborative culture – and key tools enabling it
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Health, Dental & Vision benefits
  • RRSP matching
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Development & Progression opportunities
  • Paid Vacation, Personal Days and Sick days
  • Flex Fridays in Summer, Week off between Christmas and New Years'
  • No Internal Meetings Fridays

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is C$82,000–C$115,000 annually, plus a 10% target bonus. Final compensation will reflect the successful candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity.

This is a new position.

AI Usage

We use technology to make hiring smarter, faster, and more personal, never less human. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools help us manage applications efficiently and highlight qualifications that align with each role, allowing our recruiters to focus more on meaningful conversations with candidates. AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. Every decision is made by people, our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are trained to apply sound judgment and equitable practices at every stage. We believe technology exists to amplify human insight, not replace it. That belief shapes how we build relationships, tell stories, and grow our teams.

At Agility, we strive every day to build a more inclusive work environment and introduce tools that enable it. We strongly encourage applications from all people regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability status or sexual orientation.

Even if you find yourself not checking all the boxes of our listed requirements but you are excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you anyway. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application for this role, and other potential role matches open now or in the future.

If, at any stage of the application process, you require accommodation owing to disability or a medical need, please let us know at for us to make appropriate arrangements.

About Positron AI

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. Our first-generation ASIC, Asimov, is a cutting-edge accelerator targeting frontier AI workloads, with additional generations already underway.

Role Overview

The Accelerator Platform Software (APS) team owns the software closest to the metal: the host-side platform layer, the device-side runtime and firmware, the Linux-based device OS, the simulation and emulation environments we use to build software ahead of silicon, performance and debug tooling, and product security. If it touches the accelerator, it goes through us. We build with AI-native workflows, where agentic coding tools, a shared skills repository, and automation are core to how the team ships.

This role sits on the Director's staff and owns making that leverage real across every sub-team. Most companies would staff an entire developer-systems team for this mission. We are hiring one person and giving them the whole thing. You will be the engineer who makes AI-assisted development actually work in a shop where the code talks to registers and a wrong answer means a hung device, not a bad paragraph. You will embed with each sub-team, find where their week goes, and build agentic workflows that give it back, then prove the gains with evaluations rather than enthusiasm. You report directly to the Director of APS, and your roadmap is yours to define from the friction you observe.

Key Responsibilities

Forward deployment and workflow building

  • Embed with APS sub-teams across firmware, runtime, performance, and simulation, and build agentic workflows into how they actually work, including coding, debugging, triage, test generation, and keeping documentation honest.
  • Pair directly with senior engineers on their real work, earning adoption by making their week measurably better.

Tooling and shared infrastructure

  • Own the shared skills repository and internal agent tooling that turn hard-won team knowledge into reusable, evaluated automation.
  • Wire agents into CI and everyday engineering surfaces, including code review, log and trace triage, and silicon-debug assistance.

Quality and evaluation

  • Build and maintain evaluations so workflow quality is measured rather than guessed, and regression-test the automation like any other production system.

Standards and culture

  • Set the standard for what good AI-assisted engineering looks like where correctness is non-negotiable, and champion that AI-native culture across the team.
  • Identify where AI leverage genuinely pays off and where it does not, and say so plainly.

Required Qualifications

  • A strong software engineering background, with systems or infrastructure experience strongly preferred; this is an engineering role, not a prompt-writing role.
  • Hands-on, expert experience using agentic development tools such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, integrating LLM APIs, and building evaluations.
  • A shipped track record of internal tooling or developer-productivity work that engineers actually adopted.
  • The credibility and patience to win over skeptical senior systems engineers with results rather than demos.
  • Self-directed working style, comfortable defining your own roadmap from observed friction without a team around you.
  • Excellent written communication skills, since we run on written plans, design docs, and async updates.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A low-level or hardware-adjacent background, enough to be credible pairing on a kernel driver or a trace-analysis session.
  • Experience with CI/CD systems, developer platforms, or build and release engineering.
  • Prior forward-deployed, solutions-engineering, or platform-team experience.

Leveling & Scope

Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

Why Join Us?

  • You will own a mission most companies spread across an entire team, with a roadmap you define and a direct line to the Director of APS.
  • You will shape what AI-native engineering looks like at a company building production AI inference hardware, where your tooling directly accelerates the software that turns silicon into a product.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $325,000 – $400,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

The Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) will be the field subject matter expert relating to patient support, access, reimbursement, prior authorization, appeal, financial assistance, and other business-related issues within the Dupixent Business Unit. The FRM is a critical front-line member of the Sanofi Patient Support Services organization and will work across multiple internal stakeholders, Sales Teams, Market Access, Account Directors, Trade, Dupixent MyWay (Patient Support Program) and program vendors to deliver an exceptional customer experience. jobs.description:
Data and Integration Engineer (AI and Automation)

Job Overview

Our client is a UK-based managed service provider delivering technology and operational services to customers in the Accountancy, Financial Services, and Asset Management sectors. They are looking for a hands-on Data and Integration Engineer (AI and Automation) to own and develop the integration capability connecting their service, commercial, financial, and operational systems.

The role will focus on API integration engineering, data quality, automation, reporting, and the secure integration of AI capabilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for building reliable, well-documented, and supportable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the quality and accessibility of business data.

Job Details
Work Setup: Work from Home
Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | UK Time
Holidays: Will follow UK holidays

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain API integrations between business systems, including two-way synchronization between platforms and integration with the central data layer.
  • Build integrations with appropriate error handling, alerting, and reconciliation checks to ensure broken or partial data feeds are identified promptly.
  • Automate recurring manual processes across finance and operations, including scheduled extracts, reconciliation support, and supplier billing, using auditable and reproducible processes.
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues at source, including entity matching across customer, accounting, and CRM records, and implement controls to prevent recurring issues.
  • Contribute to the design and development of the central data warehouse, including staging layer design, entity matching, incremental loading, and history handling.
  • Work with finance and operations stakeholders to develop reports and dashboards based on the central data layer.
  • Build AI-assisted workflows where they can measurably improve business throughput and use AI development tools to accelerate engineering work.
  • Gather requirements directly from non-technical stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations and translate business needs into clear written specifications.
  • Assess vendor APIs and develop secure, reliable integration solutions for both existing and unfamiliar systems.
  • Work with production constraints such as permissions, rate limits, limited schema access, and differences between vendor documentation and actual endpoint behaviour.
  • Ensure solutions are documented, monitored, supportable, and maintained using disciplined development and source-control practices.
  • Follow the established delivery process, including planning, scope definition, pre-sales authorization, peer review, documentation, and go-live activities.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting API integrations between business systems in a production environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of REST, OAuth2, and webhooks.
  • Experience with two-way synchronization, including understanding of write conflicts, retries, idempotency, and reconciliation.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Graph, Entra APIs, or comparable vendor APIs.
  • Ability to work with real-world production constraints, including permission limitations, rate limits, restricted schema access, and inconsistent API behaviour.
  • Strong SQL skills, including queries, joins, views, and stored procedures.
  • Experience with Power Query, including ETL, data transformation, and M language.
  • Experience automating recurring processes end-to-end, including scheduling, monitoring, and failure handling.
  • Practical experience using AI coding tools within a reviewed workflow, with the ability to verify and validate AI-generated output.
  • Experience building and delivering reports and dashboards for business users using Power BI or a comparable reporting tool.
  • Ability to translate reporting requirements from non-technical stakeholders into working and documented outputs.
  • Understanding of how the underlying data model affects reporting capabilities and limitations.
  • Strong focus on accuracy, reconciliation, and traceability of data back to its source.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to finance professionals and business concepts to technical colleagues.
  • Self-starter who can work independently with direction from the Finance Director.
  • Ability to gather requirements directly from business stakeholders and work effectively with colleagues who may have limited data-related knowledge.
  • Willingness to identify and communicate when a solution cannot be implemented safely.
  • Strong documentation and working practices, including maintaining work in shared workspaces and source control.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, particularly in orchestrating AI services over a data platform and understanding how models and APIs are selected and governed.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and pipelines, with an understanding of capacity and licensing costs.
  • Experience delivering a data warehouse or lakehouse, including staging layer design, dimensional modelling, incremental loading, and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Working knowledge of data governance concepts such as sensitivity labelling, Microsoft Purview, access control, and data classification.
  • Experience integrating accounting platforms such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, or NetSuite with reporting tools or downstream systems.
  • Experience with PSA/MSP platforms such as Halo PSA, ConnectWise, Autotask, or Datto.
  • Exposure to IT Glue, Liongard, or Scalepad.
  • Advanced Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic models, star schema design, and Power BI Service administration.
  • Experience in an MSP, professional services, or project-based business where billable utilization and project margin are important.
  • Experience with low-code automation tools such as Power Automate or Zapier, with the judgment to determine when low-code is more appropriate than custom development.

jobs.excerpt: 🚀 Step into the center of the business as the ultimate force multiplier!
jobs.description:
🚀 Step into the center of the business as the ultimate force multiplier!
We are looking for a relentless, outcome driven Chief of Staff to work directly with the Owner, bridging the gap between high level leadership and ground floor execution.
The Details

  • Job Title: Chief of Staff (Job ID: COSJPC1)
  • Compensation: $3,000 to $5,000
  • Employment Type: Full Time
  • Location: Fully Remote
The Role
This is not an assistant role, nor is it purely strategic. You will sit at the center of the business, rebuilding broken handoffs, pulling critical numbers, running leadership cadences, and owning projects nobody else has bandwidth for. If you want a high impact position where you see the entire business and have a real hand in where the company goes next, this is it.
What You Will Do
  • Executive Leverage: Act as a proxy for the Owner in meetings. Prep decision memos so leadership is ready to decide (not just discuss), own the meeting cadence, and fiercely filter what reaches the executive desk.
  • Operations & Performance: Own the company operating rhythm, build performance dashboards, find and fix team friction, and systematize undocumented processes.
  • Special Projects: Take end to end ownership of high priority, cross departmental initiatives (new product lines, tooling migrations, market expansion) and build the business cases behind them.
  • Communication & Alignment: Translate leadership priorities to the team, surface ground level realities, and draft internal executive communications.
Your First 90 Days
  • Days 1 to 30: Learn the business end to end. Sit with every function and map how work flows and where it stalls.
  • Days 31 to 60: Take over leadership cadences and reporting. Deliver a written assessment of top bottlenecks with actionable recommendations.
  • Days 61 to 90: Own at least two cross functional projects outright and show measurable movement.
What We Are Looking For
  • Experience: 3 to 5+ years in ops, consulting, program management, or a similar CoS/business ops role.
  • Track Record: Proven ability to finish ambiguous, cross functional problems without being managed.
  • Communication: Fluent English (written and spoken) with the ability to turn a messy situation into a crisp, one page memo.
  • Data Driven: Comfortable building models, reading a P&L, and telling a story with numbers.
  • Discretion: Sound judgment with confidential executive information.
  • Strongly Preferred: Experience with multiple business models, distributed teams, rapid headcount growth, and hands on skills with modern operations tools (CRMs, project management, automation).
How You Work
  • You default to ownership; if it falls between roles, you pick it up.
  • You love being told to figure it out and returning with a bulletproof plan.
  • You seamlessly jump from a five year strategy to fixing a broken spreadsheet formula in the same hour.
  • You prefer fixing the system over fighting the same fire twice.
What We Offer
  • Direct exposure to executive decision making.
  • A genuine path into senior leadership.
  • A high autonomy environment where your work visibly moves the business.

📩 Ready to build, optimize, and lead? Apply now!

jobs.excerpt: Hajoca Corporation is one of the country’s largest privately-held wholesale distributors of plumbing, heating & cooling, and industrial supplies.
jobs.description:
Hajoca Corporation is one of the country’s largest privately-held wholesale distributors of plumbing, heating & cooling, and industrial supplies. Founded in 1858, Hajoca is a company based on the principles of “Service, Integrity, Reliability,” and on relationships of trust and support with teammates, customers, and suppliers. Throughout its history, Hajoca has played an active role in shaping advances in plumbing. However, we attribute our success to two simple truths; a unique business philosophy and talented people. Hajoca is all about the people, who give us our advantage, and who will guide us successfully into the future.

Hajoca has over 400 locations nationwide, called Profit Centers; and at the foundation of our family of businesses is a National Support Center (NSC) where Centers of Excellence are dedicated to enabling the success of our Profit Centers.

The Infrastructure Operations team in our National Support Center (NSC) is looking for a Sr Red Hat/UniVerse Administrator at their Lafayette Hill, PA office. This position is remote.

Do you have deep, hands-on experience administering Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Rocket UniVerse or another MultiValue database? Do you enjoy tuning, securing, and troubleshooting the infrastructure supporting a mission-critical ERP platform? Are you excited by the opportunity to own the SQL replication pipeline connecting Eclipse operational data to enterprise reporting and analytics? If so, then we’d like you to join our dedicated team as a Senior Red Hat / UniVerse Administrator.

About the Role:

The Senior Red Hat / UniVerse Administrator is the senior technical owner of the platform that Hajoca’s Epicor Eclipse ERP runs on — the Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) operating environment, the Rocket UniVerse MultiValue database beneath Eclipse, and the near real time SQL replication layer that feeds the enterprise data warehouse and business intelligence. This role keeps a mission critical, 24×7 distribution platform stable, secure, high performing, and highly available across production and non production environments, while ensuring that operational Eclipse data flows accurately and continuously into SQL Server for reporting and analytics.

The ideal candidate blends deep Linux systems administration with hands on MultiValue database expertise and a strong data integration mindset — someone who can tune the OS and the UniVerse database, work fluently within the Eclipse ecosystem, and own the replication pipeline that turns nested MultiValue records into clean relational data for Power BI, SSRS, and Excel.

In this role, you will:

Own Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Administration

  • Install, configure, patch, and upgrade RHEL servers (physical and virtual) that host the Eclipse/UniVerse environment, keeping the estate on current, supported releases.
  • Tune the kernel, filesystems (LVM/XFS), memory, and CPU for MultiValue database workloads and heavy transactional I/O.
  • Automate provisioning, patching, and configuration management with Red Hat Satellite and Bash scripting to drive consistency and reduce manual effort.
  • Monitor system health, forecast capacity, and proactively tune performance to sustain availability targets.
  • Administer users, groups, permissions, SSH, sudo/PAM, and OS hardening in line with security policy.
  • Manage, networking (interface bonding, firewalld, DNS, NTP), systemd services, logging, and scheduled jobs.

Own Rocket UniVerse / MultiValue Database Administration

  • Administer Rocket UniVerse (U2) MultiValue database instances underpinning Epicor Eclipse — including accounts, files, file sizing/resizing, hashing, and record/group locks.
  • Diagnose and resolve locking, contention, and session issues; tune uvconfig, phantom processes, and shared memory parameters for optimal throughput.
  • Perform backups, transaction logging, and point in time recovery; validate restore procedures on a regular cadence.
  • Apply MultiValue performance monitoring (e.g., Rocket MVX: Performance) to track sessions, locks, host resources, and replication health.
  • Use RetrieVe/UniQuery and read UniVerse BASIC to investigate data issues and support reporting.
  • Maintain UniVerse licensing, TLS transport encryption, and data at rest encryption; open and manage support cases with Rocket Software or the VAR.

Own Epicor Eclipse SQL Replication & Maintain the Data Warehouse

  • Own the Epicor Eclipse SQL Replication engine that provides near real time replication of core Eclipse UniVerse (MultiValue) database files directly into a structured SQL Server data warehouse environment.
  • Configure, schedule, and continuously monitor replication so operational transactional data syncs into SQL tables with acceptable latency and completeness.
  • Manage the mapping and transformation that flattens nested multi value fields — such as multiple order lines within a single record — into standard relational rows and columns.
  • Administer the Information Control Engine (ICE) integration that feeds Eclipse data into dashboards and BI.
  • Maintain the SQL Server data warehouse (schema, indexing, SQL Agent jobs, and storage) and preserve a clean, standard schema for third party reporting.
  • Enable and support downstream reporting connections — Power BI, SSRS, and Excel — offloading heavy queries from the primary Eclipse environment to protect production performance.
  • Detect and resolve replication failures, resync/backfill gaps, and continuously verify data integrity between Eclipse and the SQL targets.

Ensure Backup, Disaster Recovery & High Availability

  • Design, execute, and document backup and recovery strategies spanning RHEL, UniVerse, Eclipse, and the SQL data warehouse.
  • Own disaster recovery planning and regular failover/recovery testing to meet defined RTO/RPO objectives.
  • Ensure business continuity for a 24×7 distribution operation, including participation in an on call rotation.

Govern Security & Compliance

  • Harden and patch RHEL against recognized benchmarks (e.g., CIS / DISA STIG) and manage vulnerability remediation.
  • Enforce least privilege access, audit logging, and change management discipline across the platform stack.
  • Support enterprise security and compliance initiatives in partnership with the Cyber Security & AI Enablement team.

Drive Automation, Documentation & Collaboration

  • Build and maintain automation (Ansible playbooks and scripts) for repeatable, auditable operations.
  • Produce and maintain runbooks, SOPs, architecture diagrams, and knowledge base articles.
  • Partner across Infrastructure, Applications & Support, Networking, and Cyber teams, and with business stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior administrators and actively share scarce MultiValue/Eclipse knowledge across the team.

About You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive systems administration experience, including some senior level ownership of production environments.
  • Preferred Certifications include Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) and/or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), Rocket U2 (UniVerse / UniData) training or certification, Microsoft SQL Server certification (e.g., Azure Database Administrator Associate).

Our ideal candidate will also:

  • Have deep, hands on Red Hat Enterprise Linux administration experience— installation, patching, performance tuning, storage, networking, and security.
  • Have hands on experience administering a MultiValue database — Rocket UniVerse or UniData (U2), or another Pick based platform.
  • Possess a working knowledge of Epicor Eclipse ERP (or a comparable MultiValue based distribution ERP) sufficient to support the underlying database and data pipeline — Eclipse application administration is owned by a separate partner role.
  • Possess a working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and of data replication / ETL concepts.
  • Be proficient in Bash scripting and automation with Ansible.
  • Possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills and the ability to react quickly and decisively during incidents.
  • Have virtualization (VMware) and enterprise storage (SAN/NAS) experience.
  • Be available for after hours maintenance windows and shared on call support.
  • Have direct experience with Epicor Eclipse SQL Replication and the Information Control Engine (ICE).
  • Possess reporting/BI integration experience with Power BI, SSRS, and Excel against a replicated SQL data warehouse.
  • Have a background in wholesale distribution or another multi site, high transaction environment. a background in wholesale distribution or another multi site, high transaction environment.
  • Be familiar with UniVerse BASIC and comfortable reading and adjusting existing MultiValue code.
  • Have experience coordinating vendor support relationships (Epicor, Rocket Software, and VARs).
  • Have experience with Rubrik Data Protection for management of backups, recovery, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Have experience with Zerto Continuous Data Protection.
  • Demonstrate strong functional knowledge; take ownership of skills, knowledge, and relationships needed to perform the job.
  • Be professional, organized, and able to manage work, time, and problems.
  • Be results oriented; focused on attaining goals and objectives.
  • Have a keen ability to interpret technical problems and systematically troubleshoot and resolve.

The benefits of working with us:

Our culture is well-suited for exceptional people who use their talents to drive business and want to share in the financial success their efforts yield. In addition to a competitive starting wage, we offer a Profit-Sharing Program that provides each team member with an opportunity to earn a direct share of the profits on an annual basis. In addition to our generous compensation package, Hajoca also offers:

Full-time benefits (for team members working 30 or more hours per week):

  • Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage
  • Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and critical care coverage
  • Life insurance and Long Term Disability
  • Pre-tax accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuter benefits
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time (sick time also offered to PT team members as required by state law)
  • Paid pregnancy and parental leave
  • Paid day of community service

Full-time and part-time benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • Retirement cash account with company contributions
  • Targeted training programs focused on your personal and professional growth
  • Company wellness program
  • Employee discounts
  • College tuition benefits
  • Please note that benefit offerings may differ for teammates employed through an intern program.

About Rethink First

Rethink First is on a mission to inspire hope and power potential. We are a market leader in behavioral and mental health technology, serving employers, schools, government agencies, behavioral health providers, clinicians, and families worldwide.

The Opportunity

The Manager, Software Development leads one software development team, or a clearly defined front-end, back-end, or full-stack product area, responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable solutions within Rethink First. The role owns direct people management, coaching, performance, delivery execution, quality, operational readiness, and practical team-level adoption of AI-DLC to improve how software is planned, built, tested, released, and supported.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on software development leader who develops engineers, removes delivery barriers, and helps the team use AI responsibly within a disciplined development lifecycle. They bring clarity when priorities evolve, move work forward with sound judgment and a strong sense of ownership, operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, and build trusted stakeholder alignment across Product, Operations, Support, Security, and customer-facing teams. Enterprise architecture strategy and governance are outside the scope of this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead one front-end, back-end, or full-stack software development team within an assigned product area through planning, execution, delivery, release readiness, and ongoing support of product commitments.

  • Manage, mentor, and develop engineers through coaching, feedback, clear expectations, performance management, and practical growth plans.

  • Partner with Product Management to translate roadmap priorities into achievable team delivery plans, user stories, sequencing, capacity planning, and measurable outcomes.

  • Remain technically engaged by partnering with technical leads where applicable, guiding team-level design discussions, reviewing code and technical approaches when needed, supporting proof-of-concept work, and reinforcing sound engineering practices.

  • Strengthen engineering execution through pragmatic Agile practices, predictable planning, repository health, automated testing, quality gates, technical debt management, operational readiness, and production learning.

  • Serve as a trusted cross-functional partner to Product, Operations, Support, Security, and customer-facing teams; resolve customer issues, strengthen feedback loops, navigate tradeoffs, and keep team priorities aligned with operational and business needs.

  • Build a culture of ownership, quality, trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement; use delivery, quality, reliability, and team-health measures to guide decisions.

How We Work with AI

  • Embed AI-DLC practices into day-to-day software delivery to improve productivity, quality, documentation, testing, and release confidence without replacing sound engineering judgment or human accountability.

  • Establish practical team-level guardrails for AI-assisted coding, testing, review, security, privacy, and release validation, with clear accountability for human judgment and final acceptance.

  • Coach the team on effective AI-assisted development practices, including context engineering, test generation, refactoring support, documentation support, and responsible use of agents or copilots.

  • Measure AI-DLC effectiveness through delivery predictability, cycle time, defect trends, quality of AI-assisted output, review findings, team adoption, and business impact.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of software engineering or web development experience, including 2+ years leading engineers as a manager or technical lead.

  • Proven success delivering SaaS, web, mobile, or cloud-based software products in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong technical foundation in modern software development, including C#/.NET, SQL, APIs, JavaScript/TypeScript, cloud platforms such as Azure, automated testing, CI/CD, and secure development practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to improve engineering practices, resolve delivery risks, manage technical debt, and support modernization while maintaining product stability.

  • Track record of leading a team through growth, modernization, or organizational change while sustaining engagement, accountability, and delivery momentum.

  • Sound judgment and initiative, with the ability to make decisions, surface tradeoffs, and advance work with limited direction while keeping stakeholders aligned.

  • Experience building healthy development team practices, including prioritization, sprint planning, estimation, code review, test automation, incident response, and performance visibility.

  • Practical experience applying AI-assisted development within a software team, including context engineering, evaluation, human oversight, automated gates, and security and privacy controls.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare technology experience and familiarity with HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, cybersecurity, privacy, and resilience.

  • Experience improving developer productivity, test automation, CI/CD, observability, or modernization of established SaaS products.

  • Experience with LLM platforms, coding agents or copilots, AI evaluation, or developer-platform tooling.

  • Flexible paid time off   

  • 11 paid company holidays

  • Parental leave

  • Access to our award-winning RethinkCare platform supporting neurodiversity in the workplace through parental success, professional resilience, and personal wellbeing.
