Senior Director, Product & AI Security THE ROLE

Reporting directly to the Fortive Chief Information Security Officer, you will be responsible for delivering strategic vision and operational oversight for Product Security and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security across the enterprise. This role will lead the development and execution of a comprehensive security strategy that embeds secure-by-design principles into software, connected products, firmware, and AI-enabled capabilities.

You will work across operating companies, engineering, product management, R&D, legal, and compliance teams to ensure product security, AI security, and secure-by-design controls are integrated throughout the product lifecycle. This leader will define enterprise standards, drive measurable risk reduction, and enable innovation by aligning security controls with business objectives, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments.

You will lead, coach, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of product and AI security professionals operating across Fortive and its operating companies.

REPORTS TO

VP & Chief Information Security Officer at Fortive

TEAM

Team consists of FTEs, contractors, and third-party security partners supporting product security engineering, AI security engineering, secure development lifecycle, and vulnerability management.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Product & AI Security Strategy: Develop and implement a comprehensive product and AI security strategy aligned with business objectives, growth initiatives, and regulatory requirements. Establish enterprise standards for secure software development, AI model security, data protection, and product security risk management.

Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC): Embed security and AI security controls into the full product lifecycle, including requirements definition, architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and sustainment. Drive consistent adoption of threat modeling, secure coding standards, code scanning, software bill of materials, and vulnerability remediation processes.

AI Security & Model Risk: Own the AI security program, including threat modeling and adversarial/red-team testing of AI systems; protection against prompt injection, model exfiltration, and data leakage; AI supply-chain and third-party/foundation-model risk; discovery and management of shadow AI; security of AI-assisted code generation and protection of intellectual property; and secure use of agentic AI, including non-human identities, tool and protocol integrations, and segregation-of-duties controls. Provide risk-tiered security review and recommendations on AI use cases and models, and represent Security on the AI Governance Committee in an advisory capacity, with business owners remaining accountable for use-case decisions.

Security Architecture for Products: Define and maintain reference architectures and blueprints for secure software, connected devices, cloud-native platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. Ensure scalability, resiliency, and security by design across products and customer environments.

Customer & Regulatory Alignment: Partner with sales, customer success, and legal teams to support customer security reviews, contract requirements, and regulatory obligations. Ensure alignment with global standards and emerging product security and AI regulations, including the EU Cyber Resilience Act and the EU AI Act.

Vulnerability & Incident Management: Oversee product vulnerability management processes, coordinated disclosure, penetration testing, and remediation programs, including scheduling and coordination of external penetration testing vendors and assessors. Ensure rapid response and transparent communication for product security incidents.

Software Supply Chain & Code Signing: Own software supply chain integrity for products, including code signing, build and release integrity, third-party and open-source component risk, and protection of intellectual property from exfiltration or malicious code insertion.

Acquisition Integration: Ensure product and AI security capabilities are scalable and capable of integrating acquired technologies efficiently while maintaining consistent enterprise standards.

Automation & Operational Efficiency: Drive automation and efficiency across product security operations, reducing manual effort and cycle times for vulnerability management, security reviews, and reporting while scaling coverage across operating companies.

Metrics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Establish measurable, OpCo-level product and AI security metrics that operating companies can track and improve over time. Provide regular reporting to executive leadership and the Board on product and AI security risk and program effectiveness, drive accountability, and continuously improve the program.

Deep expertise in secure software development, cloud-native architectures, DevSecOps, API security, and modern application security practices.

Demonstrated ability to lead security transformation in environments experiencing organic growth and acquisitions.

Experience collaborating with engineering, product management, legal, privacy, and compliance teams to translate security requirements into scalable, practical controls.

Strong understanding of global product security and AI regulations (such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act and the EU AI Act), secure coding practices, threat modeling, identity and access management, vulnerability management, and incident response.

jobs.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

About Liftoff Security Team

The Liftoff Security team protects Liftoff's customers, users, and employees. We architect Liftoff's security posture, build the tools and systems that defend it, and partner with engineering teams as they ship new products and features. Our work spans the entire stack — infrastructure, web, mobile, and IT — and we approach security from a software engineering standpoint, scaling our impact through automation and well-designed tools. As our Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you will own internal offensive testing and lead the move from point-in-time penetration tests to continuous, AI-assisted testing. You will independently plan assessments, safely validate vulnerabilities, work with engineering teams through remediation and retesting, and build sustained knowledge of our source code and systems. You will contribute across application, cloud, and infrastructure security, support Accelerate and MX as priorities change, and share the team's on-call and incident-response work.

Responsibilities

  • Independently plan and execute internal penetration tests across applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and corporate systems; prioritize assessments by risk and business impact.

  • Partner with engineering teams to explain findings, agree on practical fixes, track remediation, and retest to confirm the risk is resolved.
  • Maintain knowledge of Liftoff’s systems and attack surface, revisit high-risk attack paths as systems change, and turn confirmed findings into repeatable tests.
  • Build testing tools and workflows that combine hands-on assessments with ongoing automated testing and remediation validation.

  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted offensive security tooling: evaluate platforms and build workflows for code analysis, test generation, and finding triage; measure coverage, accuracy, and effort saved.
  • Partner with Detection & Response to turn validated attack paths and offensive findings into detection improvements and incident-response exercises.

  • Write production-quality code for security tools and automation, review pull requests, and navigate large, unfamiliar codebases. Develop safe proof-of-concept code and independently validate AI-generated code and findings.
  • Strong understanding of application and API security, authentication and authorization, network security, and common vulnerability classes.
  • Hands-on experience assessing cloud and infrastructure security, including identity and access controls, configuration, and attack paths.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex systems and architecture and contribute across application, cloud, and infrastructure security.
  • Practical software engineering habits: testing, observability, version control, peer code review, continuous integration, and blameless postmortems.
  • Strong technical writing: clear assessment plans, proposals, reproducible findings, runbooks, and post-incident reviews that support engineering decisions. Explain exploitability and business impact clearly in writing and conversation.
  • Willingness to share the security team’s on-call and incident-response responsibilities, including occasional off-hours response.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience securing large-scale cloud systems, mobile advertising, or other high-volume SaaS environments.

  • Ownership & Impact: Build and own our in-house offensive security capability, from selecting assessments to confirming fixes.
  • Broad Attack Surface: Test applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and corporate systems with access to source code and engineering context.
  • Engineering Partnership: Work with teams that value security and stay involved through remediation and retesting.
  • Room to Grow: Move from point-in-time penetration tests to continuous testing and lead adoption of AI-assisted offensive security tools.

Hands-On Technical Work: Investigate complex systems, validate vulnerabilities safely, and build tools that make testing more effective.

We are currently looking for a Senior FHIR Data Platform Engineer for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will optimize and maintain the HAPI FHIR data platform, with a strong focus on PostgreSQL performance, FHIR resource indexing, data quality, Master Data Management (MDM), and healthcare data reporting. The engineer will also develop FHIR-based quality measurement services, support HEDIS reporting, and work with large-scale healthcare datasets to ensure reliable, accurate, and performant data exchange.

The role operates in a highly collaborative environment, partnering with cloud platform engineers, data engineers, architects, and healthcare interoperability teams to optimize database performance, support reporting initiatives, maintain platform availability, and deliver production-ready solutions. The engineer will work extensively with HAPI FHIR, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, OMOP, and related data technologies.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities

  • Optimize the HAPI FHIR JPA persistence layer within PostgreSQL, including search parameters, custom indexes, partitioning strategies, reindexing, resource expunge and history policies, Bulk Data export performance, and asynchronous MDM link tables.
  • Design and execute FHIR data quality checks, including US Core STU 9 conformance, duplicate and orphaned reference detection, and source-event precedence validation.
  • Develop and maintain measure-reporting services for digital quality measurement engines and HEDIS baselines, including FHIR-based measure evaluation, facility and statewide reporting, administrative-effort baselines, and DHHS monthly service report exports.
  • Query OMOP Common Data Model and Apache Iceberg data marts for reporting purposes and collaborate with data engineers on the transformation of published healthcare data into OMOP when FHIR-side changes affect downstream datasets.
  • Produce capacity planning and performance evidence supporting 99.9% availability, 15-minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO), and 4-hour Recovery Time Objective (RTO) requirements for the FHIR platform.
  • Support cloud platform engineers with Aurora PostgreSQL sizing, read-replica configurations, backup verification, and database performance optimization while delivering migration scripts, runbooks, dashboards, and test suites into designated repositories.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field and 7+ years of professional PostgreSQL experience in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL query planning, index design, partitioning, and performance troubleshooting across multi-terabyte databases.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR JPA server internals, including resource tables, search-parameter indexing, Bulk Data, MDM, FHIR R4, and US Core.
  • Working knowledge of OMOP Common Data Model (CDM) v5.4, including concept, vocabulary, and clinical-event tables, with experience writing analytical SQL queries.
  • Experience developing healthcare quality reporting solutions using FHIR-based measures, CQL, FHIR Measure/MeasureReport, digital quality measures (dQM), HEDIS, or equivalent clinical quality reporting standards.
  • Proficiency in Java 21, Spring Boot, Flyway, and Git, with the ability to extend HAPI FHIR interceptors and measure-reporting services while following secure development practices in HIPAA-regulated environments.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, Apache Iceberg, Apache Spark, Kafka Streams, OpenSearch, and Grafana.
  • Experience supporting Medicaid programs, state Health Information Exchanges (HIEs), or VA/federal healthcare data modernization initiatives.
  • Experience working with healthcare data extracts from Epic, Meditech, Oracle Health, or athenahealth.
  • Experience with OHDSI tools such as Achilles or Data Quality Dashboard (DQD) and healthcare data quality validation.
  • Experience with high-availability database architectures, disaster recovery planning, backup verification, and production performance monitoring.

Security Clearance Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Corporate Laptop
  • Training Opportunities
  • Remote Opportunity

jobs.excerpt: Senior Product Manager, PlatformLocation: Ireland/UK (Remote)About EntityEntity is building the destination for high calibre games on the web.
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Platform

Location: Ireland/UK (Remote)

About Entity

Entity is building the destination for high calibre games on the web. A curated catalogue of bestselling full-scale game titles running natively in the browser: click a link and you’re playing in seconds on the device you already own.

There are no downloads, no installs and no new hardware. This new low-friction way of playing games is powered by the latest developments in web technologies such as WebAssembly and WebGPU, allowing us to render high-quality game experiences on your device. This is not a game streaming service; this is the power of the New Web.

For developers, we’re the official, licensed channel for proper games on the web. We offer self-serve D2C tools to publish, operate and grow their games, with social play, identity and a unique end-to-end business analytics suite built in.

We’ve signed top-tier publishers representing many millions of unit sales on PC and console to date and are preparing for our launch in 2027.

We’re early, funded and moving fast. Joining Entity at this stage is a rare opportunity to help shape our company and our mission. We are an AI-native business; embracing the latest technologies and tools is essential to being successful with us.

About the role

We're hiring a Product Manager to own the platform itself. That covers what players use to find, play and share games, and the portal and tools developers and publishers use to bring their games to Entity.

Product at Entity is split into two roles that work as one team:

  • Product Manager, Platform (this role) owns what we build: core platform features, the player experience, developer tools, and the governance a platform needs, such as age verification, GDPR and payments compliance.
  • Product Manager, Live owns how the product performs once it's live: the store, pricing, the player funnel, live ops and product performance.

You'll own the platform roadmap and decide what goes into each release. The Live PM is one of your most important internal customers.

You'll work inside the development team, not at a distance from it. We don't write a spec and throw it over the fence. We want someone who works through problems directly with engineers and designers, makes decisions quickly, and keeps everyone clear on the goal.

We're a small team with a launch window ahead of us, so we need to move fast and iterate. The right person knows how much process and documentation is enough to keep everyone aligned, and no more. You'll also be close to how games and players are changing, and keen to build for where the industry is heading.

Key responsibilities

  • Roadmap and releases. Own the platform roadmap: what we build, when and why. Set the scope of each release, sequence the work and keep a single prioritised backlog for the platform team.
  • Player experience. Define the core player-facing features, with core and mid-core players at the centre:
    • Finding (Discovery), launching and playing games, quickly
    • social features incl voice, spectate, virality
    • accounts, profiles, billing and the core systems needed to run a consumer platform at scale
    • cloud saves, trials, drm and the many other games specific features
    • The playing experience across devices (Incl mobile web)
  • Developer and publisher tools. Help define the tool suite that our game developers and publishers use to publish, manage and understand their games. We are a D2C self publishing and distribution platform unlocking the web as a channel.
  • Governance and compliance. Own the platform requirements for:
    • age verification and ratings
    • GDPR and privacy
    • accessibility
    • security
    • payment provider rules
  • Payments infrastructure. Own billing and payments as a platform capability. The Live PM defines the pricing, offers and store experience that run on it.
  • Technical health. Work with the CTO and VP Engineering to ensure quality. Set and hold targets for performance, reliability.
  • Working with the team. Work with engineers and designers day to day to shape features together, solve problems as they come up and make quick, clear decisions.
  • Light process. Keep documentation and process to what the team needs to understand the goal and what we're building, and no more.
  • Data and feedback. Define success measures for every feature. Use data, player and developer feedback and testing to see what's working, and change quickly what isn't.
  • Communication. Keep the wider team and leadership clear on plans and progress, including a short monthly updates and adhoc reports for senior leadership / investors.

Requirements

  • 3+ years' product management on games or gaming platforms, including recent work on modern, player-facing products.
  • A track record of shipping platform or core features for players, developers or both, and improving them based on results.
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams as part of the team, not handing over specs.
  • A working grasp of platform governance: privacy, age verification, payments or similar regulated areas.
  • Good judgement on process: you know when a quick conversation is enough and when something needs writing down.
  • Confidence using data to make product decisions, including setting success measures and reading player behaviour.
  • A current, first-hand understanding of how people play and discover games today, including:
    • where players spend their time: Discord, Reddit, Twitch, TikTok, YouTube
    • how players aged 16 to 60 engage with games and games content
    • how AI is changing how games are made, found and played
  • Clear communication, and the ability to keep a small team aligned on goals and priorities.
  • Based in the UK or Ireland, with the right to work there.

Nice to have

  • Experience on a games platform, storefront, launcher or console ecosystem.
  • Experience building products for developers, such as publishing portals, self-serve tools or SDKs.
  • Experience with browser or web technology, or cross-device products.
  • Experience with social features or products driven by community.
  • Experience taking a product from pre-launch to launch.
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or in a small, fast-moving team.
  • A technical background, or enough technical understanding to discuss trade-offs credibly with engineers.
  • A passion for games, and hands-on use of AI tools in your own product work.

Working Conditions

Entity is remote-first, but this role is only open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland, with a suitable home-working setup. We value autonomy, clear ownership, and outcome-driven work. Some flexibility in working hours is expected to support collaboration across the team. Occasional travel may be required for team sessions, industry events, or visits with development partners.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering
jobs.excerpt: Silvaco is hiring a Memory Design Lead to drive the architecture, design, customer interface and delivery of our embedded memory compiler portfolio: single-port SRAM, ROM, single- and dual-port register files (1PRF, 2PRF), and dual-port RAM (DPRAM).
jobs.description:
Silvaco is hiring a Memory Design Lead to drive the architecture, design, customer interface and delivery of our embedded memory compiler portfolio: single-port SRAM, ROM, single- and dual-port register files (1PRF, 2PRF), and dual-port RAM (DPRAM). You will lead a team of memory designers, set the technical direction across multiple process nodes, and serve as the senior technical voice in customer engagements — from early presales architecture discussions through PPA negotiation, integration support, and silicon qualification.

This role blends deep technical leadership with direct customer impact. You will shape what our compilers can do, how competitive their PPA is, and how confidently our customers can integrate them into their SoCs. If you have built memory compilers in production, mentored design teams, and enjoy translating customer requirements into winning silicon, this is a high-leverage role at a fast-growing semiconductor IP and EDA company.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Memory Design

  • Lead architecture, circuit design, and physical implementation of memory compilers across SRAM, ROM, 1-port and 2-port register files, and dual-port RAM.

  • Define bitcell selection, peripheral architecture (decoders, sense amps, write drivers, IO, self-timing), redundancy and repair strategy, and assist circuits (read/write assist, body bias) to hit aggressive PPA targets.

  • Drive Vmin, leakage, performance, area, and yield optimization across PVT corners, process variation, and aging effects.

  • Own the technical roadmap for the memory portfolio: new compiler variants, new nodes, feature enhancements, and methodology improvements.

  • Establish design, verification, and signoff methodology, while leading design and layout reviews, SPICE/FastSPICE characterization, statistical/Monte Carlo analysis, BIST/repair, DFT, and physical verification.

  • Lead silicon validation efforts including test chip development, testing and reporting.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of memory design engineers spanning circuit design, layout, characterization, and compiler/automation.

  • Set individual and team goals, conduct technical reviews, and develop career paths for engineers at multiple levels.

  • Allocate engineering effort across roadmap projects, customer commitments, and silicon programs; manage schedules, dependencies, and risk.

  • Build a culture of design rigor, peer review, and continuous methodology improvement.

Presales & Customer Engagement

  • Serve as the senior technical lead in presales engagements — qualifying opportunities, presenting Silvaco's memory portfolio, and shaping winning technical proposals.

  • Translate customer SoC requirements (frequency, voltage, density, power, port configuration, special modes) into compiler specifications and PPA commitments.

  • Partner with sales, field application engineers, and product management on RFQs, technical evaluations, and competitive benchmarking.

  • Lead deep-dive technical workshops with customer architects and design teams; respond to detailed technical questionnaires and audit-style reviews.

PPA Analysis & Benchmarking

  • Own PPA analysis across the memory portfolio — performance, power (active and leakage), area, and yield — at both the instance and SoC-aggregate level.

  • Build and maintain competitive benchmarks against foundry and third-party memory IP; identify gaps and prioritize closure.

  • Drive what-if and sensitivity analysis to guide architecture trade-offs (e.g., bitcell choice, mux ratio, banking, assist circuits, voltage operating range).

  • Translate PPA insights into clear, customer-ready collateral: datasheets, application notes, and technical white papers.

Customer Communication & Support

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for strategic customers throughout the engagement lifecycle — from evaluation through integration, tapeout, and silicon validation.

  • Lead technical reviews, integration debug, and silicon correlation discussions with customer design and product engineering teams.

  • Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of customer-reported issues, coordinating across design, characterization, CAD, and product teams.

  • Represent Silvaco in foundry partner meetings and at industry conferences as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • 10+ years of embedded memory design experience, with demonstrated production tapeouts of SRAM and at least two of: ROM, 1-port register file, 2-port register file, dual-port RAM.

  • Deep expertise in bitcell-level circuit design, memory peripherals, self-timed paths, sense amplifier design, and assist circuit techniques.

  • Hands-on experience across multiple process nodes, including FinFET and/or advanced sub-7nm nodes.

  • Strong command of SPICE simulation, statistical and Monte Carlo analysis, Vmin/yield modeling, and reliability (BTI/HCI/EM) analysis.

  • Working knowledge of memory compiler architecture and automation: how compilers assemble instances, generate views (.lib, LEF, GDS, Verilog, CDL), and scale across configurations.

  • Hands-on experience with DFT/scan tools (Tessent, FastScan), power integrity signoff (RedHawk or equivalent), and layout verification flows (DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction)

  • Familiarity with RTL/Verilog modelling of memory compilers, testchip definition and silicon correlation, and SDK/automation development for compiler view generation.

  • Proven team leadership experience — direct management or strong technical lead role over a team of 6+ memory designers.

  • Demonstrated success in customer-facing technical roles: presales, PPA negotiation, integration support.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical material to engineers, architects, and executives.

  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, TCL, Perl) and Linux-based design environments.

  • Experience working with AI tools, such as Claude, OpenAI, Gemini

  • Prior experience presenting at industry venues (ISSCC, VLSI Symposium, custom integrated circuits conferences) or contributing to memory IP standards.

  • Direct experience interfacing with foundry partners on PDK, bitcell qualification, and reference flow alignment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading memory compiler programs at an IP vendor, foundry, or large semiconductor company.

  • Background in low-power memory design for mobile, IoT, automotive, or AI/ML accelerator applications.

  • Experience with multi-port memory architectures beyond 2-port (e.g., 3-port, 4-port register files) and specialty memories (TCAM, multi-bank arrays).

All Silvaco salary ranges are determined by role, level, and geographic location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

Silvaco is a publicly traded company on the Nasdaq market under the symbol SVCO. For over three decades, Silvaco, based in Silicon Valley, California and with global locations around the world has solved semiconductor design challenges by offering affordable and competitive TCAD (Technology Computer Aided Design) software, EDA (Electronic Design Automation) software, proven design IP (intellectual property), and world class support to engineers and researchers across the globe. Silvaco solutions span from atoms to systems: starting with simulation of material behavior impacting semiconductor devices, to design and analysis of transistor circuits, and lastly providing IP blocks for systems-on-chip (SoC) designs.

jobs.title: Middle Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Boosters — це українська продуктова компанія.  Ми створюємо глобальні продукти в сферах Productivity та EdTech, які несуть цінність для 60 мільйонів людей.
jobs.description:
Boosters — це українська продуктова компанія. Ми створюємо глобальні продукти в сферах Productivity та EdTech, які несуть цінність для 60 мільйонів людей. Для нас важливо будувати продукти з довготривалим впливом — системні, масштабні та здатні залишатися актуальними десятиліттями.

Зараз ми шукаємо Middle Data Engineer в наш флагманський продукт JustDone — AI асистент для академічної аудиторії, який допомагає краще працювати з науковими роботами, навчатись і проводити глибинні дослідження. Ми віримо, що AI може суттєво змінити те, як люди навчаються та працюють з інформацією. Не через cheating, а через якісніший і глибший рісьорч, швидшу роботу з великими обсягами інформації та автоматизацію формальних і рутинних задач. Так у студентів і дослідників залишається більше часу на те, що справді має значення — мислення, навчання та власні ідеї.

Основна мета цієї ролі — взяти ownership за аналітичну data-інфраструктуру JustDone, забезпечувати її стабільну роботу та знаходити можливості для оптимізації й розвитку. Також ти матимеш можливість долучатися до суміжних задач NLP-напрямку.

Сьогодні JustDone це

  • 3+ млн преміум користувачів;
  • #1 позиція в США в ніші AI Writing Assistants;
  • 90%+ одиниць контенту, створених користувачами, знаходять реальне застосування;
  • понад 3 млн одиниць контенту, який генерується користувачами щомісяця;
  • власні AI та NLP рішення: AI Detector, Text Humanization Engines, AI Research Assistant.

Твоє майбутнє середовище

Наша головна перевага — це люди. Ми працюємо з тими, хто щодня прагне до самовдосконалення та задає високу планку гри. Ти станеш частиною команди фахівців з Data Engineering і працюватимеш пліч-о-пліч із Владом, Сергієм, Данилом та Олею.

Лідерка напрямку — Люба, Lead NLP Engineer. Для Люби важливі небайдужість до результату, самостійність та ownership - не просто закрити задачу, а розуміти, навіщо ми її робимо і чи справді вирішили проблему.

Ми цінуємо сфокусовану роботу та не перевантажуємо команду зустрічами. У нас немає зайвої бюрократії в ухваленні технічних рішень: можна пропонувати нові інструменти, експериментувати з підходами та впливати на те, як організована робота. Важливо лише розуміти, яку цінність принесе запропоноване рішення.

Саме в цій ролі ти отримаєш

  • Автономність та вплив. Зможеш самостійно визначати можливості для покращення аналітичної інфраструктури, пропонувати технічні рішення та бачити їхній результат.
  • Роботу з масштабними технічними задачами. Працюватимеш із production-системами та великими обсягами даних, впливаючи на їхню надійність і продуктивність.
  • Експертизу на перетині Data та AI. Зможеш долучатися до NLP-задач, працювати з Milvus і переймати досвід команди.
  • Перспективи зростання. Розвиватися до Senior Data Engineer із подальшою можливістю рухатися в напрямку Data/Platform Architect.

Твоя зона впливу

  • Розвиток event pipelines. Підтримуватимеш і розвиватимеш потоки даних від RabbitMQ до DWH та Amplitude / Reteno.
  • Інтеграція джерел даних. Підключатимеш нові та підтримуватимеш наявні джерела, розвиватимеш ETL / ELT pipelines.
  • Ownership аналітичної інфраструктури. Відповідатимеш за BigQuery та Airflow: керуватимеш доступами й service accounts, підтримуватимеш порядок у data streams і schemas.
  • Моделювання та оптимізація даних. Розвиватимеш архітектуру Bronze → Silver → Gold, працюватимеш із partitioning, clustering і materialized views, оптимізуватимеш схеми та запити.
  • Якість і надійність даних. Налаштовуватимеш перевірки актуальності й повноти даних, моніторинг SLA та anomaly alerts, досліджуватимеш інциденти й шукатимеш їхні першопричини.
  • Підтримка NLP-інфраструктури. Розвиватимеш пайплайни завантаження й оновлення даних у Milvus, працюватимеш з індексами та lifecycle даних для NLP-систем.

Для цього тобі знадобиться

  • 2+ роки комерційного досвіду на позиції Data Engineer.
  • Впевнене володіння Python - розробка ETL/ELT-процесів, consumers та integrations, написання підтримуваного production code.
  • Сильний SQL - складні запити, window functions, оптимізація та робота з великими датасетами.
  • Досвід роботи з DWH та Data Modeling - структурування даних, incremental loads, побудова й підтримка production pipelines.
  • Досвід із хмарними data-платформами - GCP або аналогічними рішеннями.
  • Розуміння оркестрації та event-driven pipelines - Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub або аналоги.
  • Розуміння Data Quality та Observability - моніторинг, контроль якості даних, alerts і troubleshooting.
  • Досвід роботи з Vector DB (Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant) буде перевагою.
  • Ownership і самостійність - вмієш не лише знаходити проблеми, а й пропонувати та реалізовувати рішення.
  • Комунікація та командна взаємодія - можеш пояснювати технічні рішення простою мовою.
  • Продуктове мислення - прагнення покращувати наявні рішення, їхню надійність, швидкість та ефективність.

Твій шлях до команди Boosters

Pre-screen з рекрутером (45 хвилин) → Співбесіда з Любою (1 година) → Hard skills Interview з Сергієм та Владом (90 хвилин) → Bar-raising (1 година)

Ми пропонуємо

Кар’єрний та персональний розвиток

  • Планові performance review і розробка PDP;
  • Підтримка в розвитку твого персонального бренду в соцмережах Boosters і експертних медіа;
  • Профільні комʼюніті з безкоштовними курсами і можливістю нетворкінгу;
  • Бюджет на курси, конференції та вивчення англійської;
  • Техніка від компанії та оплата всіх необхідних сервісів для роботи.

Автономію та гнучкість

  • Можливість обирати між роботою в офісі (Київ або Львів) та remote-first форматом (Україна та закордон);
  • Гнучкий старт дня (з 8 до 11 ранку за Києвом);
  • 20 дей-офів на рік, вихідні на державні свята та безлімітні лікарняні.

Турботу про здоров’я

  • Медичне страхування;
  • Компенсація роботи з психологом;
  • Індивідуальний бенефіт на заняття спортом;
  • Сніданки й обіди (on-site в офісах);
  • Спортивні активності: спільнота для бігу, волейбол, йога (офлайн); стретчинг та йога (онлайн).

Intern Testimonials

“The Ballotpedia internship experience sharpened my research and analytical skills, deepened my understanding of American politics, and gave me a front-row seat to the inner workings of a mission-driven organization. Working for Ballotpedia was a collaborative effort and my team and supervisor were consistently involved in my improvement and growth this summer. It is a must for potential interns!”— Brynley Jones, Summer 2024 Editorial Intern

"Interning at Ballotpedia was a wonderful opportunity to approach politics from a new angle. As a journalism student, I am often told to maintain neutrality, but the people at Ballotpedia are the first people who have shown me how to do that. It is refreshing to work for an organization so committed to non-partisan and fair coverage." — Claire Harrison, Summer 2024 Editorial Intern

"Interning with Ballotpedia was a wonderful experience. I was guided and taught throughout various projects while also being allowed to be creative and explore my ideas and projects. I have learned not only about American politics but meaningful ways to reach and educate people. It was an invaluable experience with great mentorship!" — Abigail Campbell, 2020 Communications Intern and current Communications Manager

"Participating in the editorial internship program was an exceptional learning experience that prepared me for my current role as a staff writer. Through the internship, I received extensive training on preventing bias, learned how to code the website, and worked on challenging projects, all with the support of helpful and encouraging Ballotpedia staff." — Janie Valentine, 2019 Spring Intern and current Managing Editor of the Law Team

Program Description

As an intern, you will go through a similar onboarding experience to full-time Ballotpedia employees. You will learn how to code the Ballotpedia website, be oriented to Ballotpedia’s style guide, learn about what we do to prevent and detect bias in our resources, and much more. Following orientation, you will join either the Communications, Editorial, External Relations or Tech teams, working alongside full-time staff members.

As a Ballotpedia Editorial intern, you may:

  • be embedded in one of our Editorial teams (i.e. Ballot Measures, Elections, Events, Law, Local Expansion, News, or Policy) and work directly with Editorial staff members;
  • research elections and candidates, policy topics, legislation, ballot measures, or other topics, depending upon your assignment;
  • Support creation or create original encyclopedic articles
  • assist our teams in news tracking, legislation tracking, and primary source monitoring;
  • process candidate surveys;
  • conduct other detailed research projects;
  • participate in brainstorming sessions and planning meetings with experienced staff members;
  • process new volunteer applications and work with volunteer program activities; and
  • assist with metrics and reporting on data collection.

As a Ballotpedia Communications intern, you may:

  • assist with Ballotpedia’s social media, including creating posts and graphics;
  • assist with Ballotpedia’s various email products, from daily and weekly newsletters to special campaigns;
  • respond to communications from a variety of external sources;
  • collect a variety of data points, tracking subscribers, and engagement;
  • help develop compelling presentations, infographics and reports;
  • monitor and report on media mentions;
  • participate in special research projects;
  • participate in promotional planning and activities;
  • assist in identifying and coordinating influencer relations on social media; and
  • find and analyze potential social media channels for Ballotpedia to join or track
  • Assist with video script writing and video image sourcing
  • Assist with SEO tagging
  • Opportunities to write marketing/promotional content.

Ballotpedia’s Tech Department also offers internship opportunities. You can find more information on how to become a Tech intern on our Job Opportunities page.

Ballotpedia’s spring 2027 internship runs from Monday, January 11, 2027 through Friday, May 7, 2027. Ballotpedia’s spring internship is a part-time internship program; interns will work approximately 10-20 hours per week depending on their availability.

Ballotpedia is happy to facilitate credit for your internship experience if that is available to you. If you will be seeking credit for your internship, and if there is anything that Ballotpedia will need to do to assist you, please include that information in the same file as your cover letter.

Environment

Ballotpedia interns will work remotely, as all Ballotpedia staff work remotely. To join Ballotpedia, you must have a well-functioning computer with Internet access. Ballotpedia uses Google Applications (Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive and more) to accomplish our goals. Some familiarity with Google Applications is helpful.

Compensation

Interns will be compensated at $15.00 per hour.

Please note:If the minimum wage in your area is more than $15.00 per hour, you will be compensated per your area’s minimum wage.

To Apply

To apply, click on “Apply for this job” below and fill out the form.

Please provide the following in PDF format:

  • résumé
  • cover letter which states your area of preference (Editorial or Communications), including the contact information for two professional references
  • neutral writing sample (under five pages)
    Note: please include this in the same file as your cover letter

Please ensure that either your resume or your cover letter includes your current address. Applications that do not include a current address will not be accepted.

If you are hired for this position, Ballotpedia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, Ballotpedia is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E-Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.

About Ballotpedia

Ballotpedia is a mission-driven organization dedicated to providing Americans with accurate, relevant, and reliable information about politics, elections, and public policy. Our goal is to close the ballot information gap and help voters make informed decisions. We value innovation, humility, hunger, and a collaborative spirit and are committed to continuously improving our offerings to better serve our audiences, readers, and candidates.

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tasks and responsibilitiesIn a public-sector digital-services environment, you will develop secure, accessible and responsive business applications that support citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users in Belgium.
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

In a public-sector digital-services environment, you will develop secure, accessible and responsive business applications that support citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users in Belgium. You will work across the application stack, from the Blazor user interface to the .NET services behind it, while contributing to technical decisions and supporting colleagues.

You will join an ICT department of approximately 250 professionals working on more than 50 projects in different development phases. The organisation is modernising its application landscape towards a cloud-native architecture on Microsoft Azure, using Azure Service Bus and containerised workloads. A platform engineering team provides shared libraries, the design system, DevOps pipelines and standards for the application teams.

Web user interfaces are standardised on Blazor, allowing one .NET skill set to cover the complete application. The UI is the part of the application used by citizens, healthcare professionals and employees, so it must be accessible, consistent and responsive. The organisation is also exploring the responsible use of AI in business applications and software development.

Job purpose

As Senior .NET Developer with a UI focus, you will design, develop, integrate and maintain modern business applications. You will take ownership of their user interfaces while contributing to the underlying services. The role combines advanced hands-on development with technical leadership, coaching and close collaboration with analysts, architects, UX stakeholders, security specialists, the platform engineering team and operations.

You will translate functional and technical requirements into reusable, accessible solutions. Your work will support a consistent user experience across devices and browsers, correct integration with services and APIs, reuse of the shared component library and design system, and compliance with standards for architecture, security, quality, maintainability and delivery.

As a senior developer, you will help resolve complex technical issues, make well-founded design choices, improve engineering practices and support colleagues through coaching and code reviews. The role remains strongly hands-on, with direct contributions to feature development, testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement across both the UI and its supporting services.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide technical direction for Blazor development across teams and promote consistent UI architecture, reusable components, coding standards and engineering practices in line with the platform team's standards.
  • Develop features, reusable components, prototypes, technical improvements and bug fixes using C#, modern .NET, Blazor, Razor components and the .NET Web APIs on which they depend.
  • Design scalable, maintainable and reusable front-end structures that align with the organisation's architectural principles, and contribute to the shared component library built on MudBlazor and the shared design system.
  • Build responsive interfaces with semantic HTML and modern CSS that meet WCAG 2.1 level AA, as required of Belgian public bodies under the European Web Accessibility Directive. Consider usability, browser compatibility and the public-service context throughout the development process.
  • Work with functional and business analysts and UX stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess feasibility and translate user and business needs into sound technical solutions.
  • Integrate Blazor applications with REST APIs and JSON-based services, including typed clients, suitable error handling, state management, validation and resilience. Extend the Web APIs when a feature requires it.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorisation flows using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect for internal users, healthcare professionals and citizens, each with its own identity provider. Apply secure development practices throughout the application lifecycle.
  • Maintain code quality through structured pull-request reviews, refactoring, SonarQube static analysis, coding standards and clear, reusable and testable components.
  • Define and maintain unit tests, Blazor component tests with bUnit, service-level integration tests and, where appropriate, automated UI tests with Playwright. Follow the test pyramid to support reliable releases and prevent regressions.
  • Use Git, Azure DevOps repositories, boards and CI/CD pipelines for controlled versioning, automated builds, testing and deployment to Azure environments.
  • Select the appropriate Blazor render mode for each application, monitor and improve loading time, rendering behaviour and responsiveness, and use Dynatrace and browser tools to diagnose issues in test and production.
  • Coach developers, share Blazor and accessibility expertise, document solutions and contribute to continuous technical improvement.
  • Lead the analysis and resolution of complex end-to-end issues from the browser through the API to the database across development, test and production environments.
  • Evaluate relevant .NET and web technologies and patterns, including AI-assisted development practices, and recommend adoption when they provide sustainable value and align with architectural and security decisions.

Key technical expertise

You should have recent, substantial hands-on experience in the following areas:

  • C# and modern .NET: Advanced proficiency in C# and current .NET, including .NET 10 or later, asynchronous programming, dependency injection, clean code and maintainable application design.
  • Blazor and Razor components: Recent experience developing production-grade Blazor applications, including the Blazor Web App model and its render modes: static server-side rendering, interactive Server, WebAssembly and Auto. You understand prerendering, streaming rendering, component lifecycle, state handling, forms, validation and reusable component libraries such as MudBlazor.
  • HTML, CSS and responsive design: Strong command of semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive design for consistent use across devices and screen sizes.
  • Accessibility: Practical experience delivering interfaces that meet WCAG 2.1 level AA, including keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, contrast, focus management and accessible forms. You are comfortable testing with assistive technologies.
  • REST API integration and JSON exchanges: Experience consuming and building REST APIs with ASP.NET Core, handling JSON exchanges and implementing robust validation, error handling and integration patterns.
  • OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect: Practical experience implementing secure authentication and authorisation in web applications with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and claims-based authorisation.
  • Data access: Working proficiency with Entity Framework Core and SQL, sufficient to implement features end to end and diagnose data-related issues.
  • Testing: Strong experience with unit testing, Blazor component testing with bUnit and service-level integration testing. Automated UI testing with Playwright is an advantage. You can design testable code and integrate automated tests into delivery pipelines.
  • Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines: Advanced use of Git, branching and pull-request workflows, Azure DevOps repositories and boards, and CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test and deployment.
  • Engineering quality and security: A demonstrated focus on code quality, code reviews, application security, maintainability, observability and reusable components.
  • AI-assisted development: Experience using GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or a similar coding assistant in a professional setting, with sound judgement about when to use these tools and how to review their output.
  • JavaScript and TypeScript interoperability: Knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and JavaScript-Blazor interoperability is an asset, particularly when integrating browser APIs or specialised front-end libraries.
  • Front-end architecture and design patterns: Ability to select and apply suitable patterns for component design, separation of concerns, state management, dependency management and scalable application structures.
  • Performance and browser diagnostics: Experience analysing rendering, network calls, memory usage and client-side performance with browser development tools, together with an understanding of the scalability characteristics of each Blazor render mode.
  • Cloud and containerised environments: Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and an understanding of containerised deployment for application delivery and troubleshooting.
  • Distributed systems: Sufficient understanding of messaging, including Azure Service Bus and NServiceBus, and distributed systems to collaborate effectively with integration-focused colleagues and diagnose end-to-end issues.
  • Additional ecosystem assets: Knowledge of SharePoint as a document management system or of legal document stores with WORM requirements is an asset where relevant to the assigned application domain.

Key soft skills

  • Technical leadership and mentorship: Guide developers, provide constructive feedback, share knowledge and support professional growth while remaining hands-on.
  • Collaboration: Work effectively with analysts, architects, UX stakeholders, security specialists, testers, platform engineering, operations and business representatives in a multidisciplinary public-service environment.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making: Identify root causes, compare options, explain trade-offs and make pragmatic, sustainable technical decisions.
  • User focus: Understand the needs of citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users, including users of assistive technologies, and translate them into clear, accessible and efficient digital experiences.
  • Communication: Explain complex technical matters clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and produce concise, useful technical documentation.
  • Resilience and adaptability: Manage changing technologies, priorities and requirements while maintaining quality, security and delivery commitments.
  • Continuous improvement: Follow relevant developments in .NET, Blazor, web standards, accessibility, security and software engineering, and apply them with sound judgement.

Language proficiency: Mastery of French or Dutch and professional proficiency in English are required. Passive understanding of the second national language is an asset.

Expected seniority

You should be able to work autonomously on complex application challenges, take ownership from requirements through production support, influence technical choices and raise the quality and consistency of the wider development team, particularly on the user-interface side. Seniority must be demonstrated through recent hands-on delivery, not only through coordination or advisory experience.

Demonstrated experience as a front-end developer with a strong .NET and Blazor background.

Senior Manager, Software Quality Assurance

Pay Transparency: A reasonable estimate of the annual base salary for this position is $150,000 - $175,000 plus discretionary annual bonus. Pay ranges may vary by location.


As our Senior Manager, Software Quality Assurance, you will lead the software quality function while applying hands-on software development knowledge to ensure product software, firmware, and digital health platform services are designed, developed, verified, validated, and released in compliance with applicable quality system procedures. You will provide strategic and operational leadership to software quality engineers, drive continuous improvement in software quality processes, and ensure robust risk management throughout the software lifecycle.


You and your team will partner with key stakeholders to provide cross-functional support, contribute to design history file content, and, where applicable to you areas of expertise, lead post-market product investigations, CAPAs, and provide audit support.. This is a full-time, remote position and may include up to 25% travel.


This is an opportunity to directly impact product quality and the improve user experience. LivaNova is a growing, cutting-edge, medical device company specializing in neuromodulation product the enrich patients lives.


What You'll Do

  • Team Leadership and Development: Recruit, mentor, coach, and develop software quality engineers. Lead the software and firmware quality function for product software and cloud infrastructure, including the digital health platform.
  • Design Control Oversight: Ensure the completeness and sufficiency of design requirements, architecture specifications, detailed design specifications, code review evidence, verification and validation evidence, risk management files, and traceability.
  • Change Control Governance: Chair or oversee software change control boards and defect management processes. Communicate V&V results to management, including summaries of outcomes and known software anomalies.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Build strategic alignment with partner organizations, including R&D, Regulatory, Operations, Security, Marketing, and Clinical.
  • Risk Management Stewardship: Maintain working knowledge of program hazard analyses, FMEAs, security risk assessments, risk management reports, and post-market lifecycle risk documentation.
  • Technical Decision-Making: Approve complex investigations, technical assessments, code-related quality conclusions, and quality-critical decisions. Manage the team to ensure on-time delivery of investigations, CAPAs, and audit responses.
  • Quality Management System Ownership: Maintain and improve software development, test, and change management procedures, as well as best practices for digital health platform management.
  • Manufacturing Software Validation: Demonstrate a deep understanding of validation requirements and processes. Ensure team members support compliant validation of manufacturing and test system software as part of new product development programs.
  • Audit and Inspection Readiness: Serve as a senior SME during internal audits and external regulatory inspections. Ensure the team delivers efficient, complete design history files with the elements necessary to demonstrate compliance.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate software quality status, risks, and mitigation strategies to senior leadership. Organize and support cross-functional efforts in the event of field actions.
  • Continuous Improvement: lead initiatives that strengthen software quality processes, tools, and metrics.

Your Background and Experience

The following represent the minimum qualifications:

  • Engineering Degree — BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. Advanced Degree Preferred — MS or higher in engineering or a software-related discipline preferred.
  • 8+ years of medical device experience and 3+ years of prior team management experience.
  • Medical Device Software and Quality Expertise: Deep knowledge of software development principles, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, FDA QMSR, ISO 14971, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience developing software or firmware in the medical device industry, combined with software quality leadership experience and demonstrated proficiency with IEC 62304 requirements. Candidates must possess technical capability in software development, preferably C or C#, including the ability to assess code reviews, software defects, verification results, and CAPA conclusions.
  • Strategic Quality Planning; Risk Management Leadership; Audit Expertise; Ability to lead strategy and provide technical direction for complex software investigations, CAPAs, quality decisions, and development-related risk assessments.

What We Can Offer You

At LivaNova, you'll help change the trajectory of lives for a new day while working alongside passionate teams dedicated to delivering impactful innovation for patients worldwide.


We offer:

  • A role in an innovative medical technology environment that supports professional growth and development.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with international partners and cross-functional teams to bring life-changing solutions to patients.
  • A culture grounded in Empowered Accountability, Curious Mindset, Constructive Collaboration, and Thoughtful Humility.
  • Competitive compensation and an inspiring place to work.

If you're inspired by purpose-driven work, meaningful innovation, and the opportunity to bring New Life in Action every day, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Senior Software Engineerу цій ролі — це про поєднання глибокої інженерної експертизи та готовності брати на себе лідерство.
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineerу цій ролі — це про поєднання глибокої інженерної експертизи та готовності брати на себе лідерство. Ми шукаємо людину, яка мислить системно, приймає рішення і не уникає відповідальності за результат.

Якщо ти сильний інженер, який давно мислить не лише задачами, а впливом — ця роль для тебе. В нас немає мікроменеджменту: ти сам знаходиш рішення, формуєш підхід до роботи і доводиш його до результату.

В короткій перспективі роль еволюціонує від індивідуального внеску до управління командою та напрямком. Це включає: формування команди, участь у наймі, відповідальність за делівері та якість. А згодом - повноцінне лідерство над бізнес-напрямком, де твій вплив вимірюється не кодом, а бізнес результатами.

Honeytech — динамічний, швидкозростаючий проект, що створив платформу з коміксами в азійській стилістиці та вже став № 1 у своїй ніші! Уяви Netflix, але для коміксів — лише за кілька років ми зібрали 15+ мільйонів користувачів, кинули виклик гігантам з Південної Кореї й довели, що можемо будувати продукт світового рівня з України!
Наша експертна команда налічує понад 90 спеціалістів в штаті та зростає більше ніж в 2.5 рази щороку.

Чому це може бути цікаво саме тобі?

  • Ти впливаєш на продукт. Ми маленька професійна команда, де твої ідеї мають реальний вплив на платформу.

  • Швидкий цикл розробки. Середній час до продакшену ≈1 тиждень, тож ти одразу бачиш результати своєї роботи.

  • Мінімум бюрократії. Ніяких тайм-трекерів, а всі необхідні апруви отримуєш протягом дня.

  • Повна гнучкість. Ми – full remote, але якщо тобі комфортніше працювати з офісу, є варіанти у Києві, Львові та Варшаві.

  • Ти формуєш майбутнє компанії. Ми швидко зростаємо, і твоя роль – не просто "писати код", а закладати фундамент на роки вперед.


Ми шукаємо інженера, який має сильну архітектурну та бекенд-експертизу:

  • Досвід проєктування архітектури продуктів з нуля (System Design)

  • Практичний досвід роботи з високонавантаженими системами (High Load)

  • Розуміння життєвого циклу продукту в продуктових компаніях або стартапах

Backend та інфраструктура:

  • Глибокий досвід роботи з реляційними базами даних (складні схеми, оптимізація запитів та індексів)

  • Побудова мікросервісної архітектури або SOA

  • Досвід роботи з чергами повідомлень (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

Інженерна база:

  • Сильні Computer Science fundamentals (алгоритми, структури даних, складність, патерни)

Стек технологій, з яким працюємо:

  • Back-end: PHP 8.1+, Symfony 6+, NodeJS, Kafka, Redis, SQL

  • Front-end: Twig (шаблонізація) / TypeScript, Webpack Encore

  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS (RDS, S3, Redis), Docker, GitLab

Що потрібно буде робити?

  • Розробка: брати безпосередню участь у реалізації технічних рішень і писати якісний, продуманий код

  • Бізнес-цінність: фокусуватися не лише на технічній частині, а й на тому, щоб рішення реально впливали на бізнес-результат

  • Масштабування відповідальності: у перспективі 2–4 місяців перейти до управління бізнес-напрямком — включно з делівері, people-менеджментом і контролем якості

  • Управління командою: формувати та розвивати власну команду, включно з участю в наймі та прийнятті кадрових рішень


Цікаво, що ще пропонуємо?

- Робота на найбільш конкурентних ринках Tier1 (США, Канада, Британія, Австралія і т.д), що дозволяє стати експертом у своїй справі.

- 20 робочих днів відпустки на рік (після 3 місяців співпраці) та до 30 днів sick leave з медичним підтвердженням. А також можливість трансферу робочих днів та days off по державних святах України.

- Веселі тімбілдінги та корпоративні подорожі Україною та Європою.

- Допомога в релокації, оплата коворкінгів або допомога у придбанні зарядних станцій для комфортної роботи під час відключення електропостачання (після 3х місяців співпраці).

- Різноманітні можливості для навчання: доповіді спікерів у різних напрямах, велика корпоративна бібліотека, компенсація зовнішніх курсів і, звичайно, уроки англійської мови + speaking clubs (після випробувального терміну).

- Але найголовніше: Honeytech — це команда професіоналів, де кожний відчуває підтримку та досягає своїх цілей!

Якщо ти побачив у рядках вище себе — надсилай нам своє резюме поспілкуємось та познайомимо з продуктом!
